sentences.text: I saw a man get hit by a car.
sentences.translationZh: 我看見有個男人被車撞了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我看见有个男人被车撞了。

sentences.text: Is it OK if I go out with Tom?
sentences.translationZh: 我跟湯姆外出行嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我跟汤姆外出行吗？

sentences.text: My son is now as tall as I am.
sentences.translationZh: 我兒子現在和我一樣高了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我儿子现在和我一样高了。

sentences.text: Did I tell you I got a new job?
sentences.translationZh: 我有告訴你我找到新工作了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有告訴你我找到新工作了嗎？

sentences.text: I felt as if I were in a dream.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覺就像做夢一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感觉就像做梦一样。

sentences.text: Is it OK for me to come in now?
sentences.translationZh: 我現在進來方便麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我现在进来方便么？

sentences.text: He told me to do it, so I did it.
sentences.translationZh: 他讓我做，我就做了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他让我做，我就做了。

sentences.text: I don't eat as much as I used to.
sentences.translationZh: 我比以前吃得少了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我比以前吃得少了。

sentences.text: I felt a drop of rain on my head.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覺有滴雨落在頭上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感觉有滴雨落在头上。

sentences.text: I think I can run as fast as Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我能跑得跟湯姆一樣快。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我能跑得跟汤姆一样快。

sentences.text: I want you guys to do me a favor.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要大傢伙幫我個忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。

sentences.text: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
sentences.translationZh: 說謊總是一種罪嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 说谎总是一种罪吗？

sentences.text: As soon as he saw me, he ran away.
sentences.translationZh: 他一看見我，就跑了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一看見我，就跑了。

sentences.text: Do you have a lot of money on you?
sentences.translationZh: 你身上有很多錢嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你身上有很多钱吗？

sentences.text: He threw a piece of meat to a dog.
sentences.translationZh: 他朝狗扔了一塊肉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他朝狗扔了一块肉。

sentences.text: I came to warn you not to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我來警告你別那樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我来警告你别那样做。

sentences.text: I hope I can do that before I die.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我能在死前做一次。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我能在死前做一次。

sentences.text: I was the one who had to tell Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 該由我告訴湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 该由我告诉汤姆。

sentences.text: I'm not as strong as I used to be.
sentences.translationZh: 我不跟以前一樣強壯了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不跟以前一樣強壯了。

sentences.text: It is a lot of fun to drive a car.
sentences.translationZh: 開車很好玩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 開車很好玩。

sentences.text: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.
sentences.translationZh: 她可能是護士。我不太肯定。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。

sentences.text: Air is to us what water is to fish.
sentences.translationZh: 空氣對人來說就是水對魚的意義。
sentences.translationOriginal: 空气对人来说就是水对鱼的意义。

sentences.text: Do you have a lot of time to relax?
sentences.translationZh: 你有很多休閒時間嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有很多休閒時間嗎？

sentences.text: Do you still want to give me a hug?
sentences.translationZh: 你還想給我一個擁抱嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你還想給我一個擁抱嗎？

sentences.text: He will not be able to do the work.
sentences.translationZh: 他沒能力做這個工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他没能力做这个工作。

sentences.text: I am sure that he is an honest man.
sentences.translationZh: 我確定他是個老實人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我确定他是个老实人。

sentences.text: I did not expect it to be that big.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒想到它有那麼大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没想到它有那么大。

sentences.text: I don't know her, nor do I want to.
sentences.translationZh: 我不認識她，也不想認識。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不认识她，也不想认识。

sentences.text: I have a lot of friends to help me.
sentences.translationZh: 我有很多朋友幫我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有很多朋友帮我。

sentences.text: I need a bag. Will you lend me one?
sentences.translationZh: 我需要個包。你能借我一個嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要个包。你能借我一个吗？

sentences.text: I owe it you that I am still alive.
sentences.translationZh: 多虧了你，我還活著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 多亏了你，我还活着。

sentences.text: I will get the work done in a week.
sentences.translationZh: 我會一週內完成這個工作的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会一周内完成这个工作的。

sentences.text: I will not allow you to use my pen.
sentences.translationZh: 我不允許你用我的鋼筆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不允许你用我的钢笔。

sentences.text: If you want to, you can use my car.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你願意，你可以用我的車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你愿意，你可以用我的车。

sentences.text: It looks as if it is going to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 天看起來要下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天看起来要下雨了。

sentences.text: There are a lot of eggs in the box.
sentences.translationZh: 這個盒子裡有很多蛋。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个盒子里有很多蛋。

sentences.text: This is all the money I have on me.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我身上所有的錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是我身上所有的錢。

sentences.text: Tom has no one to turn to for help.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有能求助的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没有能求助的人。

sentences.text: Tom used to eat a lot of junk food.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆以前經常吃很多垃圾食品。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆以前经常吃很多垃圾食品。

sentences.text: A dog can run faster than a man can.
sentences.translationZh: 狗跑得比人快。
sentences.translationOriginal: 狗跑得比人快。

sentences.text: A map helps us to know where we are.
sentences.translationZh: 地圖幫助我們知道所在的位置。
sentences.translationOriginal: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。

sentences.text: All you need to do is just sit here.
sentences.translationZh: 你要做的只是坐在這兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。

sentences.text: Do I have to take off my shoes here?
sentences.translationZh: 在這裡我必須脫鞋嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 在這裡我必須脫鞋嗎?

sentences.text: Do you have a lot of money with you?
sentences.translationZh: 你身上有很多錢嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你身上有很多钱吗？

sentences.text: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
sentences.translationZh: 您介不介意我把燈關了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您介不介意我把灯关了？

sentences.text: He is the man you met the other day.
sentences.translationZh: 他是前幾天和你見過面的那個人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是前几天和你见过面的那个人。

sentences.text: He took a taxi to get there in time.
sentences.translationZh: 他打出租車以及時趕到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他打出租车以及时赶到。

sentences.text: How do I get my dog to eat dog food?
sentences.translationZh: 怎麼樣才能讓我的狗吃狗糧？
sentences.translationOriginal: 怎么样才能让我的狗吃狗粮？

sentences.text: I brought up two kids all on my own.
sentences.translationZh: 我一個人把兩個小孩扶養長大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一個人把兩個小孩扶養長大。

sentences.text: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
sentences.translationZh: 我聽得見你，但我看不見你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。

sentences.text: I don't care if you trust me or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我不關心你是否信任我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不關心你是否信任我。

sentences.text: I don't like the way you talk to me.
sentences.translationZh: 我不喜歡你和我說話的口氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不喜歡你和我說話的口氣。

sentences.text: I don't see why I had to come along.
sentences.translationZh: 我不明白為什麼我得跟著去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不明白为什么我得跟着去。

sentences.text: I found this at the risk of my life.
sentences.translationZh: 我冒著生命危險找到了這個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我冒著生命危險找到了這個。

sentences.text: I have not seen him for a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我很久沒見過他了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很久没见过他了。

sentences.text: I know you don't want to talk to me.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道你不想跟我說話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道你不想跟我说话。

sentences.text: I should tell Tom what I have to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我應該告訴湯姆我該做甚麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我應該告訴湯姆我該做甚麼。

sentences.text: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
sentences.translationZh: 我很熱，就把電風扇打開了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很熱，就把電風扇打開了。

sentences.text: I'm not as stupid as you think I am.
sentences.translationZh: 我不像你想的那麼傻。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不像你想的那么傻。

sentences.text: I've had a lot of work to do lately.
sentences.translationZh: 我最近有很多事情要做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我最近有很多事情要做。

sentences.text: It is a pity that you can't join us.
sentences.translationZh: 你不能和我們一起來真可惜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不能和我們一起來真可惜。

sentences.text: The old man was almost hit by a car.
sentences.translationZh: 老人幾乎被車撞上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老人幾乎被車撞上。

sentences.text: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆往他的吐司上放了許多蜂蜜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆往他的吐司上放了许多蜂蜜。

sentences.text: Tom said he keeps a gun in his home.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他的家裡有把槍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他的家裡有把槍。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary he had a lot of money.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗他有很多錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆告訴瑪麗他有很多錢。

sentences.text: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
sentences.translationZh: Tom，我想和你談談。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom，我想和你談談。

sentences.text: We went all out to get the job done.
sentences.translationZh: 我們全力以赴來完成工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们全力以赴来完成工作。

sentences.text: Why do you need to read such a book?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼你要讀這樣一本書？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为什么你要读这样一本书？

sentences.text: Are you sure you know how to do this?
sentences.translationZh: 你真的知道這個怎麼做嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真的知道这个怎么做吗？

sentences.text: Do you think Tom will let us do that?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為湯姆會讓我們做嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你認為湯姆會讓我們做嗎？

sentences.text: He came to Tokyo at the age of three.
sentences.translationZh: 他三歲就到東京了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他三岁就到东京了。

sentences.text: He had no idea why his wife left him.
sentences.translationZh: 他不知道為什麼他的妻子要離開他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不知道为什么他的妻子要离开他。

sentences.text: He has been ill in bed for four days.
sentences.translationZh: 他已臥病在床四天了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他已卧病在床四天了。

sentences.text: He is now either in Rome or in Paris.
sentences.translationZh: 他不是在羅馬，就是在巴黎。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不是在羅馬，就是在巴黎。

sentences.text: He will be my deputy while I am away.
sentences.translationZh: 我不在的時候，他將是我的代理人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

sentences.text: I don't do that as well as I used to.
sentences.translationZh: 我不如以前做得好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不如以前做得好了。

sentences.text: I don't go in for that sort of thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我討厭那種事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我讨厌那种事。

sentences.text: I don't know if I have time to do it.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道我是否有時間做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道我是否有时间做。

sentences.text: I don't want to live my life in fear.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想在恐懼中生活。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想在恐惧中生活。

sentences.text: I have no more time to talk with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒時間再跟你說話了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没时间再跟你说话了。

sentences.text: I know him by name, but not by sight.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道他的名字，但不知道他長什麼樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道他的名字，但不知道他长什么样。

sentences.text: I know him by sight, but not by name.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道他的樣子，但不知道他的名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。

sentences.text: I ran into Mary at a party last week.
sentences.translationZh: 上星期在一次派對中我遇到了瑪麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 上星期在一次派對中我遇到了瑪麗。

sentences.text: I swear I will never do such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我發誓我不會做這種事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我发誓我不会做这种事。

sentences.text: I think it's time for you to grow up.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得你是時候該懂事了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得你是时候该懂事了。

sentences.text: I think that Tom has a crush on Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆愛上瑪麗了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆爱上玛丽了。

sentences.text: I think that Tom should go on a diet.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆需要減肥了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆需要减肥了。

sentences.text: I used to eat pizza, but now I don't.
sentences.translationZh: 我以前吃披薩，但現在不了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以前吃披萨，但现在不了。

sentences.text: I want a new shirt. What do you want?
sentences.translationZh: 我要一件新襯衫。你想要什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？

sentences.text: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
sentences.translationZh: 我叔叔給了我一塊漂亮的手錶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我叔叔给了我一块漂亮的手表。

sentences.text: I would like to have a cup of coffee.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要一杯咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要一杯咖啡。

sentences.text: I'd love to find out why she said so.
sentences.translationZh: 我很想找出她為什麼這麼說的原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很想找出她为什么这么说的原因。

sentences.text: I'm the one who wants to be with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我才是那個想和你在一起的人！
sentences.translationOriginal: 我才是那个想和你在一起的人！

sentences.text: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你需要筆的話，我借你一支。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你需要笔的话，我借你一支。

sentences.text: It will cost you more to go by plane.
sentences.translationZh: 搭飛機將花你比較多的錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 搭飛機將花你比較多的錢。

sentences.text: My father is too busy to take a walk.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親太忙而無法去散步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父親太忙而無法去散步。

sentences.text: She was in a hurry to see her father.
sentences.translationZh: 她急於見她的父親。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她急于见她的父亲。

sentences.text: The nurse will tell you how to do it.
sentences.translationZh: 護士會告訴你怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 护士会告诉你怎么做。

sentences.text: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
sentences.translationZh: 這是搭帳篷的好地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是搭帐篷的好地方。

sentences.text: This is what Tom would want me to do.
sentences.translationZh: 這是湯姆會想讓我們做的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是湯姆會想讓我們做的。

sentences.text: Tom and I were born in the same city.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和我生在同一個城市。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆和我生在同一個城市。

sentences.text: Tom can swim almost as fast as I can.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆幾乎能遊得跟我一樣快。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆几乎能游得跟我一样快。

sentences.text: Tom left a note for Mary on her desk.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆給瑪麗在她桌上留了便條。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆給瑪麗在她桌上留了便條。

sentences.text: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。

sentences.text: Tom said he was ill, which was a lie.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他病了，這是說謊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他病了，这是说谎。

sentences.text: Tom told me he had a right to see it.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他有權看它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他有权看它。

sentences.text: Tom went out for a walk with his dog.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆帶他的狗出去走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆帶他的狗出去走。

sentences.text: We are glad to have you in our class.
sentences.translationZh: 我們很高興你加入了我們班。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们很高兴你加入了我们班。

sentences.text: We have to pick a name for the child.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要給孩子起個名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們要給孩子起個名字。

sentences.text: What kind of woman do you think I am?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為我是哪種女人？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你认为我是哪种女人？

sentences.text: You may as well tell me all about it.
sentences.translationZh: 你不妨告訴我一切。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不妨告訴我一切。

sentences.text: A wise man would not say such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 一個聰明人不會說這種話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一个聪明人不会说这种话。

sentences.text: Can you tell us a bit more about that?
sentences.translationZh: 能再告訴我一點嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 能再告诉我一点吗？

sentences.text: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
sentences.translationZh: 你發燒和喉嚨痛嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你發燒和喉嚨痛嗎?

sentences.text: Do you know what time it is in Boston?
sentences.translationZh: 請問現在波士頓是幾點鐘？
sentences.translationOriginal: 请问现在波士顿是几点钟？

sentences.text: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
sentences.translationZh: 你想成為一名電影演員嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想成為一名電影演員嗎？

sentences.text: Do you want to go on a picnic with me?
sentences.translationZh: 你想跟我去野餐嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想跟我去野餐吗？

sentences.text: Do you want to know why I lied to Tom?
sentences.translationZh: 你想知道為什麼我對Tom說話嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想知道为什么我对Tom说话吗？

sentences.text: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
sentences.translationZh: 你怎麼樣？旅遊愉快嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你怎么样？旅游愉快吗？

sentences.text: How do you say "I love you" in French?
sentences.translationZh: “我愛你”用法語怎麼講？
sentences.translationOriginal: “我爱你”用法语怎么讲？

sentences.text: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
sentences.translationZh: 我買了幾個雞蛋和一點牛奶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。

sentences.text: I do not know when she will come back.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道她什麼時候會回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道她什么时候会回来。

sentences.text: I don't care as long as you are happy.
sentences.translationZh: 只要你開心就行了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只要你开心就行了。

sentences.text: I don't have time to meet up with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒時間跟您碰頭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没时间跟您碰头。

sentences.text: I don't know if I can go to the party.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道我是否可以去派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道我是否可以去派对。

sentences.text: I don't like the way you laugh at her.
sentences.translationZh: 我不喜歡你嘲笑她的方式。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。

sentences.text: I don't like to go out when it's dark.
sentences.translationZh: 我天黑後不喜歡出門。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我天黑后不喜欢出门。

sentences.text: I have no idea what I'm going to wear.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道穿甚麼好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道穿甚麼好。

sentences.text: I hope that you give this book a read.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望你讀讀這本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望你讀讀這本書。

sentences.text: I know him, but I don't know his name.
sentences.translationZh: 我認識他但是我不知道他的名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認識他但是我不知道他的名字。

sentences.text: I like May the best of all the months.
sentences.translationZh: 所有月份中我最喜歡五月。
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有月份中我最喜歡五月。

sentences.text: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.
sentences.translationZh: 我喜歡她因我的笑話而歡笑的樣子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我喜欢她因我的笑话而欢笑的样子。

sentences.text: I think I may have made a big mistake.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我可能已經犯了大錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我可能已經犯了大錯。

sentences.text: I think Tom might not want to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為湯姆可能不想那樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为汤姆可能不想那样做。

sentences.text: I want to go to school and study hard.
sentences.translationZh: 我想上學並努力學習。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想上学并努力学习。

sentences.text: I was about to leave when you came in.
sentences.translationZh: 你來的時候我剛好要走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你来的时候我刚好要走。

sentences.text: I was in the bath when the phone rang.
sentences.translationZh: 在我洗澡的時候，電話響了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

sentences.text: I was the last one to turn in my test.
sentences.translationZh: 我是最後交的考試卷。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我是最后交的考试卷。

sentences.text: I wish you had told me the truth then.
sentences.translationZh: 但願你那時候就告訴我真相。
sentences.translationOriginal: 但願你那時候就告訴我真相。

sentences.text: I wonder if you are as busy as we are.
sentences.translationZh: 我擔心你會跟我們一樣忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我担心你會跟我們一樣忙。

sentences.text: I'd like to finish the work on my own.
sentences.translationZh: 我想自己把工作做完。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想自己把工作做完。

sentences.text: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要訂房。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要订房。

sentences.text: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.
sentences.translationZh: 能為你服務我會感到非常高興。
sentences.translationOriginal: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。

sentences.text: I'll go with you as far as the bridge.
sentences.translationZh: 我會跟著你走到橋那裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会跟着你走到桥那里。

sentences.text: I'm going to drop in on her next week.
sentences.translationZh: 下禮拜我要去拜訪她一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 下禮拜我要去拜訪她一下。

sentences.text: If Tom can't tell me, then no one can.
sentences.translationZh: 如果湯姆不能告訴我，就沒人能了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果湯姆不能告訴我，就沒人能了。

sentences.text: It is stupid of you to believe in him.
sentences.translationZh: 你相信他真是太愚蠢了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你相信他真是太愚蠢了。

sentences.text: It is two miles from here to the park.
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡到公園距離兩英里。
sentences.translationOriginal: 從這裡到公園距離兩英里。

sentences.text: It is very hot in the summer in Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 日本的夏天很熱。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本的夏天很热。

sentences.text: It looks like Tom has a crush on Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 看來湯姆熱戀著瑪麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看来汤姆热恋着玛丽。

sentences.text: My wife is afraid to drive my new car.
sentences.translationZh: 我的妻子害怕開我的新車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的妻子害怕开我的新车。

sentences.text: Next time it will be my turn to drive.
sentences.translationZh: 下次該輪到我開車了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 下次该轮到我开车了。

sentences.text: She came here as soon as she heard it.
sentences.translationZh: 她一來這裡就聽到了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一來這裡就聽到了。

sentences.text: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
sentences.translationZh: 她把她的CD在書架上排成一排。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她把她的CD在書架上排成一排。

sentences.text: The baby seemed to be in a deep sleep.
sentences.translationZh: 那個嬰兒似乎在熟睡中。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那個嬰兒似乎在熟睡中。

sentences.text: The boy went to bed with his socks on.
sentences.translationZh: 男孩穿著襪子就上床睡覺了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 男孩穿着袜子就上床睡觉了。

sentences.text: There are a lot of people in the park.
sentences.translationZh: 公園裡有很多人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 公园里有很多人。

sentences.text: There was a big gold star on the door.
sentences.translationZh: 在門上有一個大大的金色星星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在門上有一個大大的金色星星。

sentences.text: This is the lady who wants to see you.
sentences.translationZh: 這位就是誰想見你的夫人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這位就是誰想見你的夫人。

sentences.text: Tom asked Mary to buy a gift for John.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆叫瑪麗買一份禮物給約翰。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆叫玛丽买一份礼物给约翰。

sentences.text: Tom never did what we asked him to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我們叫湯姆做什麼，他從來不做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们叫汤姆做什么，他从来不做。

sentences.text: Tom paid me back the money he owed me.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把欠我的錢還給我了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把欠我的钱还给我了。

sentences.text: We have to do a great deal of reading.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要讀很多書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们要读很多书。

sentences.text: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
sentences.translationZh: 在人群中，我們失去了那個男人的蹤影。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在人群中，我们失去了那个男人的踪影。

sentences.text: We waited in the park for a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在公園等了好久。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们在公园等了好久。

sentences.text: Where can I go to get a map of Europe?
sentences.translationZh: 去哪裡可以買到歐洲的地圖？
sentences.translationOriginal: 去哪里可以买到欧洲的地图？

sentences.text: Why do you let Tom treat you that way?
sentences.translationZh: 你為甚麼讓湯姆那麼對待你？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你為甚麼讓湯姆那麼對待你？

sentences.text: Would you like to know how I did that?
sentences.translationZh: 你想知道我怎麼做到的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想知道我怎么做到的吗？

sentences.text: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
sentences.translationZh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

sentences.text: You do your part and I'll do the rest.
sentences.translationZh: 你做你的部份, 其他的我來做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你做你的部份, 其他的我來做。

sentences.text: You remind me of a boy I used to know.
sentences.translationZh: 你讓我想起我過去認識的一個男孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。

sentences.text: All I really want to do is talk to Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我真正想做的就是跟湯姆說話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我真正想做的就是跟湯姆說話。

sentences.text: All you need to do is trust each other.
sentences.translationZh: 除了相信對方以外，你們沒什麼要做的了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了相信对方以外，你们没什么要做的了。

sentences.text: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
sentences.translationZh: 以眼還眼，以牙還牙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 以眼還眼，以牙還牙。

sentences.text: Are you sure that you want to go there?
sentences.translationZh: 你確定你要去那兒嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你确定你要去那儿吗？

sentences.text: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，他沒做錯任何事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。

sentences.text: As far as I know, she is still missing.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，她仍然失蹤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据我所知，她仍然失踪。

sentences.text: Can you put up with the way he behaves?
sentences.translationZh: 你能容忍他做事的方式麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？

sentences.text: Do you think he did the job on his own?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為他是自己獨立完成這份工的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你认为他是自己独立完成这份工的吗？

sentences.text: Excuse me, do you know what time it is?
sentences.translationZh: 不好意思，請問您知道現在幾點了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 不好意思，请问您知道现在几点了吗？

sentences.text: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
sentences.translationZh: 得寸進尺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 得寸进尺。

sentences.text: He did all he could to protect his son.
sentences.translationZh: 他做了一切能做的去保護他的兒子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他做了一切能做的去保護他的兒子。

sentences.text: He got wet from the waist to the knees.
sentences.translationZh: 他從腰部到膝蓋都濕了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他從腰部到膝蓋都濕了。

sentences.text: He had his head in the clouds in class.
sentences.translationZh: 他在課堂上心不在焉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在課堂上心不在焉。

sentences.text: He is older than she is by three years.
sentences.translationZh: 他比她大三歲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他比她大三岁。

sentences.text: He promised me he would be here at six.
sentences.translationZh: 他答應我六點鐘的時候他會在這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他答應我六點鐘的時候他會在這裡。

sentences.text: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
sentences.translationZh: 他叫自己的妻子不要衝動購物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他叫自己的妻子不要衝動購物。

sentences.text: He was hit by a car and died instantly.
sentences.translationZh: 他被車撞了之後便過世了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他被車撞了之後便過世了。

sentences.text: He was made a fool of by his neighbors.
sentences.translationZh: 他被他的鄰居們愚弄了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他被他的邻居们愚弄了。

sentences.text: He will be a good husband to my sister.
sentences.translationZh: 他會是我妹妹的好丈夫的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他会是我妹妹的好丈夫的。

sentences.text: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
sentences.translationZh: 她家在一座山的山腳下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她家在一座山的山脚下。

sentences.text: His death was a great loss to our firm.
sentences.translationZh: 他的死對我們公司是一個巨大的損失。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。

sentences.text: How long are you going to be in Boston?
sentences.translationZh: 你要在波士頓留多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你要在波士顿留多久？

sentences.text: How much will it cost you to go by air?
sentences.translationZh: 坐飛機將花你多少錢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 坐飛機將花你多少錢？

sentences.text: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
sentences.translationZh: 我請這個男孩把球扔回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我請這個男孩把球扔回來。

sentences.text: I don't have a car, but my sister does.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒有車，但我姐妹有。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没有车，但我姐妹有。

sentences.text: I don't know what I'm going to do next.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道下一步做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道下一步做什么。

sentences.text: I don't think I can help you very much.
sentences.translationZh: 我不認為我能幫你很多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不認為我能幫你很多。

sentences.text: I don't think that this is a good idea.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得這主意不行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得这主意不行。

sentences.text: I have a certain amount of money on me.
sentences.translationZh: 我有些錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有些钱。

sentences.text: I have a lot of problems at the moment.
sentences.translationZh: 目前我問題很多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 目前我问题很多。

sentences.text: I like grapes, but I can't eat so many.
sentences.translationZh: 我雖然喜歡吃葡萄，但是我吃不了那麼多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我虽然喜欢吃葡萄，但是我吃不了那么多。

sentences.text: I ran into my aunt by chance in Europe.
sentences.translationZh: 我在歐洲偶遇了姑母。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在欧洲偶遇了姑母。

sentences.text: I think I'll be able to deal with that.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我能做好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我能做好。

sentences.text: I want to spend the whole day with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我想跟你度過一整天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想跟你度過一整天。

sentences.text: I wish I hadn't said that at the party.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我在聚會上沒說過那話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我在聚會上沒說過那話。

sentences.text: I wish that Tom would agree to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望湯姆能同意。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望湯姆能同意。

sentences.text: I'd buy a new house if I had the money.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我有錢，我會買一個新房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我有錢，我會買一個新房子。

sentences.text: I'd like to be alone if you don't mind.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不介意的話，我想一個人待著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不介意的话，我想一个人呆着。

sentences.text: I'll stop by your place on my way home.
sentences.translationZh: 我回家路上會在你那裡停下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我回家路上会在你那里停下。

sentences.text: I'm going to get rid of all this stuff.
sentences.translationZh: 我要擺脫這一切。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要摆脱这一切。

sentences.text: I'm on my way to the meeting right now.
sentences.translationZh: 我在前往會議的路上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在前往会议的路上。

sentences.text: Is there a discount if you pay in cash?
sentences.translationZh: 用現金付的話會有折扣嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 用現金付的話會有折扣嗎?

sentences.text: It looks like today will be a long day.
sentences.translationZh: 看來今天會是漫長的一天啊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看来今天会是漫长的一天啊。

sentences.text: It was lucky for you that you found it.
sentences.translationZh: 你很幸運找到了它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你很幸運找到了它。

sentences.text: It was one of the best nights I've had.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我度過的最好的夜晚之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我度过的最好的夜晚之一。

sentences.text: My brother and I are in the same class.
sentences.translationZh: 我的兄弟和我在一個班級。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的兄弟和我在一个班级。

sentences.text: She got all dolled up for her big date.
sentences.translationZh: 為了她的重要約會，她精心打扮了一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 为了她的重要约会，她精心打扮了一下。

sentences.text: She was asked to write her name in ink.
sentences.translationZh: 她被要求用墨水寫下她的名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她被要求用墨水写下她的名字。

sentences.text: The man sitting next to me spoke to me.
sentences.translationZh: 坐在我旁邊的男人跟我說話了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 坐在我旁边的男人跟我说话了。

sentences.text: The taxi I took was very old and small.
sentences.translationZh: 我打的這輛出租車很老，也很小。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我打的这辆出租车很老，也很小。

sentences.text: There are a few shops next to my house.
sentences.translationZh: 我家旁邊有幾家商店。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我家旁边有几家商店。

sentences.text: There is a photo of Tom on Mary's desk.
sentences.translationZh: 在瑪麗的桌上有張湯姆的照片。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在瑪麗的桌上有張湯姆的照片。

sentences.text: There were a lot of people in the park.
sentences.translationZh: 公園裡有很多人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 公园里有很多人。

sentences.text: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.
sentences.translationZh: 這咖啡熱得我沒辦法喝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这咖啡热得我没办法喝。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary have a daughter and a son.
sentences.translationZh: Tom和Mary有個女兒和兒子。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom和Mary有個女兒和兒子。

sentences.text: Tom begged me to let him go home early.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆求我讓他早點回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆求我让他早点回家。

sentences.text: Tom hasn't taken a bath in a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆很長時間沒洗澡了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆很长时间没洗澡了。

sentences.text: Tom is afraid to go out alone at night.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆害怕晚上一個人出門兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆害怕晚上一个人出门儿。

sentences.text: Tom is no longer a member of this club.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不再是俱樂部的成員了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不再是俱乐部的成员了。

sentences.text: We have a lot of rain in June and July.
sentences.translationZh: 六七月份雨很多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 六七月份雨很多。

sentences.text: We would like you to come to our party.
sentences.translationZh: 我們希望你來我們的聚會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们希望你来我们的聚会。

sentences.text: When I heard the news, I wanted to cry.
sentences.translationZh: 當我聽到這個消息時，我想哭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我听到这个消息时，我想哭。

sentences.text: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
sentences.translationZh: 當他感到舒服時，他去散步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当他感到舒服时，他去散步。

sentences.text: Who told you that Tom and I are dating?
sentences.translationZh: 誰告訴你我和湯姆在交往的？
sentences.translationOriginal: 谁告诉你我和汤姆在交往的？

sentences.text: You can go to the ballpark on this bus.
sentences.translationZh: 坐這個公車可以到球場。
sentences.translationOriginal: 坐這個公車可以到球場。

sentences.text: You need to put more water in the vase.
sentences.translationZh: 你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。

sentences.text: You seem to ask Tom a lot of questions.
sentences.translationZh: 你看來問了湯姆很多問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看來問了湯姆很多問題。

sentences.text: You won't be happy no matter what I do.
sentences.translationZh: 無論我做什麼，你都不高興。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论我做什么，你都不高兴。

sentences.text: You work as hard as he did at your age.
sentences.translationZh: 你跟他在你這個年紀時一樣努力工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你跟他在你這個年紀時一樣努力工作。

sentences.text: A lot of people swim here in the summer.
sentences.translationZh: 許多人夏天在這裡游泳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。

sentences.text: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
sentences.translationZh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。
sentences.translationOriginal: 兔子有长耳朵和短尾巴。

sentences.text: Are you aware of how much she loves you?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道她有多麼愛你嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道她有多麼愛你嗎?

sentences.text: Could you tell me where I can get a bus?
sentences.translationZh: 你能告訴我能在哪裡上公交車嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能告诉我能在哪里上公交车吗？

sentences.text: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
sentences.translationZh: 當你在陽光下的時候，遮住你的頭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你在陽光下的時候，遮住你的頭。

sentences.text: Do you have any idea where Tom could be?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道湯姆能在哪裡嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道湯姆能在哪裡嗎？

sentences.text: Do you know where Tom is waiting for us?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道湯姆在哪裡等我們嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道汤姆在哪里等我们吗？

sentences.text: Do you plan to eat all of that yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？

sentences.text: Does it matter to you how much it costs?
sentences.translationZh: 它花多少錢對你很重要嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 它花多少钱对你很重要吗？

sentences.text: He fell in love with her at first sight.
sentences.translationZh: 他對她一見鍾情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他對她一見鍾情。

sentences.text: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
sentences.translationZh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了幾顆牙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。

sentences.text: He is not as smart as his older brother.
sentences.translationZh: 他不像他的兄長那樣聰明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

sentences.text: He thought that it was like a bird cage.
sentences.translationZh: 他認為這像個鳥籠。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他认为这像个鸟笼。

sentences.text: He was happy at the news of her success.
sentences.translationZh: 聽到她成功的消息，他很高興。
sentences.translationOriginal: 听到她成功的消息，他很高兴。

sentences.text: He wrote this book at the age of twenty.
sentences.translationZh: 他在20歲的時候寫了這本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在20岁的时候写了这本书。

sentences.text: How long are you going to stay in Japan?
sentences.translationZh: 你會在日本多久?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你會在日本多久?

sentences.text: How much do you want in terms of salary?
sentences.translationZh: 您想要多少工資？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您想要多少工资？

sentences.text: I am happy to have so many good friends.
sentences.translationZh: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

sentences.text: I can read German, but I can't speak it.
sentences.translationZh: 我能看德語，但是不能說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我能看德语，但是不能说。

sentences.text: I can't bring myself to do such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我不能讓自己做這樣的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不能让自己做这样的事。

sentences.text: I can't put up with the heat any longer.
sentences.translationZh: 我受不了這大熱天了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我受不了这大热天了。

sentences.text: I can't tell you how much I'll miss Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我不會告訴你我有多想念湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不会告诉你我有多想念汤姆。

sentences.text: I could not keep the tears from my eyes.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒法忍住我的眼淚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没法忍住我的眼泪。

sentences.text: I didn't know you were going to be here.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道你要來這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道你要來這裡。

sentences.text: I do not know whether it is good or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道它是好是壞。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道它是好是坏。

sentences.text: I don't know if I'll have time to do it.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道我是否有時間做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道我是否有时间做。

sentences.text: I don't know if she wants to go with me.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道她想不想和我一起去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道她想不想和我一起去。

sentences.text: I don't know whether I have time or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道我有沒有時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道我有沒有時間。

sentences.text: I feel like my head is going to explode.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覚我的頭要炸了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感覚我的頭要炸了。

sentences.text: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
sentences.translationZh: 除了接受報價，我別無選擇。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了接受报价，我别无选择。

sentences.text: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
sentences.translationZh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超級痛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

sentences.text: I looked after him for a period of time.
sentences.translationZh: 我看了他一段時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我看了他一段时间。

sentences.text: I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?
sentences.translationZh: 我需要一支鉛筆，我能用你的其中一支嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要一支铅笔，我能用你的其中一支吗？

sentences.text: I swear that I'll never do such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我發誓我不會做這種事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我发誓我不会做这种事。

sentences.text: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
sentences.translationZh: 我打心底裡感激你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我打心底里感激你。

sentences.text: I think it's time for me to buy a house.
sentences.translationZh: 我想我該是時候買間房子了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想我該是時候買間房子了。

sentences.text: I think that Tom is a bit too impatient.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆有些過於性急了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆有些过于性急了。

sentences.text: I used to play alone when I was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 我小時候常常獨自玩耍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。

sentences.text: I waited for her for a really long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我真的等了她很長一段時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我真的等了她很長一段時間。

sentences.text: I walk my dog in the park every morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我每天早上到公園裡遛狗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我每天早上到公园里遛狗。

sentences.text: I want to buy a few pairs of sunglasses.
sentences.translationZh: 我想買幾副墨鏡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想買幾副墨鏡。

sentences.text: I want you to not go to Boston with Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我要你別和湯姆去波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要你別和湯姆去波士頓。

sentences.text: I was at home most of the day yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我昨天大部分時間在家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我昨天大部分时间在家。

sentences.text: I was told that I don't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 有人告訴我我不用做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有人告訴我我不用做。

sentences.text: I will get you a bike for your birthday.
sentences.translationZh: 你生日的時候，我送你一輛自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

sentences.text: I wish I could go to the party with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我能和你一起參加派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我能和你一起参加派对。

sentences.text: I would rather stay at home than go out.
sentences.translationZh: 比起出門，我更喜歡待在家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 比起出门，我更喜欢待在家。

sentences.text: I'll come and see you one of these days.
sentences.translationZh: 這些天我會抽一天來看你的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。

sentences.text: I'm at work now, so I'll call you later.
sentences.translationZh: 我現在在上班，所以晚點打給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我现在在上班，所以晚点打给你。

sentences.text: I'm very sorry that I came home so late.
sentences.translationZh: 我很抱歉那麼晚回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很抱歉那么晚回家。

sentences.text: I've been told Tom is going to be fired.
sentences.translationZh: 有人告訴過我湯姆要被開除。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有人告訴過我湯姆要被開除。

sentences.text: If I had the money, I'd buy a new house.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我有錢，我會買一個新房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我有錢，我會買一個新房子。

sentences.text: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我中了彩票，我會買輛新車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我中了彩票，我会买辆新车。

sentences.text: If you want a pencil, I'll lend you one.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你需要鉛筆，我借你一支。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你需要铅笔，我借你一支。

sentences.text: Is it true that Tom can't read or write?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆真的不會讀也不會寫嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆真的不会读也不会写吗？

sentences.text: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
sentences.translationZh: 對猴子來說，爬樹很容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。

sentences.text: It is imperative for you to act at once.
sentences.translationZh: 你必須馬上行動。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必须马上行动。

sentences.text: It is rude of him not to give me a call.
sentences.translationZh: 他不打電話給我真是無禮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不打电话给我真是无礼。

sentences.text: May I ask you for your name and address?
sentences.translationZh: 我能問一下您的姓名和住址嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？

sentences.text: No one lived on the island at that time.
sentences.translationZh: 那個時候，沒有人在這個島上生活。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个时候，没有人在这个岛上生活。

sentences.text: Now is a great time to buy one of those.
sentences.translationZh: 現在是買它的最好時機。
sentences.translationOriginal: 现在是买它的最好时机。

sentences.text: Our school is in the center of the town.
sentences.translationZh: 我們學校在市中心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们学校在市中心。

sentences.text: She had my mother take care of the baby.
sentences.translationZh: 她讓我母親照顧孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她让我母亲照顾孩子。

sentences.text: She seems to be in love with my brother.
sentences.translationZh: 她似乎喜歡上了我哥哥。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她似乎喜歡上了我哥哥。

sentences.text: She used to go to the movies on Sundays.
sentences.translationZh: 她從前會在星期天去看電影。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她從前會在星期天去看電影。

sentences.text: She was too short to see over the fence.
sentences.translationZh: 她太矮了，看不到圍牆外面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她太矮了，看不到围墙外面。

sentences.text: Since I was sick, I didn't go to school.
sentences.translationZh: 由於我生病了，我便沒去上學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。

sentences.text: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
sentences.translationZh: 那個男人在一週前死於肺癌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。

sentences.text: The boy grew up to be a great statesman.
sentences.translationZh: 這個孩子長大後成為了一個偉大的政治家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个孩子长大后成为了一个伟大的政治家。

sentences.text: The church is at the foot of a mountain.
sentences.translationZh: 教堂位於山腳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 教堂位于山脚。

sentences.text: The offer is too good to be turned down.
sentences.translationZh: 此提議好得令人難以拒絕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 此提議好得令人難以拒絕。

sentences.text: There are a lot of books in the library.
sentences.translationZh: 圖書館裡有很多書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 圖書館裡有很多書。

sentences.text: There are a lot of hot springs in Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 日本有很多溫泉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本有很多温泉。

sentences.text: There is a bank in front of the station.
sentences.translationZh: 車站前有個銀行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 车站前有个银行。

sentences.text: They live on the other side of the road.
sentences.translationZh: 他們住在路對面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們住在路對面。

sentences.text: This is only one of the things we found.
sentences.translationZh: 這只是我們發現的東西之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这只是我们发现的东西之一。

sentences.text: Tom came to see if Mary needed any help.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆過來看看瑪麗有沒有什麼需要幫忙的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆过来看看玛丽有没有什么需要帮忙的。

sentences.text: Tom didn't give me what I asked him for.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒給我我跟他要的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没给我我跟他要的。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆甚至連怎麼煎雞蛋都不知道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。

sentences.text: Tom had a lot of problems at the school.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在學校遇到了很多問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在学校遇到了很多问题。

sentences.text: Tom has lived in Boston for over a year.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆住在波士頓已經一年多了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆住在波士顿已经一年多了。

sentences.text: Tom is a good friend of yours, isn't he?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是你的好朋友，不是麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆是你的好朋友，不是麼？

sentences.text: Tom is busy now and can't talk with you.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆現在忙，不能跟你講話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆現在忙，不能跟你講話。

sentences.text: Tom knows that I used to live in Boston.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆知道我在波士頓住過。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆知道我在波士頓住過。

sentences.text: Tom lost his only son in a car accident.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在一場車禍中失去了他的獨子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在一场车祸中失去了他的独子。

sentences.text: Tom said he read a book about this ship.
sentences.translationZh: Tom說他在這次的航行中讀了一本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom说他在这次的航行中读了一本书。

sentences.text: Tom told me to take good care of myself.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我要照顧好我自己。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我要照顾好我自己。

sentences.text: Tom wants to pay back the money he owes.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想去還欠的錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想去还欠的钱。

sentences.text: Tom went over and sat down next to Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆來了，坐到了瑪麗的邊上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆来了，坐到了玛丽的边上。

sentences.text: We are not short of oil in this country.
sentences.translationZh: 我們國家不缺石油。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们国家不缺石油。

sentences.text: We can't see the other side of the moon.
sentences.translationZh: 我們看不到月亮的另一邊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們看不到月亮的另一邊。

sentences.text: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
sentences.translationZh: 我們往車裡裝了很多行李。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們往車裡装了很多行李。

sentences.text: We lost our cat and Tom found it for us.
sentences.translationZh: 我們弄丟了車，Tom幫我們找了回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們弄丟了車，Tom幫我們找了回來。

sentences.text: We met in a coffee shop near the campus.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在校園附近的咖啡廳碰面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們在校園附近的咖啡廳碰面。

sentences.text: What do you plan to major in at college?
sentences.translationZh: 你計劃去大學後主修什麼嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？

sentences.text: What do you want to be when you grow up?
sentences.translationZh: 你長大後想成為什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你长大后想成为什么？

sentences.text: What kind of movie do you want to watch?
sentences.translationZh: 你想看哪種類型的電影？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想看哪种类型的电影？

sentences.text: What time did you get to bed last night?
sentences.translationZh: 你昨天甚麼時候睡覺？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你昨天甚麼時候睡覺？

sentences.text: What would you like to be in the future?
sentences.translationZh: 你以後想當什麼呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你以后想当什么呢？

sentences.text: What would you like to do in the future?
sentences.translationZh: 以後打算幹什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 以后打算干什么？

sentences.text: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
sentences.translationZh: 當我在你這個年紀時，冥王星是行星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當我在你這個年紀時，冥王星是行星。

sentences.text: Why don't you want to tell us the truth?
sentences.translationZh: 為甚麼你不想告訴我們真相？
sentences.translationOriginal: 為甚麼你不想告訴我們真相？

sentences.text: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
sentences.translationZh: 您願意聽我說幾分鐘話嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您愿意听我说几分钟话吗？

sentences.text: Will you tell me how to get to Shinjuku?
sentences.translationZh: 請問你可以告訴我如何可以到達新宿嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 请问你可以告诉我如何可以到达新宿吗？

sentences.text: You can buy it for a thousand yen or so.
sentences.translationZh: 你能以大約1000日元買下它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能以大约1000日元买下它。

sentences.text: You should have told me a long time ago.
sentences.translationZh: 很久以前你就應該告訴我的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很久以前你就應該告訴我的。

sentences.text: You will not be able to catch the train.
sentences.translationZh: 你將無法趕上火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你將無法趕上火車。

sentences.text: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?
sentences.translationZh: 我能跟你私下談一分鐘嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？

sentences.text: Can you tell me where the flea market is?
sentences.translationZh: 你能告訴我跳蚤市場在哪裡嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能告訴我跳蚤市場在哪裡嗎？

sentences.text: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
sentences.translationZh: 您能教我彈鋼琴嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您能教我弹钢琴吗？

sentences.text: Did you eat at home before you came here?
sentences.translationZh: 你來之前在家裡吃飯了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你來之前在家裡吃飯了嗎？

sentences.text: Did you plan to eat all of that yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？

sentences.text: Do I have to answer all of the questions?
sentences.translationZh: 我需要回答所有問題嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要回答所有問題嗎？

sentences.text: Do I have to bring my son to your office?
sentences.translationZh: 我必須帶我的兒子到你的辦公室嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我必須帶我的兒子到你的辦公室嗎？

sentences.text: Do you know which road leads to my house?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道哪一條路到我家嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道哪一條路到我家嗎?

sentences.text: Do you really think that I look like Tom?
sentences.translationZh: 你真的覺得我長得像湯姆嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真的觉得我长得像汤姆吗？

sentences.text: Do you think he is good for the position?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為他適合這個職位嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你认为他适合这个职位吗？

sentences.text: Do you want to go to the station with me?
sentences.translationZh: 要不一起到車站去？
sentences.translationOriginal: 要不一起到车站去？

sentences.text: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
sentences.translationZh: 凡人皆有得意時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 凡人皆有得意时。

sentences.text: Everyone knew Tom was the one who did it.
sentences.translationZh: 大家都知道是湯姆做的
sentences.translationOriginal: 大家都知道是汤姆做的

sentences.text: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
sentences.translationZh: 給我機會來讓你為我感到自豪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。

sentences.text: Have you ever seen the man in this photo?
sentences.translationZh: 你見過這張照片上的男人嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你见过这张照片上的男人吗？

sentences.text: He froze with fear when he saw the snake.
sentences.translationZh: 他看見蛇就嚇得不動了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他看見蛇就嚇得不動了。

sentences.text: He often sits by me and listens to music.
sentences.translationZh: 他經常坐在我旁邊聽音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他经常坐在我旁边听音乐。

sentences.text: He plays golf two or three times a month.
sentences.translationZh: 他一個月玩兩到三次高爾夫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一个月玩两到三次高尔夫。

sentences.text: He rushed into the room with his coat on.
sentences.translationZh: 他穿著衣服衝進房間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。

sentences.text: He was kind enough to lend me some money.
sentences.translationZh: 他夠大方，借了我一點錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。

sentences.text: He went to Italy in order to study music.
sentences.translationZh: 為了研讀音樂他去了義大利。
sentences.translationOriginal: 為了研讀音樂他去了義大利。

sentences.text: His office is past the bank on your left.
sentences.translationZh: 經過銀行，左邊就是他的辦公室了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 经过银行，左边就是他的办公室了。

sentences.text: I agree with what you say to some extent.
sentences.translationZh: 在某種程度上，我認同你所說的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。

sentences.text: I always rely on him in times of trouble.
sentences.translationZh: 我在困難時總是依賴他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在困難時總是依賴他。

sentences.text: I always take a bath before going to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 我睡覺前總要洗個澡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我睡觉前总要洗个澡。

sentences.text: I am going to my room, where I can study.
sentences.translationZh: 我要回房間了，在那兒我可以學習。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要回房间了，在那儿我可以学习。

sentences.text: I am looking for a present for my mother.
sentences.translationZh: 我正在為我的媽媽尋找禮物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我正在为我的妈妈寻找礼物。

sentences.text: I can speak Chinese, but I can't read it.
sentences.translationZh: 我會說中文，但是我不會讀中文。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我會說中文，但是我不會讀中文。

sentences.text: I cannot bring myself to do such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我不能讓自己做這樣的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不能让自己做这样的事。

sentences.text: I didn't go to school because I was sick.
sentences.translationZh: 由於我生病了，我便沒去上學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。

sentences.text: I didn't tell Tom what needed to be done.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒告訴湯姆要做甚麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我沒告訴湯姆要做甚麼。

sentences.text: I don't feel very well. I should go home.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覺不太好，我該回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感覺不太好，我該回家。

sentences.text: I don't have time to play games with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒時間跟你玩遊戲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没时间跟你玩游戏。

sentences.text: I don't think I like this game very much.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得我不太喜歡這遊戲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得我不太喜欢这游戏。

sentences.text: I don't think that we should go with Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們不應該跟湯姆一起走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我们不应该跟汤姆一起走。

sentences.text: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。

sentences.text: I feel like this isn't going to end well.
sentences.translationZh: 感覺這不會有個好結局。
sentences.translationOriginal: 感觉这不会有个好结局。

sentences.text: I finished the work in less than an hour.
sentences.translationZh: 我用不到一小時就完成了這個工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我用不到一小时就完成了这个工作。

sentences.text: I have a lot of friends living in Boston.
sentences.translationZh: 我有很多朋友住在波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有很多朋友住在波士顿。

sentences.text: I know New York like the back of my hand.
sentences.translationZh: 我對紐約瞭如指掌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我对纽约了如指掌。

sentences.text: I know someone who might be able to help.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道有個人可能能幫忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道有個人可能能幫忙。

sentences.text: I know that you still want to be with me.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道你還是想跟著我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道你还是想跟着我。

sentences.text: I know the real reason you don't want go.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道你不想去的真實原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。

sentences.text: I made a bet that she would win the game.
sentences.translationZh: 我賭她贏這比賽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我賭她贏這比賽。

sentences.text: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
sentences.translationZh: 我在銀行附近碰見老朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在银行附近碰见老朋友。

sentences.text: I think you're going to want to sit down.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得你想坐下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得你想坐下。

sentences.text: I took off my hat and entered the church.
sentences.translationZh: 我摘下帽子進了教堂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我摘下帽子进了教堂。

sentences.text: I used to smoke a lot, but now I've quit.
sentences.translationZh: 我以前常抽菸，但現在我戒掉了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以前常抽菸，但現在我戒掉了。

sentences.text: I want you to stay here until I get back.
sentences.translationZh: 我想你待在這裡直到我回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想你待在这里直到我回来。

sentences.text: I was a high school student at that time.
sentences.translationZh: 我當時是高中生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我当时是高中生。

sentences.text: I was just about to come looking for you.
sentences.translationZh: 我剛才正要找你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我剛才正要找你。

sentences.text: I was tired today so I went to bed early.
sentences.translationZh: 我今天累，所以我睡得早。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今天累，所以我睡得早。

sentences.text: I was unable to go to his birthday party.
sentences.translationZh: 我那時沒法去他的生日派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我那时没法去他的生日派对。

sentences.text: I was very nervous as the plane took off.
sentences.translationZh: 飛機起飛的時候我很緊張。
sentences.translationOriginal: 飛機起飛的時候我很緊張。

sentences.text: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你離開日本，我會非常想你的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。

sentences.text: I will give you a bike for your birthday.
sentences.translationZh: 你生日的時候，我送你一輛自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

sentences.text: I worked as a piano tuner for many years.
sentences.translationZh: 我做鋼琴調音師很多年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我做钢琴调音师很多年了。

sentences.text: I'd like to ask you a few more questions.
sentences.translationZh: 我想問再你幾個問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想問再你幾個問題。

sentences.text: I'd really like to go to Boston with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想跟你去波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想跟你去波士頓。

sentences.text: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.
sentences.translationZh: 如果有人把事情抖出來，我就麻煩了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果有人把事情抖出来，我就麻烦了。

sentences.text: I'll wait for you in front of the school.
sentences.translationZh: 我在學校前面等你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在學校前面等你。

sentences.text: I'm sure that this is a fresh water fish.
sentences.translationZh: 我肯定這是淡水魚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我肯定这是淡水鱼。

sentences.text: I'm very tired, but I can't get to sleep.
sentences.translationZh: 我很累，但我還是沒辦法入睡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很累，但我还是没办法入睡。

sentences.text: I've put all of my energy into this plan.
sentences.translationZh: 我在這項計劃上投入了所有精力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。

sentences.text: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你快一點，還能趕上他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你快一点，还能赶上他。

sentences.text: Is it true or did Tom make that story up?
sentences.translationZh: 這是事實還是Tom編的故事？
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是事實還是Tom編的故事？

sentences.text: Is there anything else you want me to do?
sentences.translationZh: 你還有什麼事情需要我去做的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你还有什么事情需要我去做的吗？

sentences.text: It is an hour's drive from here to there.
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡到那裡駕車一小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 从这里到那里驾车一小时。

sentences.text: It is evident that he has made a mistake.
sentences.translationZh: 很明顯的是他犯了錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很明顯的是他犯了錯。

sentences.text: It is your business to take care of them.
sentences.translationZh: 照顧他們是你自己的事兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 照顾他们是你自己的事儿。

sentences.text: It took me three hours to do my homework.
sentences.translationZh: 我花了3小時做作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我花了3小时做作业。

sentences.text: It wasn't me who told you not to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 不是我告訴你不要去做的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不是我告訴你不要去做的。

sentences.text: My friend invited me to go out to dinner.
sentences.translationZh: 我的朋友邀請我去吃晚餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的朋友邀請我去吃晚餐。

sentences.text: My parents won't let me go out with boys.
sentences.translationZh: 我父母不讓我和男生約會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父母不让我和男生约会。

sentences.text: My room is three times as large as yours.
sentences.translationZh: 我的房間是你的三倍大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的房間是你的三倍大。

sentences.text: Our eyes take time to adjust to the dark.
sentences.translationZh: 我們的眼睛需要時間來適應黑暗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

sentences.text: Please come back home as soon as you can.
sentences.translationZh: 請儘快回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请尽快回家。

sentences.text: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
sentences.translationZh: 請於五點鐘到機場接我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 請於五點鐘到機場接我。

sentences.text: She is always at the bottom of the class.
sentences.translationZh: 她總是在班上拿倒數第一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。

sentences.text: Sorry it took me so long to write to you.
sentences.translationZh: 對不起, 我過了這麼長的時間才回你的信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 對不起, 我過了這麼長的時間才回你的信。

sentences.text: That house is the place where I was born.
sentences.translationZh: 那房子是我出生的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那房子是我出生的地方。

sentences.text: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
sentences.translationZh: 老闆對你的工作有很高的評價。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。

sentences.text: The library is in the center of the city.
sentences.translationZh: 圖書館位於城市中心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 图书馆位于城市中心。

sentences.text: The library is in the middle of the city.
sentences.translationZh: 圖書館位於市中央。
sentences.translationOriginal: 图书馆位于市中央。

sentences.text: The truth can be more painful than a lie.
sentences.translationZh: 真相可能比謊言更令人痛苦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真相可能比谎言更令人痛苦。

sentences.text: There is no knowing what he will do next.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有人知道他接下來會幹什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没有人知道他接下来会干什么。

sentences.text: This is a good book for children to read.
sentences.translationZh: 這是本對兒童好的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是本对儿童好的书。

sentences.text: This is a post office and that is a bank.
sentences.translationZh: 這是郵局，那是銀行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是邮局，那是银行。

sentences.text: This is the house where she used to live.
sentences.translationZh: 這是她曾經住過的房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是她曾经住过的房子。

sentences.text: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我看過的最差勁的電影了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我看过的最差劲的电影了。

sentences.text: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
sentences.translationZh: 這條隧道是那條的兩倍長。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這條隧道是那條的兩倍長。

sentences.text: Tom blew out all the candles on the cake.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆吹滅了蛋糕上的所有蠟燭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆吹灭了蛋糕上的所有蜡烛。

sentences.text: Tom broke some bones in his arm and hand.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆的手臂和手斷了些骨頭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆的手臂和手斷了些骨頭。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't know if Mary is happy or not.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗是高興呢，還是不高興。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽是高兴呢，还是不高兴。

sentences.text: Tom had no idea Mary was a serial killer.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗是個連環殺手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

sentences.text: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在胸上有個頭骨文身。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆在胸上有個頭骨文身。

sentences.text: Tom has been sick in bed for three weeks.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆已經因病臥床三週了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆已经因病卧床三周了。

sentences.text: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆拿起罐子讀標籤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆拿起罐子读标签。

sentences.text: Tom said that he keeps a gun in his home.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他的家裡有把槍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他的家裡有把槍。

sentences.text: Tom took out his key and opened the door.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆掏出鑰匙開了門。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆掏出钥匙开了门。

sentences.text: Tom was the only boy in the entire class.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是班裡唯一的男生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆是班里唯一的男生。

sentences.text: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
sentences.translationZh: 我們黎明時起床以避開交通堵塞。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。

sentences.text: We have one of your friends here with us.
sentences.translationZh: 你的一個朋友在我們這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你的一个朋友在我们这里。

sentences.text: We have your size, but not in that color.
sentences.translationZh: 我們有你的尺寸，但是沒有那個顏色。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。

sentences.text: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
sentences.translationZh: 我們每天至少該睡八小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。

sentences.text: We need to find Tom as quickly as we can.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要盡快找到湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們要盡快找到湯姆。

sentences.text: What do you like to do in your free time?
sentences.translationZh: 您空閒時間喜歡做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您空闲时间喜欢做什么？

sentences.text: What do you usually do in your free time?
sentences.translationZh: 你在閒暇的時候一般做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在閒暇的時候一般做什麼？

sentences.text: What is that big building in front of us?
sentences.translationZh: 我們面前的這幢高樓是什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们面前的这幢高楼是什么？

sentences.text: When I opened the door, I broke the lock.
sentences.translationZh: 我開門的時候弄壞了鎖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我开门的时候弄坏了锁。

sentences.text: When the cat is away, the mice will play.
sentences.translationZh: 貓兒不在，老鼠玩的輕鬆自在。
sentences.translationOriginal: 貓兒不在，老鼠玩的輕鬆自在。

sentences.text: When the phone rang, he ran to answer it.
sentences.translationZh: 電話響起時，他跑去接起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 電話響起時，他跑去接起。

sentences.text: Who do you usually go to the movies with?
sentences.translationZh: 你一般和誰去看電影？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你一般和誰去看電影？

sentences.text: Will you have time to have lunch with me?
sentences.translationZh: 你有時間跟我吃午飯嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有时间跟我吃午饭吗？

sentences.text: You could count to ten when you were two.
sentences.translationZh: 在你兩歲時, 你可以數到十。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在你兩歲時, 你可以數到十。

sentences.text: You don't go to school on Sunday, do you?
sentences.translationZh: 你週日不上學, 對嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你週日不上學, 對嗎?

sentences.text: You don't have to go to school on Sunday.
sentences.translationZh: 你沒必要週日去上學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你没必要周日去上学。

sentences.text: You must be tired after such a long trip.
sentences.translationZh: 在這麼長程的旅途後你一定很累了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在這麼長程的旅途後你一定很累了。

sentences.text: You must go outside if you want to smoke.
sentences.translationZh: 如果您想抽菸的話，您必須出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果您想抽烟的话，您必须出去。

sentences.text: Do you think he will come? "I hope not."
sentences.translationZh: 你認為他會來嗎? "我希望不會。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 你認為他會來嗎? "我希望不會。"

sentences.text: A change of air will do you a lot of good.
sentences.translationZh: 改變環境將對你有很多好處。
sentences.translationOriginal: 改變環境將對你有很多好處。

sentences.text: A lot of people are starving in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 世界上許多人很飢餓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 世界上许多人很饥饿。

sentences.text: Are you going to eat all of that yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？

sentences.text: Are you sure that Tom is in Australia now?
sentences.translationZh: 你確定湯姆現在在澳洲嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你确定汤姆现在在澳洲吗？

sentences.text: As soon as the door opened, they ran away.
sentences.translationZh: 門一開，他們就逃走了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 门一开，他们就逃走了。

sentences.text: Can you put some suntan lotion on my back?
sentences.translationZh: 你能在我的背上塗些防曬霜嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能在我的背上涂些防晒霜吗？

sentences.text: Children don't like to go out in the dark.
sentences.translationZh: 孩子們不喜歡摸黑外出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孩子們不喜歡摸黑外出。

sentences.text: Could you put my name on the waiting list?
sentences.translationZh: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申請人名單上嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能把我的名字加到等候批准的申请人名单上吗？

sentences.text: Do you have any idea what's been going on?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道現在正在發生甚麼嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道現在正在發生甚麼嗎？

sentences.text: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道銀行什麼時候關門嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？

sentences.text: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道怎麼恢復已刪除的文件嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

sentences.text: Do you think that he is equal to the task?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為他能夠勝任這個任務嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你认为他能够胜任这个任务吗?

sentences.text: Don't you have any feelings for me at all?
sentences.translationZh: 你對我完全沒有感覺嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你对我完全没有感觉吗？

sentences.text: He has spent ten years in jail for murder.
sentences.translationZh: 他因為謀殺案在牢裡待了十年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他因為謀殺案在牢裡待了十年。

sentences.text: He makes three times more money than I do.
sentences.translationZh: 他賺的錢比我多三倍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他赚的钱比我多三倍。

sentences.text: He stretched out his arm to take the book.
sentences.translationZh: 他伸長了手臂為了能拿到書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他伸长了手臂为了能拿到书。

sentences.text: He's the boy we spoke about the other day.
sentences.translationZh: 他是前幾天我們談到的那個男孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是前幾天我們談到的那個男孩。

sentences.text: How did you know that was my favorite one?
sentences.translationZh: 你怎麼知道那是我最喜歡的？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你怎麼知道那是我最喜歡的？

sentences.text: I can't finish the job in so short a time.
sentences.translationZh: 我無法在這麼短的時間內完成這份工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我無法在這麼短的時間內完成這份工作。

sentences.text: I can't go with you because I'm very busy.
sentences.translationZh: 我不能和你們一起去，因為我很忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不能和你们一起去，因为我很忙。

sentences.text: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
sentences.translationZh: 我無法再忍受那噪音了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我无法再忍受那噪音了。

sentences.text: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
sentences.translationZh: 在回家的路上，我看到一場閱兵式。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。

sentences.text: I could swim well even when I was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 我很小的時候就遊得很好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很小的时候就游得很好了。

sentences.text: I didn't call on him because I had a cold.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒有拜訪他，因為我感冒了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

sentences.text: I didn't know you didn't know how to swim.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道你不會游泳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道你不會游泳。

sentences.text: I do not for a moment think you are wrong.
sentences.translationZh: 我從沒認為你錯了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我从没认为你错了。

sentences.text: I don't know if you feel the same as I do.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道你是否和我有一樣的感覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道你是否和我有一样的感觉。

sentences.text: I have a friend whose father is a teacher.
sentences.translationZh: 我有一個朋友, 他的父親是老師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有一個朋友, 他的父親是老師。

sentences.text: I hope everything will be fine in the end.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望最後一切都好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望最后一切都好。

sentences.text: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
sentences.translationZh: 我妥善保管原版拷貝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我妥善保管原版拷貝。

sentences.text: I love her so much that I can't leave her.
sentences.translationZh: 我如此地愛她所以我無法離開她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我如此地愛她所以我無法離開她。

sentences.text: I need to complete it as soon as possible.
sentences.translationZh: 我需要儘快完成。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要尽快完成。

sentences.text: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
sentences.translationZh: 我在海邊撿了個漂亮貝殼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

sentences.text: I saw the film in San Francisco last year.
sentences.translationZh: 我去年在舊金山看這部電影。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我去年在舊金山看這部電影。

sentences.text: I think this machine is in need of repair.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為這機器需要修理。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为这机器需要修理。

sentences.text: I think we shouldn't allow Tom to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們不應該允許湯姆去做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我們不應該允許湯姆去做。

sentences.text: I want the same jacket as you are wearing.
sentences.translationZh: 我也想要和你身上那件同樣的外套。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。

sentences.text: I want to introduce you to my friend here.
sentences.translationZh: 我想給你介紹一下我身旁這位朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想給你介紹一下我身旁這位朋友。

sentences.text: I want to leave this difficult job to her.
sentences.translationZh: 我想讓她幹這項艱難的工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想让她干这项艰难的工作。

sentences.text: I want to show you something in my office.
sentences.translationZh: 我想給你看看我辦公室裡的一些東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想给你看看我办公室里的一些东西。

sentences.text: If I'd known the truth, I'd have told you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我知道真相，我就告訴你了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我知道真相，我就告诉你了。

sentences.text: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你買給我冰淇淋，我就親你一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你買給我冰淇淋，我就親你一下。

sentences.text: If you have something to say, just say it.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你想說，就說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你想说，就说。

sentences.text: If you hurry you can still make the train.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你抓緊，你還能趕上火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。

sentences.text: It is definite that he will go to America.
sentences.translationZh: 他肯定要去美國。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他肯定要去美国。

sentences.text: It started raining as soon as we got home.
sentences.translationZh: 我們才一到家就下起雨來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們才一到家就下起雨來了。

sentences.text: It takes me ten minutes to walk to school.
sentences.translationZh: 我走路10分鐘能到學校 。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我走路10分钟能到学校 。

sentences.text: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
sentences.translationZh: 你真笨去接受他的提議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真笨去接受他的提議。

sentences.text: It's a pleasure to have you with us again.
sentences.translationZh: 真高興你又跟我們在一起了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真高兴你又跟我们在一起了。

sentences.text: Let me know the result as soon as you can.
sentences.translationZh: 儘早讓我知道結果。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽早让我知道结果。

sentences.text: Let's go and see as many things as we can.
sentences.translationZh: 我們走，儘可能多看點東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们走，尽可能多看点东西。

sentences.text: Let's wait for a while and see how you do.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我們等一會兒看看你怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讓我們等一會兒看看你怎麼做。

sentences.text: Look out for cars when you cross the road.
sentences.translationZh: 當你過馬路的時候要當心汽車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你過馬路的時候要當心汽車。

sentences.text: My father is going for a walk in the park.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親要去公園裡走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父親要去公園裡走。

sentences.text: My father will retire at the age of sixty.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親六十歲就要退休了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。

sentences.text: My guess is that it will be fine tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 我猜明天會是好天氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我猜明天会是好天气。

sentences.text: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
sentences.translationZh: 她買了六碼的布做衣服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她買了六碼的布做衣服。

sentences.text: She managed to finish the work on her own.
sentences.translationZh: 她想方設法以一己之力完成了工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。

sentences.text: She stayed in that area for a short while.
sentences.translationZh: 她在那地方待了片刻。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她在那地方待了片刻。

sentences.text: She will be a famous artist in the future.
sentences.translationZh: 她將來會是一個有名的藝術家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她将来会是一个有名的艺术家。

sentences.text: Since I had a cold, I didn't go visit him.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒有拜訪他，因為我感冒了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

sentences.text: Ten minutes later, our car ran out of gas.
sentences.translationZh: 我們的車再過十分鐘就沒油了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们的车再过十分钟就没油了。

sentences.text: Thank you for the present you gave my son.
sentences.translationZh: 謝謝你送給我兒子禮物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 谢谢你送给我儿子礼物。

sentences.text: That was one of the best times of my life.
sentences.translationZh: 那是我一生中最美好的時光之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。

sentences.text: The apple does not fall far from the tree.
sentences.translationZh: 蘋果掉落的地方不會離樹幹很遠。
sentences.translationOriginal: 蘋果掉落的地方不會離樹幹很遠。

sentences.text: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
sentences.translationZh: 那女孩的頭髮上綁了一根黃絲帶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那女孩的头发上绑了一根黄丝带。

sentences.text: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
sentences.translationZh: 溪流潺潺，催我入眠。
sentences.translationOriginal: 溪流潺潺，催我入眠。

sentences.text: The only thing I want to do is go fishing.
sentences.translationZh: 我唯一想做的是去釣魚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我唯一想做的是去釣魚。

sentences.text: The river's on the other side of the hill.
sentences.translationZh: 河在山丘的另一端。
sentences.translationOriginal: 河在山丘的另一端。

sentences.text: The top of Mt. Fuji was covered with snow.
sentences.translationZh: 富士山頂蓋滿了雪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 富士山顶盖满了雪。

sentences.text: There are a lot of new buildings here now.
sentences.translationZh: 這裡現在有了許多新建築。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这里现在有了许多新建筑。

sentences.text: There is a book about dancing on the desk.
sentences.translationZh: 桌子上有一本關於舞蹈的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。

sentences.text: There was nothing I could do at that time.
sentences.translationZh: 當時我什麼都不能做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当时我什么都不能做。

sentences.text: There were a lot of people at the concert.
sentences.translationZh: 音樂會上有很多人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 音乐会上有很多人。

sentences.text: They seem to have had a good time in Rome.
sentences.translationZh: 他們看來在羅馬過了些好日子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們看來在羅馬過了些好日子。

sentences.text: This book is easy enough for them to read.
sentences.translationZh: 這本書他們讀起來夠簡單了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本书他们读起来够简单了。

sentences.text: This cake tastes like it has cheese in it.
sentences.translationZh: 這塊蛋糕嚐起來有奶酪的味道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这块蛋糕尝起来有奶酪的味道。

sentences.text: This is the best book that I've ever read.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我讀過的最好的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是我讀過的最好的書。

sentences.text: This is the room where the body was found.
sentences.translationZh: 這就是發現屍體的房間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这就是发现尸体的房间。

sentences.text: To tell the truth, I don't agree with you.
sentences.translationZh: 實話說，我不贊成你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 实话说，我不赞成你。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary have three cats and two dogs.
sentences.translationZh: Tom和Mary有三隻貓和兩隻狗。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom和Mary有三隻貓和兩隻狗。

sentences.text: Tom came up with an answer to our problem.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆給我們的問題想出了個答案。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆给我们的问题想出了个答案。

sentences.text: Tom can't have done what you think he did.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆還不能做完你認為他能的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆还不能做完你认为他能的事。

sentences.text: Tom has to speak French every day at work.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆每天都要在工作時說法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆每天都要在工作时说法语。

sentences.text: Tom is able to come to our party tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆明天能來我們的聚會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆明天能来我们的聚会。

sentences.text: Tom is standing in the corner of the room.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆正站在房間的角落。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆正站在房间的角落。

sentences.text: Tom knows exactly how I like my hair done.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆很清楚我喜歡什麼樣的髮型。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆很清楚我喜欢什么样的发型。

sentences.text: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把一叠信放在玛丽桌上。

sentences.text: Tom says he hopes Mary is able to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他希望瑪麗能做到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他希望玛丽能做到。

sentences.text: Tom told me that I shouldn't ever do that.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說我絶不該做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說我絶不該做。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he had lost his textbook.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他丟了課本。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他丢了课本。

sentences.text: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆拿出錢包付了賬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆拿出錢包付了賬。

sentences.text: Tom wanted Mary to say that she loved him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想讓瑪麗說愛他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想让玛丽说爱他。

sentences.text: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆被卡車撞到而且當場死亡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆被卡車撞到而且當場死亡。

sentences.text: We are all longing for peace in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 誰都希望世界和平。
sentences.translationOriginal: 谁都希望世界和平。

sentences.text: Were you fat when you were in high school?
sentences.translationZh: 你在高中的時候胖嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在高中的时候胖吗？

sentences.text: What do you think should be done about it?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得對此該做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得对此该做什么？

sentences.text: What do you usually do in your spare time?
sentences.translationZh: 你在閒暇的時候一般做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在閒暇的時候一般做什麼？

sentences.text: What we had to do was really quite simple.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要做的很簡單。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們要做的很簡單。

sentences.text: Which one of the two brothers did you see?
sentences.translationZh: 你見到的是兩兄弟中的哪一個？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你见到的是两兄弟中的哪一个？

sentences.text: Why do you want to know what I'm thinking?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼你想知道我在想什麼?
sentences.translationOriginal: 為什麼你想知道我在想什麼?

sentences.text: Will I be the only one going to the party?
sentences.translationZh: 會不會只有我一個人去聚會？
sentences.translationOriginal: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？

sentences.text: You have to turn in the reports on Monday.
sentences.translationZh: 星期一你必須繳交報告。
sentences.translationOriginal: 星期一你必須繳交報告。

sentences.text: You must be careful not to make him angry.
sentences.translationZh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

sentences.text: You need a car if you live in the suburbs.
sentences.translationZh: 要住在郊區的話，汽車是必需的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。

sentences.text: You seem to be a little under the weather.
sentences.translationZh: 你看上去不太好。
