sentences.translationOriginal: 你看上去不太好。

sentences.text: You'll get used to living here in no time.
sentences.translationZh: 你很快就會習慣住在這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。

sentences.text: You'll learn how to do it sooner or later.
sentences.translationZh: 你遲早會學會怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你遲早會學會怎麼做。

sentences.text: A face with too much make up looks strange.
sentences.translationZh: 化妝太濃的話臉會看著很奇怪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 化妆太浓的话脸会看着很奇怪。

sentences.text: Are you a student of a private high school?
sentences.translationZh: 你在私立高中讀書嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在私立高中读书吗？

sentences.text: Are you going to be in Boston this weekend?
sentences.translationZh: 你這週末在波士頓過嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你這週末在波士頓過嗎？

sentences.text: Are you sure you don't want to sleep on it?
sentences.translationZh: 你確定你不想睡在它上面嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你確定你不想睡在它上面嗎？

sentences.text: As soon as he saw a policeman, he ran away.
sentences.translationZh: 他一看見警察就逃走了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一看见警察就逃走了。

sentences.text: Both Tom and his wife grew up in Australia.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和他的妻子都在澳大利亞長大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和他的妻子都在澳大利亚长大。

sentences.text: By the way, I've got to tell you something.
sentences.translationZh: 我得順便給你講件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我得順便給你講件事。

sentences.text: Can you please tell me your name once more?
sentences.translationZh: 請問你能再告訴我一遍你的名字嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 请问你能再告诉我一遍你的名字吗？

sentences.text: Did you forget to lock the door last night?
sentences.translationZh: 你昨天晚上忘了鎖門嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你昨天晚上忘了鎖門嗎？

sentences.text: Do you think we should send for the doctor?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為我們應該派人去請醫生來嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你認為我們應該派人去請醫生來嗎?

sentences.text: Does he go to school on foot or by bicycle?
sentences.translationZh: 他走路去學校還是騎車去學校？
sentences.translationOriginal: 他走路去学校还是骑车去学校？

sentences.text: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.
sentences.translationZh: 別忘了在你的信上貼張郵票。
sentences.translationOriginal: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。

sentences.text: He gave us not only clothes but some money.
sentences.translationZh: 他不僅給了我們衣服，還有一點錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不仅给了我们衣服，还有一点钱。

sentences.text: He got accustomed to the new way of living.
sentences.translationZh: 他適應了新的生活方式。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他适应了新的生活方式。

sentences.text: He has three times as many books as I have.
sentences.translationZh: 他有我的三倍的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他有我的三倍的书。

sentences.text: He helped an old lady get up from her seat.
sentences.translationZh: 他幫忙一位老太太從位子上站起來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他幫忙一位老太太從位子上站起來。

sentences.text: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 他是日本最偉大的藝術家之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。

sentences.text: He is richer than anyone else in this town.
sentences.translationZh: 他比鎮裡的其他人都有錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他比镇里的其他人都有钱。

sentences.text: He parked his car in front of the building.
sentences.translationZh: 他把車停在大樓前。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他把车停在大楼前。

sentences.text: He was just on the verge of going to sleep.
sentences.translationZh: 他快要睡了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他快要睡了。

sentences.text: How could I be a robot? Robots can't dream.
sentences.translationZh: 我怎麼可能是機器人呢？機器人不會做夢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我怎么可能是机器人呢？机器人不会做梦。

sentences.text: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?
sentences.translationZh: 我應該往你的咖啡裡放多少糖呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？

sentences.text: I can't tell you how to pronounce the word.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道怎麼告訴你這個詞的發音。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道怎么告诉你这个词的发音。

sentences.text: I don't have time for a vacation this year.
sentences.translationZh: 我今年沒時間去度假。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今年没时间去度假。

sentences.text: I don't know for certain when he will come.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道他來這裡的確切時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。

sentences.text: I don't know when he came back from France.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道他是什麼時候從法國回來的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道他是什么时候从法国回来的。

sentences.text: I don't like to leave things up in the air.
sentences.translationZh: 我不喜歡讓事情懸而未決。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不喜歡讓事情懸而未決。

sentences.text: I don't love her, not even if she loves me.
sentences.translationZh: 即使她愛我，我也不愛她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 即使她愛我，我也不愛她。

sentences.text: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.
sentences.translationZh: 我不像我以前那麼拖延了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。

sentences.text: I don't want something bad to happen to us.
sentences.translationZh: 我可不想要壞事發生在我們身上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我可不想要坏事发生在我们身上。

sentences.text: I don't want to be involved in that matter.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想被牽扯到這件事裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。

sentences.text: I don't want to go to Tom's birthday party.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想去湯姆的聚會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想去汤姆的聚会。

sentences.text: I had no choice but to stay in bed all day.
sentences.translationZh: 我不得不一整天都待在床上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不得不一整天都待在床上。

sentences.text: I have a few friends who speak French well.
sentences.translationZh: 我有一些法語說得好的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有一些法语说得好的朋友。

sentences.text: I have no idea of what's going on in there.
sentences.translationZh: 我不清楚這裡發生了什麼事？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不清楚這裡發生了什麼事？

sentences.text: I have to take my medicine every six hours.
sentences.translationZh: 我每六小時要服一次藥。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我每六小时要服一次药。

sentences.text: I invited him to the party and he accepted.
sentences.translationZh: 我邀請他去派對，他接受了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我邀请他去派对，他接受了。

sentences.text: I just didn't want to go to work yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 昨天我只是不想去工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨天我只是不想去工作。

sentences.text: I recognize that what he says is the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 我承認他說的是事實。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我承认他说的是事实。

sentences.text: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
sentences.translationZh: 我拒絕被你像奴隸一樣對待。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

sentences.text: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
sentences.translationZh: 我一整天都在看這本小說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一整天都在看这本小说。

sentences.text: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
sentences.translationZh: 我建議你轉身回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我建議你轉身回家。

sentences.text: I think that Tom might not want to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為湯姆可能不想那樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为汤姆可能不想那样做。

sentences.text: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為你應該跟她道歉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為你應該跟她道歉。

sentences.text: I think we shouldn't let Tom do that again.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們不該讓湯姆再那麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我們不該讓湯姆再那麼做。

sentences.text: I thought pizza was what you wanted to eat.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為你想吃的是比薩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為你想吃的是比薩。

sentences.text: I tried to change her mind, but I couldn't.
sentences.translationZh: 我試著改變她的心意，但我沒有辦法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我試著改變她的心意，但我沒有辦法。

sentences.text: I want everyone to help me clean the house.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望所有人都來幫我打掃房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望所有人都来帮我打扫房子。

sentences.text: I want to ask you some questions about Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我想問你一些關於湯姆的問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想问你一些关于汤姆的问题。

sentences.text: I want to stay in a hotel near the airport.
sentences.translationZh: 我想住在機場附近的旅館裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想住在機場附近的旅館裡。

sentences.text: I was kept waiting for nearly half an hour.
sentences.translationZh: 我等了接近半小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我等了接近半小时。

sentences.text: I went to the station to see my friend off.
sentences.translationZh: 我去車站為我朋友送行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我去车站为我朋友送行。

sentences.text: I would like to go to the concert with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我想和你一起去音樂會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

sentences.text: I'll let you know when I've figured it out.
sentences.translationZh: 我搞明白了會告訴你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我搞明白了会告诉你。

sentences.text: I'm afraid I differ with you on this point.
sentences.translationZh: 恐怕就這點上，我和你持不同意見。
sentences.translationOriginal: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。

sentences.text: I'm not saying that what she did was right.
sentences.translationZh: 我不是說她做的是對的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不是說她做的是對的。

sentences.text: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

sentences.text: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他努力學習，他會通過考試的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他努力学习，他会通过考试的。

sentences.text: If you don't know the way, ask a policeman.
sentences.translationZh: 要是不知道路的話去問警察吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是不知道路的话去问警察吧。

sentences.text: If you don't want to go, you don't need to.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不想去, 就不必去了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不想去, 就不必去了。

sentences.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
sentences.translationZh: 贈與比接受更讓人覺得幸福。
sentences.translationOriginal: 赠与比接受更让人觉得幸福。

sentences.text: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
sentences.translationZh: 學會一門外語不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 学会一门外语不容易。

sentences.text: It looks like Tom has bought a new bicycle.
sentences.translationZh: 看來湯姆借了輛自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看來湯姆借了輛自行車。

sentences.text: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
sentences.translationZh: 搭帳篷花了我們半小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 搭帳篷花了我們半小時。

sentences.text: It's very big of you to admit you're wrong.
sentences.translationZh: 你能承認你錯了是很偉大的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能承认你错了是很伟大的。

sentences.text: It's very hard getting a taxi in this city.
sentences.translationZh: 在這個城市，很難打到的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在这个城市，很难打到的。

sentences.text: Let me help you. Your bag looks very heavy.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我來幫你吧。你的包看起來很重。
sentences.translationOriginal: 让我来帮你吧。你的包看起来很重。

sentences.text: Let's go for a walk after it stops raining.
sentences.translationZh: 等雨停了，我們去散步吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 等雨停了，我们去散步吧。

sentences.text: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
sentences.translationZh: 我弟弟手裡拿著一個攝像機。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。

sentences.text: My uncle comes to see me from time to time.
sentences.translationZh: 我叔叔偶爾來看我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我叔叔偶爾來看我。

sentences.text: My uncles come to see me from time to time.
sentences.translationZh: 我的叔叔們有時會來探望我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的叔叔們有時會來探望我。

sentences.text: No matter what you say, the answer is "no."
sentences.translationZh: 不管你說什麼, 答案就是＂不。＂
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管你說什麼, 答案就是＂不。＂

sentences.text: Once he had written the letter, he sent it.
sentences.translationZh: 信一寫好，他就把它寄了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 信一写好，他就把它寄了。

sentences.text: One can't help many, but many can help one.
sentences.translationZh: 一個人幫不了許多個，但許多人能幫助一個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一个人帮不了许多个，但许多人能帮助一个。

sentences.text: Please let me know as soon as it's decided.
sentences.translationZh: 決定好的話請第一時間告訴我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 决定好的话请第一时间告诉我。

sentences.text: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
sentences.translationZh: 穿上你的鞋，我們出去吃晚飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。

sentences.text: She was advised by him to go to the police.
sentences.translationZh: 他勸她去報警。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他勸她去報警。

sentences.text: She was so curious that she opened the box.
sentences.translationZh: 她太過好奇，以至於打開了盒子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。

sentences.text: She went into her room to change her dress.
sentences.translationZh: 她進了她的房間換裙子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她进了她的房间换裙子。

sentences.text: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
sentences.translationZh: 地球的外形和橙子相似。
sentences.translationOriginal: 地球的外形和橙子相似。

sentences.text: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
sentences.translationZh: 公司由於缺乏資本倒閉了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

sentences.text: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.
sentences.translationZh: 女孩給我了一枝紅玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。
sentences.translationOriginal: 女孩给我了一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。

sentences.text: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
sentences.translationZh: 我在洗澡的時候，電話響了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在洗澡的时候，电话响了。

sentences.text: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.
sentences.translationZh: 山頂被雪覆蓋了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 山顶被雪覆盖了。

sentences.text: There is no point in pretending to be sick.
sentences.translationZh: 裝病是沒用的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 装病是没用的。

sentences.text: They welcomed me warmly, so I felt at home.
sentences.translationZh: 他們這麼熱情的歡迎我，讓我感覺家人一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们这么热情的欢迎我，让我感觉家人一样。

sentences.text: This book is too difficult for you to read.
sentences.translationZh: 這本書對你來說讀起來太難了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本书对你来说读起来太难了。

sentences.text: This novel is too difficult for me to read.
sentences.translationZh: 這本小說對我來說太難讀了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這本小說對我來說太難讀了。

sentences.text: This shirt doesn't go with that tie at all.
sentences.translationZh: 這件襯衫跟那條領帶不搭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這件襯衫跟那條領帶不搭。

sentences.text: Tom advised me not to buy a secondhand car.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆建議我不要買二手車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆建议我不要买二手车。

sentences.text: Tom and his wife both grew up in Australia.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和他的妻子都在澳大利亞長大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和他的妻子都在澳大利亚长大。

sentences.text: Tom comes here three or four times a month.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆一個月來這裡三四次。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆一个月来这里三四次。

sentences.text: Tom didn't say where he was planning to go.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒說他打算去哪裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆沒說他打算去哪裡。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't have to go to Boston next week.
sentences.translationZh: Tom下星期不用去波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom下星期不用去波士頓。

sentences.text: Tom is by far the tallest boy in our class.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆遠比我們班其他男孩高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆远比我们班其他男孩高。

sentences.text: Tom is too tired to help you do that today.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆今天太累，不能幫你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆今天太累，不能幫你。

sentences.text: Tom is writing a letter to his best friend.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆正給他的好友寫信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆正给他的好友写信。

sentences.text: Tom isn't here yet, but we expect him soon.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆還不在這裡，但我們期待他很快就來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆還不在這裡，但我們期待他很快就來。

sentences.text: Tom learned to ride a bike when he was ten.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在10歲的時候就學騎了自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在10岁的时候就学骑了自行车。

sentences.text: Tom paid me back the money that he owed me.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把欠我的錢還給我了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把欠我的钱还给我了。

sentences.text: Tom sits at his computer eight hours a day.
sentences.translationZh: Tom每天在電腦前工作八小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom每天在電腦前工作八小時。

sentences.text: Tom used to swim a lot when he was younger.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆年輕的時候經常游泳
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆年轻的时候经常游泳

sentences.text: Tom wanted to know if Mary had a boyfriend.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想知道瑪麗是否有男朋友？
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想知道玛丽是否有男朋友？

sentences.text: Tom wasn't as handsome as Mary said he was.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆並不是瑪麗說得那樣英俊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆并不是玛丽说得那样英俊。

sentences.text: We are looking for a nice house to live in.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在找一個漂亮的屋子住。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。

sentences.text: We can't know what the future has in store.
sentences.translationZh: 人不知道未來可能發生什麼事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人不知道未來可能發生什麼事。

sentences.text: We have to sing at an old folks home today.
sentences.translationZh: 我們今天得去養老院唱歌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。

sentences.text: We were just about to leave when it rained.
sentences.translationZh: 我們正要離開的時候下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們正要離開的時候下雨了。

sentences.text: We won't go out if it doesn't stop raining.
sentences.translationZh: 雨不停，我們不會出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 雨不停，我们不会出去。

sentences.text: What you said left a deep impression on me.
sentences.translationZh: 你說的話給我留下了很深刻的印象。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。

sentences.text: When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
sentences.translationZh: 當我打開門的時候，我發現他睡著了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我打开门的时候，我发现他睡着了。

sentences.text: When it stops raining, let's go for a walk.
sentences.translationZh: 等雨停了，我們去散步吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 等雨停了，我们去散步吧。

sentences.text: When the lights went out, Tom lit a candle.
sentences.translationZh: 燈滅了，湯姆點起了蠟燭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 灯灭了，汤姆点起了蜡烛。

sentences.text: Who can say what will happen in the future?
sentences.translationZh: 誰能說將來會發生什麼呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 谁能说将来会发生什么呢。

sentences.text: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
sentences.translationZh: 有了堅定的目標，你會做得很好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。

sentences.text: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 你不必擔心這樣的事情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不必擔心這樣的事情。

sentences.text: You have to get this work finished by noon.
sentences.translationZh: 你必須在中午以前完成這個工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必須在中午以前完成這個工作。

sentences.text: You ought to have come to see me yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 你昨天應該來看我的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你昨天應該來看我的。

sentences.text: You should have a doctor take a look at it.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該讓個醫生看看。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你应该让个医生看看。

sentences.text: You told Tom you could do that, didn't you?
sentences.translationZh: 你告訴湯姆你可以做到，是嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你告诉汤姆你可以做到，是吗？

sentences.text: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
sentences.translationZh: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。

sentences.text: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
sentences.translationZh: 冷空氣疾風席捲整棟房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 冷空氣疾風席捲整棟房子。

sentences.text: A fox is not caught twice in the same snare.
sentences.translationZh: 狡兔三窟。
sentences.translationOriginal: 狡兔三窟。

sentences.text: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.
sentences.translationZh: 一百多個人在一個火車事故中受了傷。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一百多个人在一个火车事故中受了伤。

sentences.text: All of us went to the theater to see a play.
sentences.translationZh: 我們所有的人都去劇院看戲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們所有的人都去劇院看戲。

sentences.text: All that I know is that he gave up the plan.
sentences.translationZh: 我所知道的是他放棄了這個計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我所知道的是他放棄了這個計劃。

sentences.text: An uncle of mine gave me some useful advice.
sentences.translationZh: 我的一個叔叔給我了一些有用的建議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的一个叔叔给我了一些有用的建议。

sentences.text: At first, he could not speak English at all.
sentences.translationZh: 起初，他不會說英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 起初，他不會說英語。

sentences.text: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
sentences.translationZh: 電腦為我們節省了很多時間，解決了很多問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 电脑为我们节省了很多时间，解决了很多问题。

sentences.text: Did Tom ever tell you how he first met Mary?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴你他是怎樣第一次遇見瑪麗的了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆告訴你他是怎樣第一次遇見瑪麗的了嗎？

sentences.text: Do you really want me to go there right now?
sentences.translationZh: 你真想讓我馬上到那裡去嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真想让我马上到那里去吗？

sentences.text: Had I known about it, I would have told you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我知道的話，我早就已經告訴你了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我知道的话，我早就已经告诉你了。

sentences.text: Having lived in Tokyo, I know the city well.
sentences.translationZh: 因為住過東京，我對這個城市非常瞭解。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为住过东京，我对这个城市非常了解。

sentences.text: He asked her to marry him, and she accepted.
sentences.translationZh: 他向她求婚，而她同意了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他向她求婚，而她同意了。

sentences.text: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
sentences.translationZh: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。

sentences.text: He is going to be a doctor when he grows up.
sentences.translationZh: 他長大了會成為一名醫生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他长大了会成为一名医生。

sentences.text: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
sentences.translationZh: 他給我看了他最新劇的底稿。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

sentences.text: He sleeps during the day and works at night.
sentences.translationZh: 他白天睡覺，晚上工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他白天睡觉，晚上工作。

sentences.text: He was a very good skier when he was little.
sentences.translationZh: 他年輕時很會滑雪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他年輕時很會滑雪。

sentences.text: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.
sentences.translationZh: 猴子跳到他身上的時候，他受到了驚嚇。
sentences.translationOriginal: 猴子跳到他身上的时候，他受到了惊吓。

sentences.text: How come Mary is going on a picnic with him?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼瑪麗和他去野餐？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为什么玛丽和他去野餐？

sentences.text: How could so many people go along with this?
sentences.translationZh: 怎麼會有這麼多的人同意呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 怎么会有这么多的人同意呢？

sentences.text: How far is it from the airport to the hotel?
sentences.translationZh: 從機場到旅館多遠？
sentences.translationOriginal: 從機場到旅館多遠？

sentences.text: How long does it take to get to the station?
sentences.translationZh: 去火車站要多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 去火车站要多久？

sentences.text: I entered the room and shook hands with him.
sentences.translationZh: 我走進了房間與他握手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我走進了房間與他握手。

sentences.text: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得我好像從惡夢中驚醒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我覺得我好像從惡夢中驚醒。

sentences.text: I heard you were injured trying to help Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我聽說你在試圖幫助湯姆的時候受傷了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我听说你在试图帮助汤姆的时候受伤了。

sentences.text: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
sentences.translationZh: 我匆匆忙忙，為的是能趕上第一班火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。

sentences.text: I met Tom for the first time three days ago.
sentences.translationZh: 我三天前第一次見湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我三天前第一次见汤姆。

sentences.text: I need to find out when we need to be there.
sentences.translationZh: 我需要知道我們什麼時候需要到那裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要知道我们什么时候需要到那里。

sentences.text: I need your advice on what I should do next.
sentences.translationZh: 我需要你指導我接下來該做甚麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要你指導我接下來該做甚麼。

sentences.text: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
sentences.translationZh: 我不論甚麼時候都不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不論甚麼時候都不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖。

sentences.text: I rode a horse for the first time yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 昨天我第一次騎了馬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨天我第一次骑了马。

sentences.text: I should have known better than to call him.
sentences.translationZh: 早知道我不應該打電話給他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 早知道我不應該打電話給他。

sentences.text: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
sentences.translationZh: 為了健康，我不再抽菸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 為了健康，我不再抽菸。

sentences.text: I suggest that you don't trust Tom too much.
sentences.translationZh: 我建議你別太相信湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我建議你別太相信湯姆。

sentences.text: I think you should leave as soon as you can.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得你應該趕緊走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得你应该赶紧走。

sentences.text: I think you're a lot stronger than you know.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為你比你想像的更強。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为你比你想象的更强。

sentences.text: I thought Tom would want to know about that.
sentences.translationZh: 我本以為湯姆願意瞭解這件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我本以为汤姆愿意了解这件事。

sentences.text: I thought we were going to do this together.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們要一起做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我們要一起做。

sentences.text: I took a taxi from the station to the hotel.
sentences.translationZh: 我從車站搭了一班到旅館的計程車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我從車站搭了一班到旅館的計程車。

sentences.text: I used to go out with friends every weekend.
sentences.translationZh: 我曾經每週末都和朋友外出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我曾经每周末都和朋友外出。

sentences.text: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.
sentences.translationZh: 門鈴響的時候，我正準備出門。
sentences.translationOriginal: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。

sentences.text: I was having a bath when the telephone rang.
sentences.translationZh: 在我洗澡的時候，電話響了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

sentences.text: I was taking a bath when the telephone rang.
sentences.translationZh: 在我洗澡的時候，電話響了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

sentences.text: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
sentences.translationZh: 你生日的時候，我送你一輛自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。

sentences.text: I wonder why they left my name off the list.
sentences.translationZh: 我奇怪他們為什麼在表裡把我的名字落下了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我奇怪他们为什么在表里把我的名字落下了。

sentences.text: I'd like to get married to someone like you.
sentences.translationZh: 我想跟你這樣的人結婚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想跟你这样的人结婚。

sentences.text: I'm going to stay here for a couple of days.
sentences.translationZh: 我將要在這裡待幾天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我將要在這裡待幾天。

sentences.text: I'm sorry that I didn't reply to you sooner.
sentences.translationZh: 抱歉，我沒有早點回覆你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 抱歉，我沒有早點回覆你。

sentences.text: I'm sure I can find something for you to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我確定我能找點給你做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我確定我能找點給你做的事。

sentences.text: If it's fine tomorrow, we'll go on a picnic.
sentences.translationZh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去野餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果明天天气好，我们就去野餐。

sentences.text: If you don't leave, I'll sic my dogs on you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不離開，我就放狗出來咬你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不离开，我就放狗出来咬你。

sentences.text: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你唱歌了，他們就會把你踢出酒吧
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧

sentences.text: If you won a million yen, what would you do?
sentences.translationZh: 如果你中了一百萬日元的獎，你會怎麼做?
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你中了一百万日元的奖，你会怎么做?

sentences.text: In order to do that, you have to take risks.
sentences.translationZh: 要這麼做，你需要冒險。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要这么做，你需要冒险。

sentences.text: In those days, a cup of coffee cost 200 yen.
sentences.translationZh: 那時候一杯咖啡要200日元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那时候一杯咖啡要200日元。

sentences.text: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
sentences.translationZh: 跳上一列正在開的火車是很危險的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。

sentences.text: It is not necessary for you to quit the job.
sentences.translationZh: 你沒必要辭掉工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你没必要辞掉工作。

sentences.text: It isn't as easy to do that as people think.
sentences.translationZh: 這並不像一般人覺得的那麼容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这并不像一般人觉得的那么容易。

sentences.text: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得她有點自私。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得她有点自私。

sentences.text: It was her little sister that broke her toy.
sentences.translationZh: 她的玩具是被她妹妹弄壞的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她的玩具是被她妹妹弄壞的。

sentences.text: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
sentences.translationZh: 你聽從她的忠告是明智的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你聽從她的忠告是明智的。

sentences.text: It was so cold yesterday that I stayed home.
sentences.translationZh: 昨天太冷了，我只好待在家裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨天太冷了，我只好待在家里。

sentences.text: It's getting to be time for me to head back.
sentences.translationZh: 差不多該回去了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 差不多该回去了。

sentences.text: It's impossible for me to explain it to you.
sentences.translationZh: 要我解釋給你聽是不可能的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要我解释给你听是不可能的。

sentences.text: It's not as easy to do that as people think.
sentences.translationZh: 這並不像一般人覺得的那麼容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这并不像一般人觉得的那么容易。

sentences.text: It's very easy to miss this kind of mistake.
sentences.translationZh: 這種錯誤很容易被人忽視。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这种错误很容易被人忽视。

sentences.text: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
sentences.translationZh: 幸運的是他有足夠的錢來付賬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。

sentences.text: Many of the user reviews on Amazon are fake.
sentences.translationZh: 亞馬遜網站上的許多用戶評論都是虛假的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 亚马逊网站上的许多用户评论都是虚假的。

sentences.text: My uncle has a flower shop near the station.
sentences.translationZh: 我叔叔在車站附近有一家花店。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我叔叔在車站附近有一家花店。

sentences.text: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
sentences.translationZh: 老婆喊我把這些舊帽子扔掉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老婆喊我把这些旧帽子扔掉。

sentences.text: Quit smoking if you don't want to die early.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你想活得久一點就戒菸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你想活得久一点就戒烟。

sentences.text: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
sentences.translationZh: 閱讀一本書可以比作一次旅行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

sentences.text: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
sentences.translationZh: 她發現她已經斷鹽了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她发现她已经断盐了。

sentences.text: She doesn't have as much patience as you do.
sentences.translationZh: 她沒像你那樣有耐心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她没像你那样有耐心。

sentences.text: She may be late, in which case we will wait.
sentences.translationZh: 她可能遲到，然後我們就要等。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她可能迟到，然后我们就要等。

sentences.text: She warned him not to go out at night alone.
sentences.translationZh: 她警告他晚上不要一個人出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

sentences.text: She was holding a small parasol in her hand.
sentences.translationZh: 她手裡握著一把小陽傘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她手里握着一把小阳伞。

sentences.text: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
sentences.translationZh: 生產日期在蓋子上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 生产日期在盖子上。

sentences.text: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
sentences.translationZh: 工程師告訴我們如何使用機器。
sentences.translationOriginal: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。

sentences.text: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
sentences.translationZh: 他買的第一項東西是一個鬧鐘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。

sentences.text: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.
sentences.translationZh: 橙子在我嘴裡留下了一種奇怪的味道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。

sentences.text: The weather was not only cold, but also wet.
sentences.translationZh: 天氣又冷又溼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天气又冷又湿。

sentences.text: There are no hats in that store that fit me.
sentences.translationZh: 那個店裡沒有合我尺寸的帽子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那個店裡沒有合我尺寸的帽子。

sentences.text: There is a library in every city in America.
sentences.translationZh: 美國的每個城市都有一個圖書館。
sentences.translationOriginal: 美国的每个城市都有一个图书馆。

sentences.text: There seemed to be no answer to the problem.
sentences.translationZh: 這個問題似乎沒有答案。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个问题似乎没有答案。

sentences.text: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.
sentences.translationZh: 山坡上有一個茅屋。
sentences.translationOriginal: 山坡上有一个茅屋。

sentences.text: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 他們說高爾夫在日本很流行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。

sentences.text: This is a good book, but that one is better.
sentences.translationZh: 這是本好書，但那本更好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是本好書，但那本更好。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary always work together as a team.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是在一個團隊裡工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆和瑪麗總是在一个團隊裡工作。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary have been here for three hours.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗已經在這裡待了三個小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆和瑪麗已經在這裡待了三個小時。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary have three sons and a daughter.
sentences.translationZh: Tom和Mary有三個兒子和一個女兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom和Mary有三個兒子和一個女兒。

sentences.text: Tom can swim faster than anyone else I know.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是我認識的人當中游泳最快的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆是我认识的人当中游泳最快的。

sentences.text: Tom didn't like spinach when he was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆小時候不喜歡菠菜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆小时候不喜欢菠菜。

sentences.text: Tom made a list of places he wants to visit.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把他想去的地方列成了一張清單。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把他想去的地方列成了一张清单。

sentences.text: Tom said he wanted to try riding a unicycle.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他想試試騎獨輪車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他想試試騎獨輪車。

sentences.text: Tom said that he wanted to eat Chinese food.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他想吃中國菜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他想吃中國菜。

sentences.text: Tom told me that his father had passed away.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他父親去世了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他父亲去世了。

sentences.text: Tom was embarrassed to have to ask for help.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆很不好意思去求幫忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆很不好意思去求帮忙。

sentences.text: Tom wrote his name in the sand with a stick.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆用棍子在沙上寫了他的名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

sentences.text: Tom, what would you like to have for dinner?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆，你晚飯想吃甚麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆，你晚飯想吃甚麽？

sentences.text: We haven't yet been told what we need to do.
sentences.translationZh: 還沒人告訴我們要做甚麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 還沒人告訴我們要做甚麼。

sentences.text: What is the total amount of money you spent?
sentences.translationZh: 你一共花了多少錢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你一共花了多少钱？

sentences.text: What number bus do I take to get to Waikiki?
sentences.translationZh: 我乘幾路車去懷基基？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我乘几路车去怀基基？

sentences.text: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
sentences.translationZh: 誰能說將來會發生什麼呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 谁能说将来会发生什么呢。

sentences.text: Will you lend me your CD player for an hour?
sentences.translationZh: 你能借我你的CD播放機一小時嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能借我你的CD播放機一小時嗎？

sentences.text: You may not remember me, but I remember you.
sentences.translationZh: 你可能不記得我了，但我記得你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可能不記得我了，但我記得你。

sentences.text: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
sentences.translationZh: 你吸太多煙了。你應該少抽一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你吸太多煙了。你應該少抽一點。

sentences.text: You'll be able to drive a car in a few days.
sentences.translationZh: 幾天之後你就可以開車了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 幾天之後你就可以開車了。

sentences.text: Did you watch TV last week? "No, I didn't."
sentences.translationZh: “上週你看電視了嗎？”“沒有，我沒看。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “上周你看电视了吗？”“没有，我没看。”

sentences.text: Is he going to swim tomorrow? "Yes, he is."
sentences.translationZh: 他明天會去游泳嗎? "是的, 他會。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 他明天會去游泳嗎? "是的, 他會。"

sentences.text: After she had lunch, she got ready to go out.
sentences.translationZh: 吃過午飯後，她準備好要出門了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 吃過午飯後，她準備好要出門了。

sentences.text: All of the cookies are in the shape of stars.
sentences.translationZh: 所有餅乾都是星星的形狀。
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有餅乾都是星星的形狀。

sentences.text: All the signs are that she is getting better.
sentences.translationZh: 所有跡象表明她好起來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有迹象表明她好起来了。

sentences.text: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
sentences.translationZh: 你們準備參加會議嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你们准备参加会议吗？

sentences.text: Are you sure you want to do this by yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你確定要自己做這個嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你确定要自己做这个吗？

sentences.text: As long as you keep quiet, you can stay here.
sentences.translationZh: 只要你保持安靜, 你可以留在這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只要你保持安靜, 你可以留在這裡。

sentences.text: Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道這兒附近有什麼好餐館嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道这儿附近有什么好餐馆吗?

sentences.text: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
sentences.translationZh: 很少有東西像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多的快樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很少有東西像音樂一樣帶給我們這麼多的快樂。

sentences.text: He has not written to us since last February.
sentences.translationZh: 他從去年二月開始就沒寫信給我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他從去年二月開始就沒寫信給我們。

sentences.text: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
sentences.translationZh: 他和班上其他男生一樣聰明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。

sentences.text: He studied hard in order to get into college.
sentences.translationZh: 他努力學習，為的是能夠考上大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他努力学习，为的是能够考上大学。

sentences.text: He was moved to tears when he heard the news.
sentences.translationZh: 當他聽到那個新聞的時候，他感動得哭了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当他听到那个新闻的时候，他感动得哭了。

sentences.text: He was playing the piano and she was singing.
sentences.translationZh: 他彈鋼琴，她唱歌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他彈鋼琴，她唱歌。

sentences.text: He wrote a book about the American Civil War.
sentences.translationZh: 他寫了本關於美國南北戰爭的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他写了本关于美国南北战争的书。

sentences.text: How large is the population of New York City?
sentences.translationZh: 紐約市的人口有多少？
sentences.translationOriginal: 纽约市的人口有多少？

sentences.text: How long do you plan to stay in this country?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算在這個國家待多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算在这个国家待多久？

sentences.text: How long does it take to walk to the station?
sentences.translationZh: 走著去火車站要多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 走着去火车站要多久？

sentences.text: I admitted that I didn't know how to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我承認我不知道怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我承認我不知道怎麼做。

sentences.text: I am going to stay here for a couple of days.
sentences.translationZh: 我將要在這裡待幾天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我將要在這裡待幾天。

sentences.text: I am staying at the hotel for the time being.
sentences.translationZh: 目前我待在酒店。
sentences.translationOriginal: 目前我待在酒店。

sentences.text: I am waiting for you to finish your homework.
sentences.translationZh: 我等你把作業做完。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我等你把作業做完。

sentences.text: I bought a VCR at that store for a low price.
sentences.translationZh: 我在上商店花低價買了錄像機。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在上商店花低价买了录像机。

sentences.text: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
sentences.translationZh: 我不能同時注意兩件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不能同時注意两件事。

sentences.text: I caught him by the arm before he could fall.
sentences.translationZh: 在他倒下前我抓住了他的手臂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在他倒下前我抓住了他的手臂。

sentences.text: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道是否該同意或拒絕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道是否該同意或拒絕。

sentences.text: I don't feel like taking a walk this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我今天早上不想散步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今天早上不想散步。

sentences.text: I don't know if he would have done it for me.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道他是否已經為我做好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道他是否已经为我做好了。

sentences.text: I don't know if that's what Tom wants or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道那是不是湯姆想要的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道那是不是汤姆想要的。

sentences.text: I don't know your reasons for not liking Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道你不喜歡湯姆的理由。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道你不喜欢汤姆的理由。

sentences.text: I don't really like him, in fact, I hate him.
sentences.translationZh: 我不太喜歡他，其實我討厭他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不太喜欢他，其实我讨厌他。

sentences.text: I don't think any more students want to come.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得不會有更多學生想來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得不会有更多学生想来了。

sentences.text: I don't think that she looks like her mother.
sentences.translationZh: 我不覺得她像她媽媽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不觉得她像她妈妈。

sentences.text: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
sentences.translationZh: 她開朗的個性使我覺得快樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她開朗的個性使我覺得快樂。

sentences.text: I have to give back the book before Saturday.
sentences.translationZh: 我必須在禮拜六之前把書還回去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我必须在礼拜六之前把书还回去。

sentences.text: I have too many things on my mind these days.
sentences.translationZh: 這幾天我腦袋裡的事情太多了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这几天我脑袋里的事情太多了。

sentences.text: I just had dinner with some of Tom's friends.
sentences.translationZh: 我剛跟湯姆的一些朋友吃了晚飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我刚跟汤姆的一些朋友吃了晚饭。

sentences.text: I should have gone to bed earlier last night.
sentences.translationZh: 我昨晚應該早點睡覺的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我昨晚应该早点睡觉的。

sentences.text: I take a walk every day except when it rains.
sentences.translationZh: 除了雨天我每天都散步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了雨天我每天都散步。

sentences.text: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為採用他的計劃對我們比較好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。

sentences.text: I think we've found what we were looking for.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們找到我們正在找的東西了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我們找到我們正在找的東西了。

sentences.text: I thought that Tom had a soccer game tonight.
sentences.translationZh: 我以為湯姆今晚有足球比賽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以为汤姆今晚有足球比赛。

sentences.text: I wanted to thank you for what you did today.
sentences.translationZh: 我想為你今天所做的事感謝你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想为你今天所做的事感谢你。

sentences.text: I was able to succeed because of your advice.
sentences.translationZh: 我因為有你的建議才能成功。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我因為有你的建議纔能成功。

sentences.text: I will give you a call as soon as I get home.
sentences.translationZh: 我一回到家就打電話給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一回到家就打电话给你。

sentences.text: I will make it clear that I won't come again.
sentences.translationZh: 我要明確表示我不會再來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要明確表示我不會再來了。

sentences.text: I wish I could buy you everything you wanted.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我能買下你想要的所有東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我能买下你想要的所有东西。

sentences.text: I wonder if a third world war will break out.
sentences.translationZh: 不知道第三次世界大戰會不會爆發。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。

sentences.text: I wonder if you have something to write with.
sentences.translationZh: 我懷疑你是否有東西可寫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我懷疑你是否有東西可寫。

sentences.text: I wonder whether or not Tom can speak French.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道湯姆會不會說法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道湯姆會不會說法語。

sentences.text: I'll deal with this problem as soon as I can.
sentences.translationZh: 我會盡快處理這問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会尽快处理这问题。

sentences.text: I'll drop by the post office on the way home.
sentences.translationZh: 我會在回家的路上順便去郵局。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会在回家的路上顺便去邮局。

sentences.text: I'm not sure, but I think I know where to go.
sentences.translationZh: 我不確定，但我認為我知道要去哪裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不确定，但我认为我知道要去哪里。

sentences.text: I've always fed my dogs in the early evening.
sentences.translationZh: 每個傍晚我都會餵我的狗狗們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每个傍晚我都会喂我的狗狗们。

sentences.text: I've got to stop eating such sweet ice cream.
sentences.translationZh: 我必須停止吃那麼甜的冰激凌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我必须停止吃那么甜的冰激凌。

sentences.text: If it rains tomorrow, I'll just stay at home.
sentences.translationZh: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家。

sentences.text: If it rains tonight, I'm not going to go out.
sentences.translationZh: 如果今晚下雨, 我就不出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果今晚下雨, 我就不出去。

sentences.text: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你發現錯誤，那就請你糾正它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你发现错误，那就请你纠正它。

sentences.text: Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?
sentences.translationZh: 黑海里的水事實上是黑的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？

sentences.text: It cost me 50 dollars to have my watch fixed.
sentences.translationZh: 我花了五十美元修好了手表。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我花了五十美元修好了手表。

sentences.text: It has been three months since he left Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 自從他離開日本已經有三個月了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 自從他離開日本已經有三個月了。

sentences.text: It is cruel of him to say such things to her.
sentences.translationZh: 他跟她說這樣的話真是太殘忍了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。

sentences.text: It is less humid today than it was yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 今天沒有昨天潮溼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天沒有昨天潮溼。

sentences.text: It is less muggy today than it was yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 今天不比昨天悶熱。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天不比昨天悶熱。

sentences.text: It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.
sentences.translationZh: 區分善惡不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 区分善恶不容易。

sentences.text: It looks like the dog wants something to eat.
sentences.translationZh: 那隻狗看起來好像想吃東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那隻狗看起來好像想吃東西。

sentences.text: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
sentences.translationZh: 在公開場合開你老闆的玩笑是無禮的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在公開場合開你老闆的玩笑是無禮的。

sentences.text: Keep an eye on the child for me for a moment.
sentences.translationZh: 幫我看會兒孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 帮我看会儿孩子。

sentences.text: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我送你到車站吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讓我送你到車站吧。

sentences.text: Life doesn't always go the way we want it to.
sentences.translationZh: 生活並不總是如我們所願。
sentences.translationOriginal: 生活并不总是如我们所愿。

sentences.text: Mary isn't like the other girls in the class.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗跟班上其他女孩不同。
sentences.translationOriginal: 瑪麗跟班上其他女孩不同。

sentences.text: More often than not, she had to go in person.
sentences.translationZh: 很多時候她要親自去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很多時候她要親自去。

sentences.text: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親總是說話很大聲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父親總是說話很大聲。

sentences.text: Once she starts talking, she is hard to stop.
sentences.translationZh: 她一旦開始說話，就很難讓她停下來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一旦開始說話，就很難讓她停下來。

sentences.text: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
sentences.translationZh: 我們的眼睛需要時間來適應黑暗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

sentences.text: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.
sentences.translationZh: 會為你說謊的人，就會對你說謊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。

sentences.text: She asked me whether I liked the plan or not.
sentences.translationZh: 她問我喜不喜歡這個計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她问我喜不喜欢这个计划。

sentences.text: She did not visit me on Sunday but on Monday.
sentences.translationZh: 她沒有在星期天來找我，而是星期一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她沒有在星期天來找我，而是星期一。

sentences.text: She got over the shock of her father's death.
sentences.translationZh: 她從她父親過世的震驚中恢復了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她從她父親過世的震驚中恢復了。

sentences.text: She has to take a remedial course in English.
sentences.translationZh: 她需要上英語補習班。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她需要上英语补习班。

sentences.text: She is going to wash the bike this afternoon.
sentences.translationZh: 她下午會洗自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她下午会洗自行车。

sentences.text: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.
sentences.translationZh: 他們中的一些人身體健康，但是其他人不是。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们中的一些人身体健康，但是其他人不是。

sentences.text: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
sentences.translationZh: 進教室的時候請把帽子摘了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 进教室的时候请把帽子摘了。

sentences.text: The charge for a front row seat is 5 dollars.
sentences.translationZh: 第一排的座位5美元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 第一排的座位5美元。

sentences.text: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
sentences.translationZh: 在全體職員回家後，火事爆發了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。

sentences.text: The flowers in the garden need to be watered.
sentences.translationZh: 花園裡的花需要澆水。
sentences.translationOriginal: 花园里的花需要浇水。

sentences.text: The information you gave me is of little use.
sentences.translationZh: 你給我的資料沒有多大的用處。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你給我的資料沒有多大的用處。

sentences.text: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
sentences.translationZh: 地主說他要提高租金。
sentences.translationOriginal: 地主说他要提高租金。

sentences.text: The old church by the lake is very beautiful.
sentences.translationZh: 河邊的老教堂很漂亮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 河边的老教堂很漂亮。

sentences.text: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
sentences.translationZh: 舊村屋有它自己一定的魅力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

sentences.text: The police seem to know exactly where we are.
sentences.translationZh: 警察看來很清楚我們在哪裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察看來很清楚我們在哪裡。

sentences.text: There are more girls than boys at our school.
sentences.translationZh: 在我們學校裡女孩比男孩多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我們學校裡女孩比男孩多。

sentences.text: There is a small garden in front of my house.
sentences.translationZh: 我家前面有個小庭院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我家前面有个小庭院。

sentences.text: There used to be a lot of frogs in this pond.
sentences.translationZh: 以前在這個池塘裡有許多青蛙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 以前在這個池塘裡有許多青蛙。

sentences.text: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.
sentences.translationZh: 有一陣從北邊吹來的冷風。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有一阵从北边吹来的冷风。

sentences.text: There's no space in the room for another bed.
sentences.translationZh: 這間房間沒有空間再放一張床了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這間房間沒有空間再放一張床了。

sentences.text: They say that he has been dead for two years.
sentences.translationZh: 他們說他死了兩年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们说他死了两年了。

sentences.text: This case might not get resolved for a while.
sentences.translationZh: 這個案件可能不會在短時間內就解決。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這個案件可能不會在短時間內就解決。

sentences.text: This song makes me think of when I was young.
sentences.translationZh: 這首歌使我想起了我年輕的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这首歌使我想起了我年轻的时候。

sentences.text: Time is the most precious thing in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 時間是世界上最寶貴的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。

sentences.text: Tom and I see each other every day at school.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和我每天都在學校見面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和我每天都在学校见面。

sentences.text: Tom closed his eyes and began to count sheep.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆閉上了眼睛開始數羊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆闭上了眼睛开始数羊。

sentences.text: Tom didn't have enough money to pay the rent.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有足夠的錢付租金。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没有足够的钱付租金。

sentences.text: Tom didn't need to finish that work by today.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不必今天就完成那工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不必今天就完成那工作。

sentences.text: Tom has been learning French for a few years.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆學了幾年法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆学了几年法语。

sentences.text: Tom has never been willing to help us before.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆以前從不這樣願意幚我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆以前從不這樣願意幚我們。

sentences.text: Tom has spent the past three years in prison.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在監獄裡待了三年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆在監獄裡待了三年。

sentences.text: Tom is spending more and more time in Boston.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在波士頓待得越來越久。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在波士顿待得越来越久。

sentences.text: Tom isn't nearly as smart as he thinks he is.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆並不像他自認為的那麼聰明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆并不像他自认为的那么聪明。

sentences.text: Tom made a list of places he wanted to visit.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆列了他想去的地方的名單。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆列了他想去的地方的名单。

sentences.text: Tom said he's going to tell us what he knows.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他要把他知道的告訴我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他要把他知道的告訴我們。

sentences.text: Tom says that he doesn't feel like going out.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他不想出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他不想出去。

sentences.text: Tom tricked Mary into doing his work for him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆哄瑪麗做他的作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆哄玛丽做他的作业。

sentences.text: Tom visits Mary every time he goes to Boston.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆每次去波士頓都去看瑪麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆每次去波士頓都去看瑪麗。

sentences.text: Tom wants to spend more time with his family.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想多把時間花在他的家庭上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想多把时间花在他的家庭上。

sentences.text: Tom worked hard to get the work done on time.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆努力工作按時完成工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆努力工作按时完成工作。

sentences.text: Watch out for cars when you cross the street.
sentences.translationZh: 當你過馬路的時候要當心汽車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你過馬路的時候要當心汽車。

sentences.text: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.
sentences.translationZh: 我們必須快點定下旅遊日期。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们必须快点定下旅游日期。

sentences.text: We have to put off the game till next Sunday.
sentences.translationZh: 我們不得不把遊戲擱到下週日了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们不得不把游戏搁到下周日了。

sentences.text: We met in 2008. A year later, we got married.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在2008年相遇。一年後，我們結婚了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們在2008年相遇。一年後，我們結婚了。

sentences.text: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
sentences.translationZh: 我們必須學會與自然和諧共處。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。

sentences.text: What do I have to do now that I'm registered?
sentences.translationZh: 我註冊了，現在該幹什麼呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我注册了，现在该干什么呢？

sentences.text: What do you say to taking a walk in the park?
sentences.translationZh: 去公園散步你覺得怎麼樣？
sentences.translationOriginal: 去公园散步你觉得怎么样？

sentences.text: What time does the train for New York depart?
sentences.translationZh: 去紐約的火車幾點出發？
sentences.translationOriginal: 去纽约的火车几点出发？

sentences.text: When I first met Tom, I didn't like him much.
sentences.translationZh: 我第一次見到湯姆時，我不太喜歡他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我第一次見到湯姆時，我不太喜歡他。

sentences.text: Why do you think that I'm thinking about you?
sentences.translationZh: 你為什麼會認為我在想你？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你为什么会认为我在想你？

sentences.text: Would you like to have a drink before dinner?
sentences.translationZh: 晚飯前您想喝一杯嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 晚饭前您想喝一杯吗？

sentences.text: Would you please have a look at these papers?
sentences.translationZh: 請你看看這些文件。
sentences.translationOriginal: 請你看看這些文件。

sentences.text: You can see the roof of the house from there.
sentences.translationZh: 你能從那裡看到房子的頂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能從那裡看到房子的頂。

sentences.text: You know as well as I do that Tom hates Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 你我都知道湯姆恨瑪麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你我都知道湯姆恨瑪麗。

sentences.text: You may have been the last person to see Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 你可能是最後一個見湯姆的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可能是最後一個見湯姆的人。

sentences.text: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
sentences.translationZh: 你該結束這種愚蠢的行為了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

sentences.text: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?
sentences.translationZh: 你說你有困難。我能幫忙嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？

sentences.text: You should make better use of your free time.
sentences.translationZh: 你要更好地利用閒暇時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你要更好地利用闲暇时间。

sentences.text: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
sentences.translationZh: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合講話了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合講話了。

sentences.text: You'd better keep your money for a rainy day.
sentences.translationZh: 你最好未雨綢繆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你最好未雨绸缪。

sentences.text: Where were you? "I was at a friend's house."
sentences.translationZh: “你在哪裡？” “我在一個朋友家。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你在哪里？” “我在一个朋友家。”

sentences.text: A great number of citizens went into the army.
sentences.translationZh: 許多老百姓加入了軍隊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 許多老百姓加入了軍隊。

sentences.text: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
sentences.translationZh: 巨大的柱子遮住了視線，讓人看不到湖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。

sentences.text: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.
sentences.translationZh: 許多房屋被洪水沖走了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。

sentences.text: As soon as she opened the door, a cat ran out.
sentences.translationZh: 她一開門，一隻貓就跑了出來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一開門，一隻貓就跑了出來。

sentences.text: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
sentences.translationZh: 亞洲的大小約四倍於歐洲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 亚洲的大小约四倍于欧洲。

sentences.text: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
sentences.translationZh: 你能把最近的公車站指給我看嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能把最近的公车站指给我看吗?

sentences.text: Could you put this report into Italian for me?
sentences.translationZh: 你可以為我把這份報告翻譯成意大利文嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以為我把這份報告翻譯成意大利文嗎？

sentences.text: Does the letter need to be written in English?
sentences.translationZh: 這封信需要用英文寫嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 這封信需要用英文寫嗎？

sentences.text: Excuse me, I have to get off at the next stop.
sentences.translationZh: 對不起，我要在下一站下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 对不起，我要在下一站下。

sentences.text: Going out in this rain is out of the question.
sentences.translationZh: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。

sentences.text: Having a slight headache, I went to bed early.
sentences.translationZh: 因為我有點頭疼，所以我早早上床睡覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因為我有點頭疼，所以我早早上床睡覺。

sentences.text: He couldn't wait to try out his new surfboard.
sentences.translationZh: 他迫不及待地想試一下他的新衝浪板。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他迫不及待地想试一下他的新冲浪板。

sentences.text: He hasn't yet turned in the report this month.
sentences.translationZh: 他這個月還沒有提交報告書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他這個月還沒有提交報告書。

sentences.text: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
sentences.translationZh: 他不像他的兄長那樣聰明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

sentences.text: He looks old, but he is still in his twenties.
sentences.translationZh: 他看上去老，但他還不到30歲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他看上去老，但他还不到30岁。

sentences.text: He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
sentences.translationZh: 他拿了面鏡子細看自己的舌頭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。

sentences.text: He really loves beer and gets drunk every day.
sentences.translationZh: 他喜歡喝啤酒，而且每天都喝醉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他喜歡喝啤酒，而且每天都喝醉。

sentences.text: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
sentences.translationZh: 他受邀做俱樂部的主席。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

sentences.text: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 他好心地把我送到醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他好心地把我送到医院。

sentences.text: He went to London, where he stayed for a week.
sentences.translationZh: 他去了倫敦，並在那兒待了一週。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他去了伦敦，并在那儿待了一周。

sentences.text: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.
sentences.translationZh: 他的缺席導致了各種謠言的產生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的缺席导致了各种谣言的产生。

sentences.text: How long did it take you to write this report?
sentences.translationZh: 你寫這份報告花了多長時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你写这份报告花了多长时间？

sentences.text: Hurry up, and you will be in time for the bus.
sentences.translationZh: 快點，你就能準時搭上公交車了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 快点，你就能准时搭上公交车了。

sentences.text: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
sentences.translationZh: 我建議你永遠不要入不敷出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

sentences.text: I always have to wear a tie because of my job.
sentences.translationZh: 因為我這份工作的緣故，我總是要打領帶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因為我這份工作的緣故，我總是要打領帶。

sentences.text: I always thought that Tom was a bit different.
sentences.translationZh: 我以前總認為湯姆是有一些與眾不同的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以前总认为汤姆是有一些与众不同的。

sentences.text: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
sentences.translationZh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

sentences.text: I believe the actions that he took were right.
sentences.translationZh: 我相信我們採取的行動是對的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我相信我们采取的行动是对的。

sentences.text: I bought the book for myself, not for my wife.
sentences.translationZh: 我給我自己買了書，不是給我妻子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我給我自己買了書，不是給我妻子。

sentences.text: I can speak Chinese, but I can't read Chinese.
sentences.translationZh: 我會說中文，但是我不會讀中文。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我會說中文，但是我不會讀中文。

sentences.text: I can talk about anything with my best friend.
sentences.translationZh: 我能跟我最好的朋友說任何事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我能跟我最好的朋友說任何事。

sentences.text: I can't let you give me your last ten dollars.
sentences.translationZh: 我不能讓你給我你最後十美圓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不能讓你給我你最後十美圓。

sentences.text: I certainly wouldn't want to be seen with Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我當然不想被人看見跟湯姆在一起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我当然不想被人看见跟汤姆在一起。

sentences.text: I didn't expect to hear back from Tom so soon.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒想到這麼快就收到湯姆的回信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我沒想到這麼快就收到湯姆的回信。

sentences.text: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.
sentences.translationZh: 我不相信孩子能獨自到東京。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不相信孩子能独自到东京。

sentences.text: I don't expect that they will support my view.
sentences.translationZh: 我不期望，他們能夠支持我的觀點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。

sentences.text: I don't know if today is Tuesday or Wednesday.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道今天是星期二還是星期三。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道今天是星期二還是星期三。

sentences.text: I don't know what I should be doing right now.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道，我現在應該做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道，我现在应该做什么。

sentences.text: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
sentences.translationZh: 要是我說錯話被人議論，我是不管的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是我说错话被人议论，我是不管的。

sentences.text: I don't think we'd have any chance of winning.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們沒有機會贏。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我们没有机会赢。

sentences.text: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
sentences.translationZh: 每天早晚，我給我的貓餵食。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每天早晚，我给我的猫喂食。

sentences.text: I go to the library two or three times a week.
sentences.translationZh: 我一週去圖書館兩、三次。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一週去圖書館兩、三次。

sentences.text: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒見過也沒聽過這樣的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。

sentences.text: I help my mother with the housework every day.
sentences.translationZh: 我每天都幫我媽做家務。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我每天都帮我妈做家务。

sentences.text: I know that you are learning French at school.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道你在學校學法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道你在學校學法語。

sentences.text: I liked Tom's first book more than the second.
sentences.translationZh: 相比第二本，我更喜歡湯姆的第一本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 相比第二本，我更喜欢汤姆的第一本书。

sentences.text: I met him by chance on the train this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 今天早上我在火車上偶遇他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天早上我在火车上偶遇他。

sentences.text: I met him just as he was coming out of school.
sentences.translationZh: 正當他從學校回來的時候，我遇見了他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 正當他從學校回來的時候，我遇見了他。

sentences.text: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
sentences.translationZh: 我發誓再也不跟她說話了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我發誓再也不跟她說話了。

sentences.text: I want you to help us find out who killed Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我想讓你幫我們查出來誰殺了湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想讓你幫我們查出來誰殺了湯姆。

sentences.text: I went to the hospital to have my eyes tested.
sentences.translationZh: 我到醫院去檢查了眼睛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我到醫院去檢查了眼睛。

sentences.text: I will write letters to you as often as I can.
sentences.translationZh: 我會盡可能多給你寫信的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会尽可能多给你写信的。

sentences.text: I wish that we could spend more time together.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我們有更多時間呆在一起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我们有更多时间呆在一起。

sentences.text: I'd like to put some things in the hotel safe.
sentences.translationZh: 我想在酒店的保險櫃裡存點東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想在酒店的保险柜里存点东西。

sentences.text: I'm stuck here in Boston because of the storm.
sentences.translationZh: 我因為風暴困在波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我因為風暴困在波士頓。

sentences.text: If it happened to Tom, it could happen to you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果那發生在Tom身上，也可能會發生在你身上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果那發生在Tom身上，也可能會發生在你身上。

sentences.text: If you don't want to do it, you don't have to.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不想的話也沒問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不想的话也没问题。

sentences.text: In Japan, the new school year begins in April.
sentences.translationZh: 日本的新學年在四月開始。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本的新學年在四月開始。

sentences.text: It is difficult for me to answer the question.
sentences.translationZh: 這個問題對我來講很難回答。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个问题对我来讲很难回答。

sentences.text: It is important for old people to stay strong.
sentences.translationZh: 老人保持強健很重要。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老人保持强健很重要。

sentences.text: It is like looking for a needle in a haystack.
sentences.translationZh: 這好比大海撈針。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这好比大海捞针。

sentences.text: It was not long before we met again by chance.
sentences.translationZh: 沒多久，我們又碰巧遇到了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没多久，我们又碰巧遇到了。

sentences.text: It's been ten years since I came to this town.
sentences.translationZh: 我來這個鎮有十年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我來這個鎮有十年了。

sentences.text: It's next to impossible to finish it in a day.
sentences.translationZh: 在一天之內完成它幾乎是不可能的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

sentences.text: It's time you went to bed. Turn off the radio.
sentences.translationZh: 你該上床了。把收音機關了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你该上床了。把收音机关了。

sentences.text: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
sentences.translationZh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。
sentences.translationOriginal: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。

sentences.text: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.
sentences.translationZh: 只要推門就好了。它自己會鎖上的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只要推门就好了。它自己会锁上的。

sentences.text: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
sentences.translationZh: 當我們明白真正的自己時，生活開始了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我们明白真正的自己时，生活开始了。

sentences.text: Mt. Fuji as seen from Suruga Bay is beautiful.
sentences.translationZh: 從駿河灣看, 富士山很美麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 從駿河灣看, 富士山很美麗。

sentences.text: My friend asked me if I was feeling all right.
sentences.translationZh: 我朋友問我是不是覺得還好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我朋友问我是不是觉得还好。

sentences.text: My mother looked at me with tears in her eyes.
sentences.translationZh: 我媽媽眼含著淚看我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我妈妈眼含着泪看我。

sentences.text: My son is going to leave for France next week.
sentences.translationZh: 我兒子下週要去法國了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我儿子下周要去法国了。

sentences.text: No matter what I do, she says I can do better.
sentences.translationZh: 不管我做什麼，她都說我能做得更好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管我做什么，她都说我能做得更好。

sentences.text: Only then did he realize he had been deceived.
sentences.translationZh: 直到那時，他才意識到他已經上當受騙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 直到那时，他才意识到他已经上当受骗。

sentences.text: Put this jacket on, and you'll be much warmer.
sentences.translationZh: 穿上外套吧！你會暖一些。
sentences.translationOriginal: 穿上外套吧！你會暖一些。

sentences.text: School was closed for the day due to the snow.
sentences.translationZh: 學校因大雪停課一天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 学校因大雪停课一天。

sentences.text: She has been absent from school for five days.
sentences.translationZh: 她已經五天不上學了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她已经五天不上学了。

sentences.text: She is proud that her son has become a doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 她為自己的兒子成為醫生而自豪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她为自己的儿子成为医生而自豪。

sentences.text: She loved me in the same way that I loved her.
sentences.translationZh: 她愛我就像我愛她一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她愛我就像我愛她一樣。

sentences.text: She spends a lot of time practicing the piano.
sentences.translationZh: 她花很多時間練鋼琴。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她花很多时间练钢琴。

sentences.text: She will give her picture to whoever wants it.
sentences.translationZh: 她會把她的照片給想要的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她会把她的照片给想要的人。

sentences.text: She wrote to her parents at least once a week.
sentences.translationZh: 他給父母寫信至少一週一次。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他给父母写信至少一周一次。

sentences.text: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
sentences.translationZh: 有人說中國像是俄國的殖民地。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有人說中國像是俄國的殖民地。

sentences.text: Thanks to a cold summer, beer has sold poorly.
sentences.translationZh: 多虧了冷夏，啤酒賣的不好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 多虧了冷夏，啤酒賣的不好。

sentences.text: That can't be Mary. She's in the hospital now.
sentences.translationZh: 那不可能是瑪麗，她現在在醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那不可能是玛丽，她现在在医院。

sentences.text: That was the first time I'd seen Tom so angry.
sentences.translationZh: 那是我第一次見到湯姆如此生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是我第一次见到汤姆如此生气。

sentences.text: The air is thin at the top of a high mountain.
sentences.translationZh: 山頂上空氣稀薄。
sentences.translationOriginal: 山頂上空氣稀薄。

sentences.text: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 氣壓計下降了 - 要下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 气压计下降了 - 要下雨了。

sentences.text: The more books you read, the more you'll know.
sentences.translationZh: 你看的書越多，你知道的越多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看的书越多，你知道的越多。

sentences.text: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
sentences.translationZh: 聚會已經推遲到了下週二。
sentences.translationOriginal: 聚会已经推迟到了下周二。

sentences.text: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.
sentences.translationZh: 土豆太熱，以至於燙到了我的嘴。
sentences.translationOriginal: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。

sentences.text: The rich are not always happier than the poor.
sentences.translationZh: 有錢人未必比窮人幸福。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有钱人未必比穷人幸福。

sentences.text: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.
sentences.translationZh: 那個賽跑運動員躍過了地面上的洞。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个赛跑运动员跃过了地面上的洞。

sentences.text: The store can supply us with anything we need.
sentences.translationZh: 這家商店可以提供所有我們需要的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这家商店可以提供所有我们需要的东西。

sentences.text: The storm had a serious effect on the economy.
sentences.translationZh: 這場暴風雪已經對經濟造成了很嚴重的影響。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。

sentences.text: The young man put out his hand and I shook it.
sentences.translationZh: 年輕人伸出他的手，接著我和他握了手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 年轻人伸出他的手，接着我和他握了手。

sentences.text: There has been a good apple harvest this year.
sentences.translationZh: 今年蘋果的收成不錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今年蘋果的收成不錯。

sentences.text: There were so many things I wanted to ask Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我有很多事想問湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有很多事想问汤姆。

sentences.text: They arrived in Osaka at the beginning of May.
sentences.translationZh: 他們五月初到了大阪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们五月初到了大阪。

sentences.text: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
sentences.translationZh: 這車便宜得讓他能買得起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這車便宜得讓他能買得起。

sentences.text: This is the house I lived in when I was young.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我年輕時候住的房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我年轻时候住的房子。

sentences.text: This is the man who's suspected by the police.
sentences.translationZh: 這是被警察認為有嫌疑的男子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是被警察认为有嫌疑的男子。

sentences.text: This is the place where the battle took place.
sentences.translationZh: 這是戰鬥發生的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是战斗发生的地方。

sentences.text: This plan will be very expensive to carry out.
sentences.translationZh: 這計劃執行起來花銷會很大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这计划执行起来花销会很大。

sentences.text: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
sentences.translationZh: 令我吃驚的是，他很容易就想出了一個方案。
sentences.translationOriginal: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。

sentences.text: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆彎下腰，捧起了一把沙子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

sentences.text: Tom couldn't think of a good place to hide it.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想不到個好地方藏它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆想不到個好地方藏它。

sentences.text: Tom didn't tell me he didn't know how to swim.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有告訴我他不會游泳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没有告诉我他不会游泳。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't know whether Mary is happy or not.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗是高興呢，還是不高興。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽是高兴呢，还是不高兴。

sentences.text: Tom had no idea that Mary was a serial killer.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗是個連環殺手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

sentences.text: Tom had no intention of giving Mary any money.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不想給瑪麗一分錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不想给玛丽一分钱。

sentences.text: Tom has admitted that he was there that night.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆承認他那晚是在那裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆承认他那晚是在那里。

sentences.text: Tom is waiting for you in the conference room.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在會議室等你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在会议室等你。

sentences.text: Tom knows I want to leave as soon as possible.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆知道我想盡早離開。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆知道我想盡早離開。

sentences.text: Tom made up his mind to become a newspaperman.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆決定做報業人士。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆决定做报业人士。

sentences.text: Tom probably knows how to get to Mary's house.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆大概知道要怎麼去瑪莉家吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆大概知道要怎麼去瑪莉家吧。

sentences.text: Tom studied hard so he could get into college.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆努力學習以進入大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆努力学习以进入大学。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he didn't want to go with us.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他不想跟我們走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆告訴我他不想跟我們走。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he'd like to become a doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他想當醫生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他想当医生。

sentences.text: Tom waited for Mary in front of the warehouse.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在倉庫前等瑪麗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆在倉庫前等瑪麗。

sentences.text: Tom wondered why there was a dog in his house.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆奇怪為什麼他的房子裡有隻狗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆奇怪为什么他的房子里有只狗。

sentences.text: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆擰乾毛巾掛起來晾乾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。

sentences.text: We were very sorry that we couldn't help them.
sentences.translationZh: 我們很遺憾無法幫助他們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們很遺憾無法幫助他們。

sentences.text: We will go on a picnic if it is fine tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 如果明天天氣好，那麼我們就去野餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果明天天气好，那么我们就去野餐。

sentences.text: What makes you think I won't be able to do it?
sentences.translationZh: 你怎麼認為我做不了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你怎么认为我做不了？

sentences.text: What subject do you think he is interested in?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得他會對什麼主題感興趣？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？

sentences.text: When I was young, I used to climb trees a lot.
sentences.translationZh: 我年輕時經常爬樹。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我年輕時經常爬樹。

sentences.text: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
sentences.translationZh: 當湯姆發現這件事時，他很生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当汤姆发现这件事时，他很生气。

sentences.text: When she was thirteen, she ran away from home.
sentences.translationZh: 她十三歲的時候離家出走了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她十三岁的时候离家出走了。

sentences.text: When she was three years old, her father died.
sentences.translationZh: 她父親在她三歲時死了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她父亲在她三岁时死了。

sentences.text: Where did you get the money to buy that dress?
sentences.translationZh: 你從哪兒弄來的錢去買那件衣服？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你從哪兒弄來的錢去買那件衣服？

sentences.text: Why didn't you tell Tom that you were married?
sentences.translationZh: 你為什麼不告訴湯姆你已經結婚了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你为什么不告诉汤姆你已经结婚了？

sentences.text: Will you pick me up at seven tomorrow morning?
sentences.translationZh: 你明早7點來接我嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你明早7点来接我吗？

sentences.text: Will you put down that paper and listen to me?
sentences.translationZh: 你能放下文件聽我說嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能放下文件聽我說嗎？

sentences.text: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.
sentences.translationZh: 你讀那本書需要大量詞彙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你讀那本書需要大量詞彙。

sentences.text: You need to have friends who can help you out.
sentences.translationZh: 你需要可以幫助你的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你需要可以幫助你的朋友。

sentences.text: You should read many books when you are young.
sentences.translationZh: 當你年輕的時候, 你應該多讀點兒書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你年輕的時候, 你應該多讀點兒書。

sentences.text: You're too old to be doing this kind of thing.
sentences.translationZh: 你老得做不了這種事了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你老得做不了这种事了。

sentences.text: A rolling stone gathers no moss is a proverb.
sentences.translationZh: “滾石不生苔”是一句諺語。
sentences.translationOriginal: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

sentences.text: A fire broke out in my neighborhood last night.
sentences.translationZh: 昨晚我領居家著火了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨晚我领居家着火了。

sentences.text: A friend of mine came to see me during the day.
sentences.translationZh: 我的一個朋友在白天的時候來看我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的一個朋友在白天的時候來看我。

sentences.text: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
sentences.translationZh: 正式工比臨時工要好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 正式工比临时工要好。

sentences.text: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
sentences.translationZh: 路中間有一輛卡車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 路中间有一辆卡车。

sentences.text: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.
sentences.translationZh: 海嘯來了，密切注意啊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海啸来了，密切注意啊。

sentences.text: All of my friends got asked to dance except me.
sentences.translationZh: 除了我，其他人都被邀請去跳舞了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了我，其他人都被邀请去跳舞了。

sentences.text: All you have to do is to take care of yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 你要做的只是照顧好你自己。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你要做的只是照顾好你自己。

sentences.text: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
sentences.translationZh: 90度的角叫直角。
sentences.translationOriginal: 90度的角叫直角。

sentences.text: Are you sure you don't want me to say anything?
sentences.translationZh: 你確定要我什麼都不說？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你确定要我什么都不说？

sentences.text: As far as I'm concerned, things are going well.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，事情很順利。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据我所知，事情很顺利。

sentences.text: At what age did you have your first girlfriend?
sentences.translationZh: 你幾歲交了第一個女朋友？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你几岁交了第一个女朋友？

sentences.text: Between you and me, I think our boss is stupid.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得我們老闆很蠢，這我就只跟你說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得我们老板很蠢，这我就只跟你说。

sentences.text: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
sentences.translationZh: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?

sentences.text: Can you please tell me where the restaurant is?
sentences.translationZh: 請問您能告訴我那家餐館在哪嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 请问您能告诉我那家餐馆在哪吗？

sentences.text: Did you enjoy yourself at the party last night?
sentences.translationZh: 你在昨晚的聚會上盡興了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在昨晚的聚會上盡興了嗎？

sentences.text: Did you have to get up very early this morning?
sentences.translationZh: 你今天必須起得很早嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你今天必須起得很早嗎？

sentences.text: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
sentences.translationZh: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？

sentences.text: Do you know if Tom has spoken to Mary recently?
sentences.translationZh: 你是否知道最近湯姆跟瑪麗有沒有說過話？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是否知道最近湯姆跟瑪麗有沒有說過話？

sentences.text: Do you know whether or not it'll rain tomorrow?
sentences.translationZh: 您是否知道，明天會不會下雨？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您是否知道，明天会不会下雨？

sentences.text: Do you think the weather will be fine tomorrow?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得明天天氣會變好嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得明天天气会变好吗？

sentences.text: Does this letter have to be written in English?
sentences.translationZh: 這封信必須用英文寫嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 這封信必須用英文寫嗎?

sentences.text: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.
sentences.translationZh: 即使我知道答案，我也不會告訴你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。

sentences.text: Even if I were rich, I wouldn't give him money.
sentences.translationZh: 就算我富有，我也不會給他錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 就算我富有，我也不会给他钱。

sentences.text: Every time I read the Bible, I am deeply moved.
sentences.translationZh: 每次我讀聖經都會被深深地感動。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每次我读圣经都会被深深地感动。

sentences.text: Friends are like flowers in the garden of life.
sentences.translationZh: 朋友就像生命之園裡的花朵。
sentences.translationOriginal: 朋友就像生命之园里的花朵。

sentences.text: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我早點到，就能遇到凱莉了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我早點到，就能遇到凱莉了。

sentences.text: Have you still not finished paying for my bike?
sentences.translationZh: 你還沒有為我的自行車付完款嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你还没有为我的自行车付完款吗？

sentences.text: He became a member of this club five years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 他在五年前成為了這個俱樂部的成員。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在五年前成為了這個俱樂部的成員。

sentences.text: He brought me coffee, when I had asked for tea.
sentences.translationZh: 我要的是茶，而他卻給了我一杯咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要的是茶，而他却给了我一杯咖啡。

sentences.text: He got into this school in September last year.
sentences.translationZh: 他去年九月進了這所學校。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他去年九月进了这所学校。

sentences.text: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
sentences.translationZh: 他早上總是有點脾氣暴躁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他早上总是有点脾气暴躁。

sentences.text: He lied to me. That is why I am angry with him.
sentences.translationZh: 他對我說了謊，這就是為什麼我生他的氣了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他对我说了谎，这就是为什么我生他的气了。

sentences.text: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.
sentences.translationZh: 他冒著生命危險救了那條狗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。

sentences.text: He said that he gets up at 6 o'clock every day.
sentences.translationZh: 他說他每天早上六點起床。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他说他每天早上六点起床。
