sentences.text: He should have the right to decide for himself.
sentences.translationZh: 他應該有權利去自己做決定。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他应该有权利去自己做决定。

sentences.text: He was unsure how he would get there, and when.
sentences.translationZh: 他不確定他怎麼到哪裡，以及什麼時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不确定他怎么到哪里，以及什么时候。

sentences.text: He went to the United States to study medicine.
sentences.translationZh: 他去美國學醫了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他去美国学医了。

sentences.text: How about eating out this evening for a change?
sentences.translationZh: 你說今晚改變一下，去外面吃晚飯怎麼樣？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你说今晚改变一下，去外面吃晚饭怎么样？

sentences.text: How do you get your children to eat vegetables?
sentences.translationZh: 你怎樣讓你的孩子們吃蔬菜？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你怎样让你的孩子们吃蔬菜？

sentences.text: How long can it be kept going with 100 dollars?
sentences.translationZh: 用100美元可以支持多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 用100美元可以支持多久？

sentences.text: How many books do you think you've read so far?
sentences.translationZh: 到目前為止，你認為你閱讀過多少書籍？
sentences.translationOriginal: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？

sentences.text: I am not used to drinking coffee without sugar.
sentences.translationZh: 我不習慣喝無糖咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不习惯喝无糖咖啡。

sentences.text: I as well as you was late for school yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我跟你一樣昨天上學遲到了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我跟你一样昨天上学迟到了。

sentences.text: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有你我無法做到，謝謝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没有你我无法做到，谢谢。

sentences.text: I didn't tell anyone what time I'd be arriving.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒跟別人說過我什麼時候會到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我沒跟別人說過我什麼時候會到。

sentences.text: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒發現任何我該道歉的理由。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没发现任何我该道歉的理由。

sentences.text: I don't think Tom is going to be too much help.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為湯姆幫不上大忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为汤姆帮不上大忙。

sentences.text: I found a taxi, but there was no driver inside.
sentences.translationZh: 我找到了一輛出租車，但裡面卻沒有司機。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我找到了一輛出租車，但裏面卻沒有司機。

sentences.text: I got up early enough to catch the first train.
sentences.translationZh: 我起了個大早為了趕第一班火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我起了个大早为了赶第一班火车。

sentences.text: I had no idea there'd be this many people here.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒想到這裡有這麼多人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没想到这里有这么多人。

sentences.text: I have to go shopping. I'll be back in an hour.
sentences.translationZh: 我該去買東西了，我一小時後回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我该去买东西了，我一小时后回来。

sentences.text: I haven't had time to look for what you wanted.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒時間找你想要的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没时间找你想要的东西。

sentences.text: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
sentences.translationZh: 我只是希望我們能離開這個可怕的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。

sentences.text: I know that I know it, but I can't remember it.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道我知道它，但我想不起來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道我知道它，但我想不起來了。

sentences.text: I like children. That's why I became a teacher.
sentences.translationZh: 我喜歡孩子。這就是為什麼我成為了教師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我喜欢孩子。这就是为什么我成为了教师。

sentences.text: I like swimming, but I don't like to swim here.
sentences.translationZh: 我喜歡游泳，但我不想在這裡遊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我喜欢游泳，但我不想在这里游。

sentences.text: I live near the sea so I often go to the beach.
sentences.translationZh: 我住在海邊所以經常去海灘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我住在海边所以经常去海滩。

sentences.text: I ran as fast as possible to catch up with him.
sentences.translationZh: 我盡力追趕他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我盡力追趕他。

sentences.text: I recognized some of the tunes that Tom played.
sentences.translationZh: 我認出了些湯姆演奏的調子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认出了些汤姆演奏的调子。

sentences.text: I stayed home all day instead of going to work.
sentences.translationZh: 我沒有去工作，在家裡待了一整天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我没有去工作，在家里待了一整天。

sentences.text: I suspect they water down the beer in that pub.
sentences.translationZh: 我懷疑那家酒館的啤酒兌水了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

sentences.text: I took it for granted that you were on my side.
sentences.translationZh: 我理所當然認為你會站在我這邊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我理所當然認為你會站在我這邊。

sentences.text: I would like to sit in the non-smoking section.
sentences.translationZh: 我想坐在無煙區。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想坐在无烟区。

sentences.text: I'm glad that I didn't buy something like this.
sentences.translationZh: 我很高興沒有買這樣的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很高兴没有买这样的东西。

sentences.text: I'm sure Tom won't have any trouble finding us.
sentences.translationZh: 我確定湯姆找到我們沒有任何問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我确定汤姆找到我们没有任何问题。

sentences.text: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.
sentences.translationZh: 我壓力好大，我真想哭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我壓力好大，我真想哭。

sentences.text: If I had taken that plane, I would be dead now.
sentences.translationZh: 要是我坐了那架飛機的話，我現在早就死了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是我坐了那架飞机的话，我现在早就死了。

sentences.text: If he knew her phone number, he could call her.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他知道她的電話，他會打給她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他知道她的电话，他会打给她。

sentences.text: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to the picnic.
sentences.translationZh: 如果明天下雨的話，我就不去野餐了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果明天下雨的话，我就不去野餐了。

sentences.text: If she had married you, she would be happy now.
sentences.translationZh: 如果她和你結婚了，她現在會很幸福。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果她和你结婚了，她现在会很幸福。

sentences.text: If you eat that much, you'll get a stomachache.
sentences.translationZh: 那麼吃的話，肚子會吃壞的噢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那么吃的话，肚子会吃坏的噢。

sentences.text: In a way you're right, but I still have doubts.
sentences.translationZh: 在某種程度上你是對的，但我還是有疑問。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。

sentences.text: Is there anything you want that you don't have?
sentences.translationZh: 有什麼你想要但是沒有的東西嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 有什么你想要但是没有的东西吗？

sentences.text: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
sentences.translationZh: 這個梯子是否足夠堅固以承受我的重量？
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？

sentences.text: It cost him 50 dollars to rent a car in Hawaii.
sentences.translationZh: 他花了50美元在夏威夷租了一輛汽車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他花了50美元在夏威夷租了一辆汽车。

sentences.text: It has always been a pleasure to work with you.
sentences.translationZh: 跟你共事總是很愉快。
sentences.translationOriginal: 跟你共事总是很愉快。

sentences.text: It is a pity that you cannot come to the party.
sentences.translationZh: 很遺憾您不能來派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很遗憾您不能来派对。

sentences.text: It was a bag that I lost in the room yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 它是我昨天遺失在房裡的包。
sentences.translationOriginal: 它是我昨天遺失在房裡的包。

sentences.text: It was very kind of you to lend me an umbrella.
sentences.translationZh: 你借給我傘真好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你借给我伞真好。

sentences.text: Like it or not, we have to attend that meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 不管喜不喜歡，我們都得參加那個會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管喜不喜歡，我們都得參加那個會議。

sentences.text: May I be the first to offer my congratulations.
sentences.translationZh: 或許我是第一個給你祝賀的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 或许我是第一个给你祝贺的人。

sentences.text: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
sentences.translationZh: 越來越多的人遷往鄉村。
sentences.translationOriginal: 越來越多的人遷往鄉村。

sentences.text: My sister can play the piano better than I can.
sentences.translationZh: 我妹妹鋼琴可以彈得比我好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我妹妹鋼琴可以彈得比我好。

sentences.text: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
sentences.translationZh: 收音機廣播充斥著有關最近爆炸的新聞。
sentences.translationOriginal: 收音機廣播充斥著有關最近爆炸的新聞。

sentences.text: One million people lost their lives in the war.
sentences.translationZh: 100萬人在戰爭中失去了生命。
sentences.translationOriginal: 100万人在战争中失去了生命。

sentences.text: Please give me some advice on what I should do.
sentences.translationZh: 請給我提提建議，我該做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请给我提提建议，我该做什么。

sentences.text: Please turn off the light before you go to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 上床睡覺之前請關燈。
sentences.translationOriginal: 上床睡觉之前请关灯。

sentences.text: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 價錢是10年前的2倍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 价钱是10年前的2倍。

sentences.text: Prices are double what they were two years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 價格是兩年前的兩倍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 價格是兩年前的兩倍。

sentences.text: She devoted her life to working among the poor.
sentences.translationZh: 她一生致力於為窮人工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一生致力于为穷人工作。

sentences.text: She said that she gets up at six every morning.
sentences.translationZh: 她說她每天早上六點起床。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她说她每天早上六点起床。

sentences.text: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.
sentences.translationZh: 她休假期間花了一大筆錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。

sentences.text: She succeeded in getting him to tell the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 她成功地從他口中得知了真相。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。

sentences.text: The baby was sound asleep in her mother's arms.
sentences.translationZh: 孩子在母親的懷中熟睡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孩子在母亲的怀中熟睡。

sentences.text: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.
sentences.translationZh: 小女孩害怕從屋頂上跳下來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。

sentences.text: The house I bought is pretty far from downtown.
sentences.translationZh: 我買的房子離市中心比較遠。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我買的房子離市中心比較遠。

sentences.text: The leaves will turn red in two or three weeks.
sentences.translationZh: 再過兩三週，樹葉就會變紅吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 再过两三周，树叶就会变红吧。

sentences.text: The man is loading the moving truck on his own.
sentences.translationZh: 這個男人獨自把東西搬上搬家卡車上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這個男人獨自把東西搬上搬家卡車上。

sentences.text: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
sentences.translationZh: 在那兒看報紙的男人是我叔叔。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。

sentences.text: The older we become, the worse our memory gets.
sentences.translationZh: 我們越老，記憶力就越差。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们越老，记忆力就越差。

sentences.text: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
sentences.translationZh: 他們到逹的確切時間還不知道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們到逹的確切時間還不知道。

sentences.text: The space race was an exciting time in history.
sentences.translationZh: 太空跑步是歷史上激動人心的時刻。
sentences.translationOriginal: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。

sentences.text: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
sentences.translationZh: 無可否認她非常有能力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无可否认她非常有能力。

sentences.text: There was nothing that I could do at that time.
sentences.translationZh: 當時我什麼都不能做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当时我什么都不能做。

sentences.text: They buried him in the graveyard by the church.
sentences.translationZh: 他們把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓園。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓園。

sentences.text: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
sentences.translationZh: 這地毯在質量上比那個好得多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。

sentences.text: Tom added both his and Mary's name to the list.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆將他自己和瑪麗的名字添加到了名單上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆将他自己和玛丽的名字添加到了名单上。

sentences.text: Tom begged his father to buy him a new bicycle.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆求他父親給他買新自行車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆求他父親給他買新自行車。

sentences.text: Tom came over to my house for dinner yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆昨天來我家吃晚飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆昨天来我家吃晚饭。

sentences.text: Tom checked the TV schedule to see what was on.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆檢查電視時間表，看看在上映什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆检查电视时间表，看看在上映什么。

sentences.text: Tom did better this time than he did last time.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆這次做得比上次好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆这次做得比上次好。

sentences.text: Tom didn't let his children go to Mary's party.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有讓他的孩子們去瑪莉的派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆沒有讓他的孩子們去瑪莉的派對。

sentences.text: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 在傳給瑪麗之前，湯姆把紙條折了起來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在传给玛丽之前，汤姆把纸条折了起来。

sentences.text: Tom has no friends who are willing to help him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有願意幫助他的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没有愿意帮助他的朋友。

sentences.text: Tom hasn't yet told us what he wants us to buy.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆還沒對我們說他希望我們買什麼呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆还没对我们说他希望我们买什么呢。

sentences.text: Tom is trying to figure out how to do that now.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆現在正在想辦法去做那件事
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆现在正在想办法去做那件事

sentences.text: Tom is used to getting up early in the morning.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆習慣早起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆习惯早起。

sentences.text: Tom isn't doing what he's supposed to be doing.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有做他該做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆沒有做他該做的事。

sentences.text: Tom knows you better than he knows anyone else.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆對你的瞭解比對其他人都清楚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆對你的瞭解比對其他人都清楚。

sentences.text: Tom might be here by 2:30, but then, maybe not.
sentences.translationZh: tom 兩點半可能會到，不過，也可能不會
sentences.translationOriginal: tom 两点半可能会到，不过，也可能不会

sentences.text: Tom said he wasn't sure what Mary wanted to do.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他不確定瑪麗想做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他不确定玛丽想做什么。

sentences.text: Tom sketched a picture of an elephant for Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆給瑪麗畫了大象的素描。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆给玛丽画了大象的素描。

sentences.text: Tom tried to convince Mary to knit him a scarf.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想說服瑪麗給他織一條圍巾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆想說服瑪麗給他織一條圍巾。

sentences.text: Tom was the one that told us about the problem.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是告訴我們問題的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆是告訴我們問題的人。

sentences.text: Tom worked very hard and earned a lot of money.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆努力工作掙了好多錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆努力工作挣了好多钱。

sentences.text: We are having a serious talk about your future.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在嚴肅地談論你的未來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。

sentences.text: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.
sentences.translationZh: 我們養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和六隻雞。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们养了两只狗、三只猫和六只鸡。

sentences.text: We need to talk about that as soon as possible.
sentences.translationZh: 我們需要盡早談論那件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們需要盡早談論那件事。

sentences.text: We promised to stand by him in case of trouble.
sentences.translationZh: 我們承諾萬一他有麻煩的時候支持他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們承諾萬一他有麻煩的時候支持他。

sentences.text: We were just talking about you when you called.
sentences.translationZh: 當你打電話來時, 我們正在談論你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你打電話來時, 我們正在談論你。

sentences.text: We'll have lived here for two years next April.
sentences.translationZh: 到明年四月我們住在這兒就滿兩年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 到明年四月我们住在这儿就满两年了。

sentences.text: What souvenir do you think she would like most?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得她最想要什麼紀念品？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得她最想要什么纪念品？

sentences.text: What time was it when you entered the building?
sentences.translationZh: 你進這幢樓的時候是幾點？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你进这幢楼的时候是几点？

sentences.text: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
sentences.translationZh: 你有100萬美元的話，你會做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有100万美元的话，你会做什么？

sentences.text: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
sentences.translationZh: 當你提出一個問題，你期望得到答案。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你提出一個問題，你期望得到答案。

sentences.text: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
sentences.translationZh: 每次聽到這首歌，都會讓我回憶起自己年輕的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

sentences.text: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?
sentences.translationZh: 今天下午你想去動物園嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天下午你想去動物園嗎?

sentences.text: You don't need to be afraid of making mistakes.
sentences.translationZh: 你們不需要害怕犯錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你们不需要害怕犯错。

sentences.text: You had better take an umbrella with you today.
sentences.translationZh: 你今天最好隨身帶把傘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你今天最好隨身帶把傘。

sentences.text: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
sentences.translationZh: 你該把你的值錢物品保存在一個安全的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。

sentences.text: You should set a good example to your children.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該給你的孩子們樹立好的榜樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好的榜样。

sentences.text: You'll get used to this in three or four weeks.
sentences.translationZh: 你在三或四周內會習慣這個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在三或四周内会习惯这个。

sentences.text: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
sentences.translationZh: 在面試的時候你必須見機行事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在面試的時候你必須見機行事。

sentences.text: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。

sentences.text: About how long will it take to get there by bus?
sentences.translationZh: 搭公車到那裡大約要花多久的時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 搭公車到那裡大約要花多久的時間？

sentences.text: An old man was resting in the shade of the tree.
sentences.translationZh: 一個老人在樹蔭下休息。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個老人在樹蔭下休息。

sentences.text: Are you closer to your mother or to your father?
sentences.translationZh: 你和爸爸更親還是媽媽更親？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你和爸爸更亲还是妈妈更亲？

sentences.text: Are you planning on eating that all by yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算自己一人把它全部吃了吗？

sentences.text: As long as you are here, we might as well begin.
sentences.translationZh: 既然你在這裡, 那我們就開始吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 既然你在這裡, 那我們就開始吧。

sentences.text: Between you and me, what is your opinion of her?
sentences.translationZh: 你就只告訴我一個人，你對她的意見如何？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你就只告诉我一个人，你对她的意见如何？

sentences.text: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
sentences.translationZh: 早飯是一天中最重要的一頓飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 早饭是一天中最重要的一顿饭。

sentences.text: By the way, did you hear that Mary quit her job?
sentences.translationZh: 話說，你聽說瑪麗辭職了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 话说，你听说玛丽辞职了吗？

sentences.text: Can you tell me how to get to the train station?
sentences.translationZh: 你可以告訴我如何到火車站嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以告訴我如何到火車站嗎?

sentences.text: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
sentences.translationZh: 能否請你說慢一點?
sentences.translationOriginal: 能否請你說慢一點?

sentences.text: Could you please tell me again why you are late?
sentences.translationZh: 你能再向我解釋一遍你為什麼遲到了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能再向我解释一遍你为什么迟到了吗？

sentences.text: Did you have any difficulty in finding my house?
sentences.translationZh: 你找我的房子有困難嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你找我的房子有困難嗎？

sentences.text: Do you know if my father is still in the office?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道我父親是否還在辦公室嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道我父親是否還在辦公室嗎？

sentences.text: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
sentences.translationZh: 除了鋼琴以外，還會玩什麼樂器嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

sentences.text: Do you think you could make a little less noise?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得你能少發點噪音嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得你能少发点噪音吗？

sentences.text: English is a language spoken all over the world.
sentences.translationZh: 英語是一種全世界通用的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英語是一種全世界通用的語言。

sentences.text: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管有金錢和名譽，他還是不幸福。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。

sentences.text: Every time I went to his place, he was studying.
sentences.translationZh: 每次我去他住處，他都在讀書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每次我去他住處，他都在讀書。

sentences.text: Everyone but Tom knew he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Give a thief enough rope and he'll hang himself.
sentences.translationZh: 多行不義必自斃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 多行不义必自毙。

sentences.text: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
sentences.translationZh: 他打著見我的幌子來了我家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

sentences.text: He demanded that I should pay the money at once.
sentences.translationZh: 他要求我馬上付錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他要求我马上付钱。

sentences.text: He hasn't come yet. He must have missed the bus.
sentences.translationZh: 他還沒來。他肯定錯過公交車了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他还没来。他肯定错过公交车了。

sentences.text: He is on goods terms with all of his classmates.
sentences.translationZh: 他和他所有的同學相處融洽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。

sentences.text: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
sentences.translationZh: 他在醫學界有很大的影響力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

sentences.text: He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.
sentences.translationZh: 他給自己定下每天早上散步的規矩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他给自己定下每天早上散步的规矩。

sentences.text: He said he was tired, so he would go home early.
sentences.translationZh: 他說他累了，所以他想早點回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他说他累了，所以他想早点回家。

sentences.text: He wishes he had gone to the theater last night.
sentences.translationZh: 昨晚他希望他去了劇場。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨晚他希望他去了剧场。

sentences.text: His mother sat up all night waiting for her son.
sentences.translationZh: 他的媽媽坐了一整夜，等她的兒子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的妈妈坐了一整夜，等她的儿子。

sentences.text: How long did it take you to translate this book?
sentences.translationZh: 你用了多少時間來翻譯這本書？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你用了多少时间来翻译这本书？

sentences.text: How long do you plan on staying in this country?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算在這個國家待多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算在这个国家待多久？

sentences.text: How long would it take to swim across the river?
sentences.translationZh: 遊過這條河要多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 游过这条河要多久？

sentences.text: I can't go with you today because I'm very busy.
sentences.translationZh: 今天我太忙了，沒法和你一起去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天我太忙了，没法和你一起去。

sentences.text: I did that, even though I didn't really need to.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管我並不是真的需要這樣做，我還是做了
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管我并不是真的需要这样做，我还是做了

sentences.text: I didn't expect to see you at a place like this.
sentences.translationZh: 我都沒想過會在這裡碰見你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我都没想过会在这里碰见你。

sentences.text: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.
sentences.translationZh: 他們說了什麼，我並不注意。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们说了什么，我并不注意。

sentences.text: I don't even know if Tom went to college or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我甚至不知道湯姆有沒有上過大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我甚至不知道汤姆有没有上过大学。

sentences.text: I don't mind if you go to bed before I get home.
sentences.translationZh: 我不介意你在我回到家之前先去睡覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不介意你在我回到家之前先去睡觉。

sentences.text: I don't think he'll be able to do it by himself.
sentences.translationZh: 我不覺得他自己一個人會做到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不觉得他自己一个人会做到。

sentences.text: I don't think it's going to be easy to find Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為，要找到湯姆可不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为，要找到汤姆可不容易。

sentences.text: I find it hard to get up early on cold mornings.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得在寒冷的早晨很難早起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我覺得在寒冷的早晨很難早起。

sentences.text: I found it best to say nothing about the matter.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得什麼都不說是最好的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得什么都不说是最好的。

sentences.text: I have a friend whose father is a famous writer.
sentences.translationZh: 我有個朋友的父親是知名的作家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有個朋友的父親是知名的作家。

sentences.text: I hope everything will turn out well in the end.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望最後一切都好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望最后一切都好。

sentences.text: I know an English teacher who comes from Canada.
sentences.translationZh: 我認識一個加拿大來的英語教師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认识一个加拿大来的英语教师。

sentences.text: I often slept on that bench when I was homeless.
sentences.translationZh: 當我無家可歸的時候，我常在那張長椅上睡覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我无家可归的时候，我常在那张长椅上睡觉。

sentences.text: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
sentences.translationZh: 我經常使用SSH來遠程連接到我的電腦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。

sentences.text: I passed the city hall on my way to the station.
sentences.translationZh: 我去車站的路上路過了市政廳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我去車站的路上路過了市政廳。

sentences.text: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆不太可能會當選。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

sentences.text: I think that it's unlikely Tom will get elected.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆不太可能會當選。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

sentences.text: I want to get a haircut before I go on the trip.
sentences.translationZh: 我想在出發旅行前剪個頭髮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想在出發旅行前剪個頭髮。

sentences.text: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 不知道明天天氣會怎麼樣呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 不知道明天天气会怎么样呢？

sentences.text: I wonder where Tom is planning to go to college.
sentences.translationZh: 我想知道湯姆計劃去哪裡上大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想知道汤姆计划去哪里上大学。

sentences.text: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.
sentences.translationZh: 我很疑惑為什麼天氣變冷的時候我會覺得很孤單。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。

sentences.text: I'd like to leave this town and never come back.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望離開這個村子並且再也不要回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望離開這個村子並且再也不要回來。

sentences.text: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
sentences.translationZh: 恐怕就這點上，我和你持不同意見。
sentences.translationOriginal: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。

sentences.text: I'm sorry I don't agree with you on that matter.
sentences.translationZh: 很抱歉那個問題我不贊成你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。

sentences.text: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
sentences.translationZh: 我對自己的作為很內疚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我對自己的作為很內疚。

sentences.text: I've been looking for a new job for a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我找工作已經很久了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我找工作已经很久了。

sentences.text: If I had one million yen now, I would buy a car.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我現在有100萬日元，我會買輛車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我现在有100万日元，我会买辆车。

sentences.text: If her temperature goes up, send for the doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 如果她的體溫上升, 派人去請醫生來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果她的體溫上升, 派人去請醫生來。

sentences.text: If it's raining tomorrow, we'll go there by car.
sentences.translationZh: 如果明天下雨，我們就坐車去那兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果明天下雨，我们就坐车去那儿。

sentences.text: If you eat that much, you'll have a stomachache.
sentences.translationZh: 那麼吃的話，肚子會吃壞的噢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那么吃的话，肚子会吃坏的噢。

sentences.text: If you had a million dollars, what would you do?
sentences.translationZh: 你有100萬美元的話，你會做什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有100万美元的话，你会做什么？

sentences.text: It is an advantage to be able to use a computer.
sentences.translationZh: 會用電腦是一個好處。
sentences.translationOriginal: 會用電腦是一個好處。

sentences.text: It is necessary for you to go there immediately.
sentences.translationZh: 你必需馬上去那兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必需马上去那儿。

sentences.text: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
sentences.translationZh: 對一個科學家來說，多愁善感是不好的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 對一個科學家來說，多愁善感是不好的。

sentences.text: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
sentences.translationZh: 據說這個區域埋著財寶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。

sentences.text: It may sound strange, but what she said is true.
sentences.translationZh: 聽起來或許有點怪，但她說的是真的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 聽起來或許有點怪，但她說的是真的。

sentences.text: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
sentences.translationZh: 您那樣做的話，可就幫到我了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 您那样做的话，可就帮到我了。

sentences.text: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
sentences.translationZh: 花光他們所有的錢會很荒謬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 花光他們所有的錢會很荒謬。

sentences.text: It's OK to eat the rest of the cake if you want.
sentences.translationZh: 你願意的話，可以把剩下的蛋糕也吃了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你愿意的话，可以把剩下的蛋糕也吃了。

sentences.text: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
sentences.translationZh: 大富翁是一個家庭玩的熱門遊戲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大富翁是一個家庭玩的熱門遊戲。

sentences.text: My father insisted on our waiting for the train.
sentences.translationZh: 我的父親堅持要我們等火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的父親堅持要我們等火車。

sentences.text: My teeth aren't as white as I'd like them to be.
sentences.translationZh: 我的牙齒沒有我希望的那樣白。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的牙齿没有我希望的那样白。

sentences.text: Paris is one of the largest cities in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 巴黎是世界上最大的城市之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 巴黎是世界上最大的城市之一。

sentences.text: Perhaps Tom is too old to do this kind of thing.
sentences.translationZh: 也許Tom年紀太大，不適合做這件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 也許Tom年紀太大，不適合做這件事。

sentences.text: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.
sentences.translationZh: 從月球上看的話，地球看起來像個皮球。
sentences.translationOriginal: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。

sentences.text: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.
sentences.translationZh: 她在從自行車上摔下來時傷到了腳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。

sentences.text: She suggested to me that I call off the meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 她建議我取消會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她建议我取消会议。

sentences.text: She will be glad if you go to see her in person.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你單獨去看她, 她會很高興的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你單獨去看她, 她會很高興的。

sentences.text: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
sentences.translationZh: 先生，那盤CD需要預定才有。
sentences.translationOriginal: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。

sentences.text: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.
sentences.translationZh: 請講慢一點，讓我們能聽懂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。

sentences.text: Tell me about some of the places you've visited.
sentences.translationZh: 給我說說你去過的一些地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 给我说说你去过的一些地方。

sentences.text: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
sentences.translationZh: 法案以10票微弱多數通過。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法案以10票微弱多数通过。

sentences.text: The bus will take you to the center of the city.
sentences.translationZh: 巴士會把你們帶到市中心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 巴士会把你们带到市中心。

sentences.text: The circumstances did not allow me to go abroad.
sentences.translationZh: 情況不允許我出國。
sentences.translationOriginal: 情况不允许我出国。

sentences.text: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
sentences.translationZh: 法庭對他的謀殺罪名作出了無罪判決。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

sentences.text: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.
sentences.translationZh: 醫生告訴她要靜養。
sentences.translationOriginal: 医生告诉她要静养。

sentences.text: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
sentences.translationZh: 馬停了下來，而且拒絕移動。
sentences.translationOriginal: 馬停了下來，而且拒絕移動。

sentences.text: The minimum wage in Okinawa is 642 yen per hour.
sentences.translationZh: 沖繩的最低時薪是每小時642日元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 冲绳的最低时薪是每小时642日元。

sentences.text: The money you give them will be put to good use.
sentences.translationZh: 你給他們的錢會用到好處。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你给他们的钱会用到好处。

sentences.text: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
sentences.translationZh: 問題是, 太陽能太貴了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 問題是, 太陽能太貴了。

sentences.text: The teacher has a great influence on his pupils.
sentences.translationZh: 這個教授對他的學生有很大的影響力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个教授对他的学生有很大的影响力。

sentences.text: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
sentences.translationZh: 天氣又冷又溼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天气又冷又湿。

sentences.text: The weatherman says there is a storm on the way.
sentences.translationZh: 氣象學家說會有暴風雨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 气象学家说会有暴风雨。

sentences.text: There is a man at the door who wants to see you.
sentences.translationZh: 門口有個男人想見你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 门口有个男人想见你。

sentences.text: These three pretty girls are all nieces of mine.
sentences.translationZh: 這三個漂亮的女孩都是我的侄女。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这三个漂亮的女孩都是我的侄女。

sentences.text: This guitar is so expensive that I can't buy it.
sentences.translationZh: 這吉他太貴了，我沒法買下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这吉他太贵了，我没法买下。

sentences.text: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 這是一個你必須自己解決的問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。

sentences.text: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
sentences.translationZh: 孩子在這條河裡游泳太危險了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孩子在这条河里游泳太危险了。

sentences.text: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
sentences.translationZh: 這條毛巾蓬鬆又柔軟，特別舒服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

sentences.text: Tom and I have known each other for a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和我相識很久了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆和我相識很久了。

sentences.text: Tom began to learn French about three years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆大約三年前開始學法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆大约三年前开始学法语。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't have any idea why his wife left him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆根本不明白為甚麼他的妻子離開了他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆根本不明白為甚麼他的妻子離開了他。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't like women who wear too much makeup.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不喜歡妝化太濃的女人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不喜欢妆化太浓的女人。

sentences.text: Tom has been on the wanted list for three years.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆已經上通緝令三年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆已经上通缉令三年了。

sentences.text: Tom is looking for someone to take Mary's place.
sentences.translationZh: Tom正在找其他人代替Mary。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom正在找其他人代替Mary。

sentences.text: Tom is very good at doing things with his hands.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆善於動手做事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆善于动手做事。

sentences.text: Tom isn't the only one here who's a good singer.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不是這裡唯一的好歌手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不是这里唯一的好歌手。

sentences.text: Tom learned how to do that from his grandfather.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆從他祖父那裡學會了怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆从他祖父那里学会了怎么做。

sentences.text: Tom opened the blinds and looked out the window.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆打開百葉窗，向窗外望去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆打开百叶窗，向窗外望去。

sentences.text: Tom said he wasn't ready, but Mary said she was.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他沒準備好，但瑪麗說她準備好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他没准备好，但玛丽说她准备好了。

sentences.text: Tom still drinks, but not as much as he used to.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆還是喝，但不像以前那麼多了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆还是喝，但不像以前那么多了。

sentences.text: Tom suggested that I change the lock on my door.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆建議我換我的門鎖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆建议我换我的门锁。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary something she didn't want to hear.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴了瑪麗她不想知道的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆告訴了瑪麗她不想知道的事。

sentences.text: Tom was a little overweight when he was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在小時候有點超重。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆在小时候有點超重。

sentences.text: Two months have passed since he left for France.
sentences.translationZh: 自從他離開去法國，已經有兩個月了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 自从他离开去法国，已经有两个月了。

sentences.text: We used to go to the movies on Saturday evening.
sentences.translationZh: 我們曾經總在星期六傍晚去看電影。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们曾经总在星期六傍晚去看电影。

sentences.text: We want to be on the first bus tomorrow morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我們想乘明天早上第一班公交車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们想乘明天早上第一班公交车。

sentences.text: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
sentences.translationZh: 當我還是個孩子的時候，我在這個泳池裡遊過泳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。

sentences.text: When he retired, his son took over the business.
sentences.translationZh: 他退休的時候，他兒子接手了他的生意。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他退休的时候，他儿子接手了他的生意。

sentences.text: While you are reading to me, I can do my sewing.
sentences.translationZh: 你讀給我聽的時候，我就可以做縫紉了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你读给我听的时候，我就可以做缝纫了。

sentences.text: Who will take care of the dog while we are away?
sentences.translationZh: 當我們離開的時候，誰來照顧狗？
sentences.translationOriginal: 當我們離開的時候，誰來照顧狗？

sentences.text: You don't have to tell Tom if you don't want to.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不想，那你便沒有這個必要去告訴湯姆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不想，那你便没有这个必要去告诉汤姆。

sentences.text: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
sentences.translationZh: 你可以選擇紅茶，咖啡或牛奶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。

sentences.text: You look like you've just lost your best friend.
sentences.translationZh: 你看上去就像是剛剛失去了自己最好的朋友似的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看上去就像是刚刚失去了自己最好的朋友似的。

sentences.text: You nearly poked me in the eye with your pencil.
sentences.translationZh: 你的鉛筆差點戳到我的眼睛了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你的鉛筆差點戳到我的眼睛了。

sentences.text: You should set a good example for your children.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該給你的孩子們樹立好榜樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。

sentences.text: You used to be able to see the church from here.
sentences.translationZh: 你以前可以從這裡看到教堂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你以前可以從這裡看到教堂。

sentences.text: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
sentences.translationZh: 你很快就會適應你的新學校。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你很快就会适应你的新学校。

sentences.text: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.
sentences.translationZh: 你會很驚訝你在一週內能學到的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你会很惊讶你在一周内能学到的东西。

sentences.text: You're not old enough to get a driver's license.
sentences.translationZh: 你還沒到可以拿駕駛執照的年齡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你还没到可以拿驾驶执照的年龄。

sentences.text: Did he write a letter yesterday? "Yes, he did."
sentences.translationZh: 他昨天寫了一封信嗎? "是的, 他寫了。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 他昨天寫了一封信嗎? "是的, 他寫了。"

sentences.text: Would you like any more? "No, I've had enough."
sentences.translationZh: 你想再多吃點嗎? "不，我吃飽了。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想再多吃點嗎? "不，我吃飽了。"

sentences.text: A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
sentences.translationZh: 理髮師是為男人刮鬍子和剪頭髮的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 理髮師是為男人刮鬍子和剪頭髮的人。

sentences.text: A doctor told me that eating eggs was bad for me.
sentences.translationZh: 一位醫生告訴過我，吃雞蛋對我的健康有害。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一位医生告诉过我，吃鸡蛋对我的健康有害。

sentences.text: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.
sentences.translationZh: 我的一位朋友要求我寄給她一張明信片。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的一位朋友要求我寄給她一張明信片。

sentences.text: A great number of books are published every year.
sentences.translationZh: 每年都有大量新書出版。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每年都有大量新书出版。

sentences.text: After you have read it, give the book back to me.
sentences.translationZh: 在你讀完後，把書還給我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在你讀完後，把書還給我。

sentences.text: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
sentences.translationZh: 突然間她開始用尖銳的聲音大喊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 突然間她開始用尖銳的聲音大喊。

sentences.text: Are you planning to be at Tom and Mary's wedding?
sentences.translationZh: 你打算參加湯姆和瑪麗的婚禮嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你打算参加汤姆和玛丽的婚礼吗？

sentences.text: Aren't you coming to pick me up tomorrow morning?
sentences.translationZh: 你明天早上不來接我嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你明天早上不来接我吗？

sentences.text: As far as I know, your letter is under that book.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，你的信在那本書下面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 據我所知，你的信在那本書下面。

sentences.text: As soon as I get to London, I'll drop you a line.
sentences.translationZh: 我一到倫敦就會給你留言的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一到伦敦就会给你留言的。

sentences.text: As soon as she wakes up, we'll turn on the music.
sentences.translationZh: 她一醒，我們就放音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一醒，我们就放音乐。

sentences.text: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
sentences.translationZh: 金窩銀窩不如自己的狗窩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

sentences.text: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你有上司的話，學會尊敬他（她）。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。

sentences.text: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
sentences.translationZh: 我們成親家了, 因為我們的孩子們結婚了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們成親家了, 因為我們的孩子們結婚了。

sentences.text: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
sentences.translationZh: 你檢查購物單上所有的項目了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你检查购物单上所有的项目了吗？

sentences.text: Do you know whether or not she can speak English?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道她是否會講英語嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道她是否會講英語嗎？

sentences.text: Do you play any instruments other than the piano?
sentences.translationZh: 除了鋼琴以外，還會玩什麼樂器嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

sentences.text: Don't pay any attention to what your father says.
sentences.translationZh: 別在意你父親說的話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 别在意你父亲说的话。

sentences.text: Even when I was a child, I was able to swim well.
sentences.translationZh: 我很小的時候就遊得很好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很小的时候就游得很好了。

sentences.text: Everybody but Tom knew he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Father ran short of money and had to borrow some.
sentences.translationZh: 父親缺錢，所以他必須去借點錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 父親缺錢，所以他必須去借點錢。

sentences.text: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.
sentences.translationZh: 他和他的姐妹們目前都住在東京。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。

sentences.text: He cannot afford to buy a car, much less a house.
sentences.translationZh: 他買不起一輛汽車，更不要說一套房子了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他买不起一辆汽车，更不要说一套房子了。

sentences.text: He could not come because of his serious illness.
sentences.translationZh: 他因為生重病不能來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他因為生重病不能來。

sentences.text: He doesn't know how to write a letter in English.
sentences.translationZh: 他不知道如何用英語寫信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不知道如何用英语写信。

sentences.text: He failed the exam, but he doesn't care too much.
sentences.translationZh: 他考試失敗了，但他不太在意。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他考试失败了，但他不太在意。

sentences.text: He once knew her, but they are no longer friends.
sentences.translationZh: 他過去認識她，但他們現在不再是朋友了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他过去认识她，但他们现在不再是朋友了。

sentences.text: He returned home for the first time in ten years.
sentences.translationZh: 他十年中第一次回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他十年中第一次回家。

sentences.text: He said he did not know the man, which was a lie.
sentences.translationZh: 他說他不認識那個男人，這是一個謊言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他說他不認識那個男人，這是一個謊言。

sentences.text: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
sentences.translationZh: 他應該為自己對客人的粗魯無禮而道歉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

sentences.text: He would often come to see us when I was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 當我還是個孩子時，他經常來看望我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當我還是個孩子時，他經常來看望我們。

sentences.text: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
sentences.translationZh: 他的急脾氣遲早會惹禍上身。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。

sentences.text: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
sentences.translationZh: 你為什麼知道這麼多的日本歷史?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你為什麼知道這麼多的日本歷史?

sentences.text: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?
sentences.translationZh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少錢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？

sentences.text: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
sentences.translationZh: 我承認這可能不是最好的方法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

sentences.text: I can't get at the exact meaning of the sentence.
sentences.translationZh: 我抓不到句子的確切含義。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我抓不到句子的确切含义。

sentences.text: I don't care what color ink, just bring me a pen.
sentences.translationZh: 顏色無所謂，給我一支筆就行了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 颜色无所谓，给我一支笔就行了。

sentences.text: I don't know what to say to make you feel better.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道該說什麼來安慰你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道该说什么来安慰你。

sentences.text: I don't know whether Tom will eat with us or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道Tom是否和我們一起吃飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道Tom是否和我们一起吃饭。

sentences.text: I don't think Tom will go to Boston next weekend.
sentences.translationZh: 我不認為湯姆下週會去波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不認為湯姆下週會去波士頓。

sentences.text: I have to write a letter. Do you have some paper?
sentences.translationZh: 我需要寫一封信。你有紙嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我需要写一封信。你有纸吗？

sentences.text: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望在六十歲時退休。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望在六十歲時退休。

sentences.text: I miss you. I need to see you. Could I come over?
sentences.translationZh: 我想你。我需要見你。我能來嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想你。我需要见你。我能来吗？

sentences.text: I ran as fast as I could, but I missed the train.
sentences.translationZh: 我用盡全力跑，但我還是沒趕上火車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我用盡全力跑，但我還是沒趕上火車。

sentences.text: I read the book after I had finished my homework.
sentences.translationZh: 我做完我的功課後，就讀這本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。

sentences.text: I really like him, but not his circle of friends.
sentences.translationZh: 我真的很喜歡他, 可是我不喜歡他周圍的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我真的很喜歡他, 可是我不喜歡他周圍的朋友。

sentences.text: I talked to him on the telephone yesterday night.
sentences.translationZh: 我昨晚跟他通電話了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我昨晚跟他通电话了。

sentences.text: I thought that Tom would want to know about that.
sentences.translationZh: 我本以為湯姆願意瞭解這件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我本以为汤姆愿意了解这件事。

sentences.text: I want a boat that'll take me far away from here.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要一艘船帶我遠離這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。

sentences.text: I want to clean the house before my parents come.
sentences.translationZh: 我想在我父母來之前收拾乾淨屋子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。

sentences.text: I want you to understand why you have to do this.
sentences.translationZh: 我想讓你明白為啥你必須這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想让你明白为啥你必须这么做。

sentences.text: I will never forget the day when I first met him.
sentences.translationZh: 我永遠不會忘記那天我第一次與他見面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我永远不会忘记那天我第一次与他见面。

sentences.text: I'm going to stop trying to be friendly with you.
sentences.translationZh: 我不跟你要好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不跟你要好了。

sentences.text: I'm hungry, so I'm going to get something to eat.
sentences.translationZh: 我餓了，所以我要吃東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我餓了，所以我要吃東西。

sentences.text: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my book.
sentences.translationZh: 我什麼地方都找過了, 但卻找不到我的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我什麼地方都找過了, 但卻找不到我的書。

sentences.text: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.
sentences.translationZh: 如果可能的話，我想環遊世界。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果可能的话，我想环游世界。

sentences.text: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll give you a kiss.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你買給我冰淇淋，我就親你一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你買給我冰淇淋，我就親你一下。

sentences.text: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
sentences.translationZh: 在這種情況下，形容詞放在名詞前面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。

sentences.text: Is it true that you built this house by yourself?
sentences.translationZh: 你真是自己造了這棟房子嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真是自己造了这栋房子吗？

sentences.text: It appears that she had a nice time at the party.
sentences.translationZh: 看來她似乎在派對上玩得很開心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看來她似乎在派對上玩得很開心。

sentences.text: It is not necessary for us to attend the meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 我們沒有必要參加會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們沒有必要參加會議。

sentences.text: It seems that you aren't having a good time here.
sentences.translationZh: 好像你們在這兒玩得不愉快啊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 好像你们在这儿玩得不愉快啊。

sentences.text: It seems that you're not having a good time here.
sentences.translationZh: 好像你們在這兒玩得不愉快啊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 好像你们在这儿玩得不愉快啊。

sentences.text: It took me half an hour to work out this problem.
sentences.translationZh: 我花了一個半小時的時間解決這個問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我花了一個半小時的時間解決這個問題。

sentences.text: It was ten years ago that he first came to Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 他第一次來到日本是在十年前。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他第一次來到日本是在十年前。

sentences.text: It would've been better if you'd stayed with Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你和Tom呆在一起，結果會更好
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你和Tom呆在一起，结果会更好

sentences.text: It's convenient for me to see you at ten tonight.
sentences.translationZh: 我今晚10點見你比較方便。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今晚10点见你比较方便。

sentences.text: London, the capital of England, is on the Thames.
sentences.translationZh: 英國首都倫敦在泰晤士河畔。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英国首都伦敦在泰晤士河畔。

sentences.text: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.
sentences.translationZh: 人是唯一會使用火的動物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。

sentences.text: My brother is not as tall as I was two years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 我弟弟沒我兩年前高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我弟弟没我两年前高。

sentences.text: My father will come home at the end of this week.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸會在這週末回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。

sentences.text: My first day in the university was rather boring.
sentences.translationZh: 我大學裡的第一天相當沒意思。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。

sentences.text: My train left at 7 and arrived in New York at 10.
sentences.translationZh: 我乘的火車7點出發，10點到了紐約。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我乘的火车7点出发，10点到了纽约。

sentences.text: Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.
sentences.translationZh: 海王星是太陽系第八個行星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海王星是太阳系第八个行星。

sentences.text: No matter what happens, I'm not changing my mind.
sentences.translationZh: 無論如何，我不會改變我的想法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 無論如何，我不會改變我的想法。

sentences.text: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
sentences.translationZh: 我們的數學老師在黑板上畫了一個圓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。

sentences.text: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.
sentences.translationZh: 就像你們知道的那樣，毅力是成功的關鍵。
sentences.translationOriginal: 就像你们知道的那样，毅力是成功的关键。

sentences.text: She followed him home to find out where he lived.
sentences.translationZh: 她跟他到家，以知道他住哪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她跟他到家，以知道他住哪。

sentences.text: She gives me a nasty look every time she sees me.
sentences.translationZh: 她每次看見我都給露出厭惡的眼神。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她每次看見我都給露出厭惡的眼神。

sentences.text: She lost her father when she was three years old.
sentences.translationZh: 她父親在她三歲時死了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她父亲在她三岁时死了。

sentences.text: She told me that she would go to Paris in August.
sentences.translationZh: 她跟我說八月份她會去巴黎。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她跟我说八月份她会去巴黎。

sentences.text: She was asked to convince him to paint the house.
sentences.translationZh: 她被要求說服他油漆房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她被要求说服他油漆房子。

sentences.text: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
sentences.translationZh: 她遇到了麻煩，因為她弄丟了她的護照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她遇到了麻煩，因為她弄丟了她的護照。

sentences.text: Starting tomorrow, it's going to snow for a week.
sentences.translationZh: 雪從明天開始下，一直持續一個星期。
sentences.translationOriginal: 雪从明天开始下，一直持续一个星期。

sentences.text: Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
sentences.translationZh: 草莓在冬天售價高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 草莓在冬天售價高。

sentences.text: That's the computer he used to write the article.
sentences.translationZh: 那就是那臺他用來寫文章的電腦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。

sentences.text: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
sentences.translationZh: 海灘是一個供孩子們玩樂的理想場所。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。

sentences.text: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
sentences.translationZh: 那家公司在廣告上花了很多錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。

sentences.text: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
sentences.translationZh: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

sentences.text: The flood water reached the level of the windows.
sentences.translationZh: 洪水湧到了窗戶的高度。
sentences.translationOriginal: 洪水涌到了窗户的高度。

sentences.text: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
sentences.translationZh: 那房子因為其少有的形狀被突顯出來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。

sentences.text: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
sentences.translationZh: 這個可憐的年輕人最後成為了一個了不起的藝術家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个可怜的年轻人最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。

sentences.text: The problem was that I had nothing to say to him.
sentences.translationZh: 問題是 我沒什麼要跟他說的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 问题是 我没什么要跟他说的。

sentences.text: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
sentences.translationZh: 強風暗示著即將到來的暴雨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 強風暗示著即將到來的暴雨。

sentences.text: The time has come when I must tell you the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 現在是我必須告訴你真相的時候了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 現在是我必須告訴你真相的時候了。

sentences.text: The weather was so cold that the lake froze over.
sentences.translationZh: 天冷得足以讓湖結冰。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天冷得足以让湖结冰。

sentences.text: There are a few apples on the tree, aren't there?
sentences.translationZh: 樹上有些蘋果，不是嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 树上有些苹果，不是吗？

sentences.text: There are seven men and four women in my section.
sentences.translationZh: 在我的部門裡有七男四女。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

sentences.text: There is no reason that I should give up my plan.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有理由讓我放棄我的計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 沒有理由让我放弃我的计划。

sentences.text: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
sentences.translationZh: 他的失敗看來有幾個原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的失败看来有几个原因。

sentences.text: They came up with a plan after a long discussion.
sentences.translationZh: 他們終於在漫長的討論之後得出了一個計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

sentences.text: They will tear down the old building in two days.
sentences.translationZh: 他們將在兩天內拆除這棟舊的建築物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們將在兩天內拆除這棟舊的建築物。

sentences.text: This flower is the most beautiful of all flowers.
sentences.translationZh: 這朵花是所有花中最漂亮的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这朵花是所有花中最漂亮的。

sentences.text: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.
sentences.translationZh: 這臺琴應該好多年沒調過音了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这台琴应该好多年没调过音了。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary went to the best restaurant in town.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗去了鎮上最好的飯店。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和玛丽去了镇上最好的饭店。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't pay much attention to how he dresses.
sentences.translationZh: Tom沒有花費精力去打扮自己。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom没有花费精力去打扮自己。

sentences.text: Tom encouraged Mary to learn how to speak French.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆鼓勵瑪麗學著說法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆鼓励玛丽学着说法语。

sentences.text: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆最近壓力特別大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆最近压力特别大。

sentences.text: Tom is in the living room, sleeping on the couch.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在客廳，躺在長沙發上睡覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在客厅，躺在长沙发上睡觉。

sentences.text: Tom is the one that has been waiting the longest.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是等了最長時間的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆是等了最长时间的人。

sentences.text: Tom often reads when his children aren't at home.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆經常在孩子們不在家時閱讀。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆经常在孩子们不在家时阅读。

sentences.text: Tom said he hasn't decided what needs to be done.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他還沒決定要做甚麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說他還沒決定要做甚麼。

sentences.text: Tom said it was cold in Boston this time of year.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說一年中這時候波士頓很冷。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说一年中这时候波士顿很冷。

sentences.text: Tom tried to catch up with Mary, but he couldn't.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆試圖去追上瑪麗，但是他沒成功。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆试图去追上玛丽，但是他没成功。

sentences.text: Tom wished he hadn't borrowed the book from Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆希望他沒有從瑪麗那裡借書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆希望他没有从玛丽那里借书。

sentences.text: Tom won't even know what you did until it's over.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不到最後不會知道你做了什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不到最后不会知道你做了什么。

sentences.text: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
sentences.translationZh: 友誼緊緊聯繫著我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。

sentences.text: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在市場上買了些蔬菜和魚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们在市场上买了些蔬菜和鱼。

sentences.text: We'll get a phone call from him tonight for sure.
sentences.translationZh: 今晚我們肯定會接到他的電話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今晚我們肯定會接到他的電話。

sentences.text: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.
sentences.translationZh: 聽講座時，你應該保持安靜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。

sentences.text: You are allowed to use the hotel's swimming pool.
sentences.translationZh: 你有權使用旅館的游泳池。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有权使用旅馆的游泳池。

sentences.text: You are free to do as you please with your money.
sentences.translationZh: 你可以隨你高興的用你的錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以隨你高興的用你的錢。

sentences.text: You can ask the child that is playing over there.
sentences.translationZh: 你可以問問在那裡玩的孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以問問在那裡玩的孩子。

sentences.text: You can get from Washington to New York by train.
sentences.translationZh: 你們可以乘火車從華盛頓去紐約。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你们可以乘火车从华盛顿去纽约。

sentences.text: You don't get up as early as your sister, do you?
sentences.translationZh: 你比你妹妹起得晚，不是麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你比你妹妹起得晚，不是么？

sentences.text: You may take either the big box or the small one.
sentences.translationZh: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以拿大的盒子或是小的盒子。

sentences.text: You ought to tell Tom that you'll likely be late.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該告訴湯姆你可能會遲到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你应该告诉汤姆你可能会迟到。

sentences.text: You'll be able to see the difference very easily.
sentences.translationZh: 您很容易就能看出區別。
sentences.translationOriginal: 您很容易就能看出区别。

sentences.text: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
sentences.translationZh: 你還太年輕無法取得駕駛執照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你還太年輕無法取得駕駛執照。

sentences.text: You're the one who decided to do this job, right?
sentences.translationZh: 你是決定做這個工作的那個人，對嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是决定做这个工作的那个人，对吗？

sentences.text: Why aren't you going? "Because I don't want to."
sentences.translationZh: 你為什麼不去？"因為我不想去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你为什么不去？"因为我不想去。

sentences.text: Will he pass the examination? "I am afraid not."
sentences.translationZh: 他會通過考試嗎? "我怕是不會。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 他會通過考試嗎? "我怕是不會。"

sentences.text: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
sentences.translationZh: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林。

sentences.text: A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
sentences.translationZh: 十七歲的男孩常常長得和他父親一樣高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 十七歲的男孩常常長得和他父親一樣高。

sentences.text: A good many people have told me to take a holiday.
sentences.translationZh: 很多人都跟我說要我休假。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很多人都跟我說要我休假。

sentences.text: A good neighbour is better than a brother far off.
sentences.translationZh: 一個好鄰居勝於一個遙遠的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個好鄰居勝於一個遙遠的朋友。

sentences.text: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
sentences.translationZh: 綠色的毯子和這條藍色的簾子不配。
sentences.translationOriginal: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

sentences.text: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
sentences.translationZh: 新的分店下個月在芝加哥開張。
sentences.translationOriginal: 新的分店下个月在芝加哥开张。

sentences.text: A young girl on crutches asked Tom where he lived.
sentences.translationZh: 一個拄著柺杖的年輕女孩問湯姆他住在哪裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一个拄着拐杖的年轻女孩问汤姆他住在哪里。

sentences.text: Although I was tired, I did what I was able to do.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然我很累，但是我已經做了我能做的了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 雖然我很累，但是我已經做了我能做的了。

sentences.text: Although he was exhausted, he had to keep working.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管他累極了，他還必須工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管他累极了，他还必须工作。

sentences.text: Anything you say can be used against you in court.
sentences.translationZh: 你所說的一切都將成為呈堂證供。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

sentences.text: As long as we love each other, we'll be all right.
sentences.translationZh: 只要我們彼此相愛，我們會沒事的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只要我們彼此相愛，我們會沒事的。

sentences.text: As more paper money came into use, the value fell.
sentences.translationZh: 當更多的紙幣投入使用，價格就下跌了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当更多的纸币投入使用，价格就下跌了。

sentences.text: Can you give me a ride to the office on Wednesday?
sentences.translationZh: 週三你可以載我到辦公室嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 周三你可以载我到办公室吗？

sentences.text: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
sentences.translationZh: 你能告訴我最近的古玩店在哪裡嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？

sentences.text: Don't leave the lights on when you leave the room.
sentences.translationZh: 離開房間時，不要留燈。
sentences.translationOriginal: 离开房间时，不要留灯。

sentences.text: Even though he has a lot of money, he's not happy.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然他很有錢，但他不幸福。
sentences.translationOriginal: 虽然他很有钱，但他不幸福。

sentences.text: Every time he comes here, he orders the same dish.
sentences.translationZh: 每次他來這裡點一樣的菜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每次他来这里点一样的菜。

sentences.text: Everyone in the room was stunned by what happened.
sentences.translationZh: 屋裡的每個人都被發生的事驚住了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 屋裡的每個人都被發生的事驚住了。

sentences.text: He drove the car, listening to music on the radio.
sentences.translationZh: 他一面開車一面聽收音機的音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一面開車一面聽收音機的音樂。

sentences.text: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
sentences.translationZh: 他試圖遊過河，但是失敗了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。

sentences.text: He told us such a funny story that we all laughed.
sentences.translationZh: 他給我們講了一個有趣的故事，我們都笑了起來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事，我们都笑了起来。

sentences.text: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
sentences.translationZh: 他戴著面具以至於沒有人認出他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他戴著面具以至於沒有人認出他。

sentences.text: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
sentences.translationZh: 他的低薪水讓他買不了房。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的低薪水让他买不了房。

sentences.text: How long does it take to get to the train station?
sentences.translationZh: 去火車站要多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 去火车站要多久？

sentences.text: How long does the airport bus take to the airport?
sentences.translationZh: 乘機場大巴去機場要多久？
sentences.translationOriginal: 乘机场大巴去机场要多久？

sentences.text: I can't believe Tom is really planning to do this.
sentences.translationZh: 我無法相信湯姆真的打算做這事兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我无法相信汤姆真的打算做这事儿。

sentences.text: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
sentences.translationZh: 我不明白為什麼你這麼批評他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

sentences.text: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.
sentences.translationZh: 我不禁想我的兒子一直都在生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。

sentences.text: I didn't know Tom was going to tell us what to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道湯姆會告訴我們該怎麼做
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道汤姆会告诉我们该怎么做

sentences.text: I didn't trust Tom and he didn't trust me, either.
sentences.translationZh: 我不信任湯姆而且湯姆也不信任我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不信任汤姆而且汤姆也不信任我。

sentences.text: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我沒犯任何嚴重的錯誤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。

sentences.text: I don't think that any more students want to come.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得不會有更多學生想來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得不会有更多学生想来了。

sentences.text: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想再聽你抱怨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想再听你抱怨了。

sentences.text: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
sentences.translationZh: 我發現他就是會很晚才來這樣的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我發現他就是會很晚才來這樣的人。

sentences.text: I had no idea it would put you to so much trouble.
sentences.translationZh: 我一點都不知道這會給你帶來那麼多問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一点都不知道这会给你带来那么多问题。

sentences.text: I hate when other people make me wait a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我討厭別人讓我等很久。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我讨厌别人让我等很久。

sentences.text: I have a friend whose father is a famous novelist.
sentences.translationZh: 我有一位父親是著名小說家的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有一位父亲是著名小说家的朋友。

sentences.text: I have nothing to say with regard to that problem.
sentences.translationZh: 對於這個問題我無可奉告。
sentences.translationOriginal: 对于这个问题我无可奉告。

sentences.text: I have to get to sleep! I've got classes tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 我必須去睡覺了！我明天早上有課。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我必须去睡觉了！我明天早上有课。

sentences.text: I have to take the book back to the library today.
sentences.translationZh: 我今天必須把書還給圖書館。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今天必須把書還給圖書館。

sentences.text: I have two dogs. One is white and the other black.
sentences.translationZh: 我有兩條狗。一條是白色的，另一條是黑色的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有两条狗。一条是白色的，另一条是黑色的。

sentences.text: I hope he'll be able to come! I'd like to see him.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望他能來！我想見他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望他能來！我想見他。

sentences.text: I know it's time to go, but I want to stay longer.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道該走了，但我想留久一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道該走了，但我想留久一點。

sentences.text: I know the boy who is sitting closest to the door.
sentences.translationZh: 我認識那個坐得最靠近門的男孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认识那个坐得最靠近门的男孩。

sentences.text: I shot the horse because it had trouble breathing.
sentences.translationZh: 我槍殺了那匹馬，因為他已呼吸困難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。

sentences.text: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
sentences.translationZh: 我叫她不要鬆開繩子，但是她做了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

sentences.text: I took it for granted that he would keep his word.
sentences.translationZh: 我理所當然地認為他會履行諾言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我理所當然地認為他會履行諾言。

sentences.text: I took it for granted that he would pass the exam.
sentences.translationZh: 我理所當然地覺得，他會通過考試。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我理所当然地觉得，他会通过考试。

sentences.text: I want to go with a friend to Hokkaido next month.
sentences.translationZh: 我想下個月和一個朋友去北海道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想下个月和一个朋友去北海道。

sentences.text: I will wait for you in front of the radio station.
sentences.translationZh: 我會在電臺前等你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我會在電台前等你。

sentences.text: I'm afraid the job I've got for you won't be easy.
sentences.translationZh: 我恐怕我給你找的工作不輕鬆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我恐怕我給你找的工作不輕鬆。

sentences.text: I'm not the only one who thinks Tom is overweight.
sentences.translationZh: 覺得湯姆肥的人不止我一個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 觉得汤姆肥的人不止我一个。

sentences.text: I've already told Tom he can't go to Mary's party.
sentences.translationZh: 我已經告訴湯姆他不能去瑪麗的聚會了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我已經告訴湯姆他不能去瑪麗的聚會了。

sentences.text: I've been coming to work one train earlier lately.
sentences.translationZh: 我已經搭了最近比較早一點的火車來上班。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我已經搭了最近比較早一點的火車來上班。

sentences.text: If it were not for your help, I could not succeed.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有你的幫忙，我無法達成。
sentences.translationOriginal: 沒有你的幫忙，我無法達成。

sentences.text: If you can't make it, call us as soon as possible.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你做不到，儘快連絡我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你做不到，儘快連絡我們。

sentences.text: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.
sentences.translationZh: 這樣做你能節約幾個小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这样做你能节约几个小时。

sentences.text: If you really want to know, why don't you ask Tom?
sentences.translationZh: 如果你真的想知道的話，為什麼不問一下湯姆呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你真的想知道的话，为什么不问一下汤姆呢？

sentences.text: If you're not listening to the radio, turn it off.
sentences.translationZh: 要是你不在聽廣播的話，就關掉它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是你不在听广播的话，就关掉它。

sentences.text: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?
sentences.translationZh: 我們可以在大樓裡拍照嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们可以在大楼里拍照吗？

sentences.text: It cost me a thousand yen to get my bicycle fixed.
sentences.translationZh: 修理我的腳踏車花了我一千日圓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 修理我的腳踏車花了我一千日圓。

sentences.text: It is extremely hot and humid in Bali in December.
sentences.translationZh: 12月份巴厘島極其炎熱和潮溼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 12月份巴厘岛极其炎热和潮湿。

sentences.text: It is not necessary for us to attend this lecture.
sentences.translationZh: 我們沒有必要出席這個講座。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們沒有必要出席這個講座。

sentences.text: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
sentences.translationZh: 她確實很漂亮，但她很自私。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

sentences.text: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
sentences.translationZh: 聽起來好像他是這場災難的罪魁禍首。
sentences.translationOriginal: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。

sentences.text: It was raining heavily when I got up this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我今天早上起來的時候雨下得很大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今天早上起来的时候雨下得很大。

sentences.text: It's a risk that Tom and I aren't willing to take.
sentences.translationZh: 我和湯姆都不願意冒這個險
sentences.translationOriginal: 我和汤姆都不愿意冒这个险

sentences.text: It's getting dark. I wonder if it's going to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 天變暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天变暗了。我不知道是不是要下雨。

sentences.text: It's two-hour drive from here to my uncle's house.
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡坐車，要花兩個小時才能到我叔叔家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 从这里坐车，要花两个小时才能到我叔叔家。

sentences.text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
sentences.translationZh: 木星是太陽系中最大的行星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 木星是太陽系中最大的行星。

sentences.text: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
sentences.translationZh: 許多電視節目對兒童有不良的影響。
sentences.translationOriginal: 許多電視節目對兒童有不良的影響。

sentences.text: Mary placed her baby in a car seat for the flight.
sentences.translationZh: 航程中瑪麗把她的寶寶放在嬰兒汽車座椅上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 航程中瑪麗把她的寶寶放在嬰兒汽車座椅上。

sentences.text: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
sentences.translationZh: 我的生意終於上了軌道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的生意終於上了軌道。

sentences.text: People are more educated now than they used to be.
sentences.translationZh: 現在的人教育程度比以前高得多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。

sentences.text: She always lets her children do what they want to.
sentences.translationZh: 她總是讓自己的小孩做自己想做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她總是讓自己的小孩做自己想做的事。

sentences.text: She came to Tokyo when she was eighteen years old.
sentences.translationZh: 她18歲的時候來到東京。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她18岁的时候来到东京。

sentences.text: She helped her father with the work in the garden.
sentences.translationZh: 她幫她爸爸幹了花園裡的活。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她帮她爸爸干了花园里的活。

sentences.text: She told me that her mother had bought it for her.
sentences.translationZh: 她告訴我她媽媽買給她了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她告诉我她妈妈买给她了。

sentences.text: She wants to move out and find a place of her own.
sentences.translationZh: 她想搬出去，找個屬於自己的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她想搬出去，找個屬於自己的地方。

sentences.text: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.
sentences.translationZh: 她上飛機前，給我招了招手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她上飞机前，给我招了招手。

sentences.text: That wasn't the main reason Tom needed to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 這不是湯姆要做那件事的主要原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这不是汤姆要做那件事的主要原因。

sentences.text: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
sentences.translationZh: 給這本書畫插畫的畫家很好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 給這本書畫插畫的畫家很好。

sentences.text: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
sentences.translationZh: 我用了比我預期更長的時間來完成作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。

sentences.text: The boy who lives next door often comes home late.
sentences.translationZh: 隔壁的男孩常常晚回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 隔壁的男孩常常晚回家。

sentences.text: The legal system in America is the world's finest.
sentences.translationZh: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。

sentences.text: The longer I stayed in Paris, the more I liked it.
sentences.translationZh: 在巴黎待得越久，我就越喜歡巴黎。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在巴黎待得越久，我就越喜欢巴黎。

sentences.text: The plane was three hours late due to bad weather.
sentences.translationZh: 由於天氣不好，飛機遲到了3小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于天气不好，飞机迟到了3小时。

sentences.text: The problem is who is going to tell him the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 問題是誰要告訴他真相。
sentences.translationOriginal: 問題是誰要告訴他真相。

sentences.text: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
sentences.translationZh: 流經倫敦的河是泰晤士河。
sentences.translationOriginal: 流经伦敦的河是泰晤士河。

sentences.text: The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.
sentences.translationZh: 這場談論即將對汙染問題展開討論。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这场谈论即将对污染问题展开讨论。

sentences.text: There is no admission fee for children under five.
sentences.translationZh: 五歲以下的小孩票價全面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 五岁以下的小孩票价全面。

sentences.text: There was no one in the room besides Tom and Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆和瑪麗，房間裡沒有人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆和玛丽，房间里没有人。

sentences.text: There was nothing on the radio about the accident.
sentences.translationZh: 電臺沒有提到這個事故。
sentences.translationOriginal: 電台沒有提到這個事故。

sentences.text: There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 你有可能不得不那麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有可能不得不那么做。

sentences.text: They called in a doctor because the child was ill.
sentences.translationZh: 他們打電話給醫生因為這個孩子生病了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們打電話給醫生因為這個孩子生病了。

sentences.text: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我所見過的最大型的構造了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

sentences.text: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
sentences.translationZh: 這個理論對我來說太難了，理解不了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary are studying together in the library.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗在圖書館一起學習。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆和瑪麗在圖書館一起學習。

sentences.text: Tom can't go out because he has a lot of homework.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆因為有很多作業不能外出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆因为有很多作业不能外出。

sentences.text: Tom couldn't read very well until he was thirteen.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆十三歲以前讀得不好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆十三歲以前讀得不好。

sentences.text: Tom had a hunch that Mary was seeing someone else.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆預感到瑪麗在見別人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆预感到玛丽在见别人。

sentences.text: Tom has made up his mind to go to Boston to study.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆已經下定決心要去波士頓唸書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆已經下定決心要去波士頓唸書。

sentences.text: Tom is wearing the same clothes he wore yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆穿著跟昨天穿的衣服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆穿着跟昨天穿的衣服。

sentences.text: Tom sat on that park bench for nearly three hours.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在公園的長椅上坐了將近三個小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在公园的长椅上坐了将近三个小时。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary that it would probably snow all day.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗雪可能會下一整天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉玛丽雪可能会下一整天。

sentences.text: Tom told me he'd give me that book if I wanted it.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說過，如果我想要的話他可以把這本書給我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说过，如果我想要的话他可以把这本书给我。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he won't come to school tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他明天不來上學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他明天不来上学。

sentences.text: Tom wants a computer small enough to easily carry.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想要個小得易於攜帶的電腦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想要个小得易于携带的电脑。

sentences.text: Tom was so drunk that he didn't even recognize me.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆醉得連我都認不出來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆醉得连我都认不出来了。

sentences.text: Tom was the first to arrive and the last to leave.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆最先來，最後走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆最先來，最後走。

sentences.text: Tom wouldn't dare show his face around here again.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不敢再到這裡露面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不敢再到这里露面。

sentences.text: Two men are checking on what's wrong with the car.
sentences.translationZh: 兩個男人在檢查汽車出了什麼故障。
sentences.translationOriginal: 两个男人在检查汽车出了什么故障。

sentences.text: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
sentences.translationZh: 很抱歉，我們不能接受你的要求。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

sentences.text: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
sentences.translationZh: 我們起得很早為了看到日出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

sentences.text: We've got to do something about this problem soon.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要快點處理這問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们要快点处理这问题。

sentences.text: What would you do if you had ten thousand dollars?
sentences.translationZh: 如果你有一萬美元，你想做什麼呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你有一万美元，你想做什么呢？

sentences.text: When I hear that song, I remember my younger days.
sentences.translationZh: 每次聽到這首歌，都會讓我回憶起自己年輕的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

sentences.text: When was the last time you spent time on Facebook?
sentences.translationZh: 你上一次用Facebook是什麼時候？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你上一次用Facebook是什麼時候？

sentences.text: You are no better at remembering things than I am.
sentences.translationZh: 你記事情的能力並不比我好多少。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你记事情的能力并不比我好多少。

sentences.text: You don't seem to be as afraid as Tom seems to be.
sentences.translationZh: 你似乎並不像湯姆看起來那樣害怕
sentences.translationOriginal: 你似乎并不像汤姆看起来那样害怕

sentences.text: You look the way your father did thirty years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 你看上去就像是三十年前你父親的樣子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看上去就像是三十年前你父親的樣子。

sentences.text: You should know better than to ask a lady her age.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該知道不要問小姐的年齡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該知道不要問小姐的年齡。

sentences.text: You should read a lot of books while you're young.
sentences.translationZh: 當你年輕的時候, 你應該多讀點兒書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你年輕的時候, 你應該多讀點兒書。

sentences.text: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
sentences.translationZh: 你不應該對你父母那樣頂嘴。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不應該對你父母那樣頂嘴。

sentences.text: You want to be excused from doing that, don't you?
sentences.translationZh: 你想通過做那件事而得到原諒是嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想通过做那件事而得到原谅是吗？

sentences.text: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
sentences.translationZh: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭醫生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭醫生。

sentences.text: You're working too hard. Take it easy for a while.
sentences.translationZh: 你工作太勤奮了。休息一會吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你工作太勤奋了。休息一会吧。

sentences.text: Have you seen my cell phone? "It's on the table."
sentences.translationZh: 你有看到我的手機嗎? "它在桌子上。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有看到我的手機嗎? "它在桌子上。"

sentences.text: Where have you been? "I've been to the barber's."
sentences.translationZh: 你去哪兒了？我去了理髮店。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你去哪儿了？我去了理发店。

sentences.text: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
sentences.translationZh: 學術造假比你想像的普遍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

sentences.text: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
sentences.translationZh: 我們所有的人都想除掉核子武器。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們所有的人都想除掉核子武器。

sentences.text: All you have to do is say the word, and I'll leave.
sentences.translationZh: 你只要說句話，我就走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你只要说句话，我就走。

sentences.text: Are you saying you don't want to go to Tom's party?
sentences.translationZh: 你的意思是你不想去湯姆的派對？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你的意思是你不想去汤姆的派对？

sentences.text: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
sentences.translationZh: 她對我來說是一個完全陌生的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。

sentences.text: As far as I'm concerned, this coffee is too strong.
sentences.translationZh: 這咖啡對我來說太濃了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这咖啡对我来说太浓了。

sentences.text: As soon as he sat down, he picked up the telephone.
sentences.translationZh: 他一坐下，就拿起了電話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一坐下，就拿起了電話。

sentences.text: Because his salary is low, he can't buy that house.
sentences.translationZh: 因為他的薪水太低，他買不起那棟房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因為他的薪水太低，他買不起那棟房子。

sentences.text: Can you imagine what the 21st century will be like?
sentences.translationZh: 你能想像21世紀會是甚麼樣嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能想象21世紀會是甚麼樣嗎？

sentences.text: China is about twenty-five times as large as Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 中國的版圖大概是日本的二十五倍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 中国的版图大概是日本的二十五倍。

sentences.text: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
sentences.translationZh: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。

sentences.text: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
sentences.translationZh: 在光滑的路上開車會導致車禍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

sentences.text: Everybody in the room was stunned by what happened.
sentences.translationZh: 屋裡的每個人都被發生的事驚住了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 屋裡的每個人都被發生的事驚住了。

sentences.text: Everyone except Tom knew he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
sentences.translationZh: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。
