sentences.text: He has no right to interfere in our family affairs.
sentences.translationZh: 他無權干涉我們的家庭事務。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他无权干涉我们的家庭事务。

sentences.text: He looked in all directions, but didn't see anyone.
sentences.translationZh: 他看了看四周，但沒看見任何人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他看了看四周，但沒看見任何人。

sentences.text: He said he did not enter the room, which was a lie.
sentences.translationZh: 他說他沒有進房間，那是騙人的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他说他没有进房间，那是骗人的。

sentences.text: He went to Italy for the purpose of studying music.
sentences.translationZh: 他去義大利的目的是學習音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他去義大利的目的是學習音樂。

sentences.text: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.
sentences.translationZh: 他和他所有的同學相處融洽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。

sentences.text: How long has it been since you saw your girlfriend?
sentences.translationZh: 你跟你的女朋友見面以來有多久了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你跟你的女朋友见面以来有多久了？

sentences.text: How many different kinds of pizzas are on the menu?
sentences.translationZh: 菜單上有多少種比薩？
sentences.translationOriginal: 菜單上有多少種比薩？

sentences.text: I am surprised that your family has a Japanese car.
sentences.translationZh: 我很驚訝，你家居然有輛日本車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很惊讶，你家居然有辆日本车。

sentences.text: I couldn't prevent Tom from eating all the cookies.
sentences.translationZh: 我阻止不了湯姆把餅乾全吃了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我阻止不了汤姆把饼干全吃了。

sentences.text: I don't even want to think about what could happen.
sentences.translationZh: 我甚至不想去想會發生什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我甚至不想去想會發生什麼。

sentences.text: I find it difficult to express my meaning in words.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得很難用言語表達我的意思。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我覺得很難用言語表達我的意思。

sentences.text: I go to the office by bicycle except on rainy days.
sentences.translationZh: 除了雨天，我都是騎車去上班的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

sentences.text: I like rugby, but not as much as I like basketball.
sentences.translationZh: 我喜歡橄欖球，但不像我喜歡籃球那麼喜歡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我喜欢橄榄球，但不像我喜欢篮球那么喜欢。

sentences.text: I think a movie is more entertaining than any book.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得一部電影比任何書都有趣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得一部电影比任何书都有趣。

sentences.text: I thought I told you to stay away from my computer.
sentences.translationZh: 我說過讓你離我的電腦遠一點的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我说过让你离我的电脑远一点的。

sentences.text: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道你不自在，但別急。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道你不自在，但别急。

sentences.text: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要一艘船帶我遠離這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。

sentences.text: I wanted to ask Tom how long he had lived in India.
sentences.translationZh: 我想問湯姆他在印度生活了多久。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想问汤姆他在印度生活了多久。

sentences.text: I was wondering if you were going to show up today.
sentences.translationZh: 我在想你今天會不會來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在想你今天会不会来。

sentences.text: I wouldn't ask this of you if it weren't important.
sentences.translationZh: 如果不是它很重要，我不會問你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果不是它很重要，我不會問你。

sentences.text: I'd like to exchange this shirt I bought yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。

sentences.text: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.
sentences.translationZh: 除非他們事先修好剎車，我才會買車子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

sentences.text: I'm disappointed that I wasn't able to go with her.
sentences.translationZh: 我很失望我沒能和她一起去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很失望我沒能和她一起去。

sentences.text: I'm on my way to meet Tom at the station right now.
sentences.translationZh: 我現在在去車站見湯姆的路上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我现在在去车站见汤姆的路上。

sentences.text: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
sentences.translationZh: 有人說你是個很有能力的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有人說你是個很有能力的人。

sentences.text: I've done bad things that I should be punished for.
sentences.translationZh: 我做了該受罰的壞事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我做了該受罰的壞事。

sentences.text: If there was no sun, all the animals would be dead.
sentences.translationZh: 如果沒有太陽，那所有生物都會死。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果没有太阳，那所有生物都会死。

sentences.text: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不能有孩子，你總能領養。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

sentences.text: Is it true that Tom wants to paint his house green?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想把房子漆成綠色，是真的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想把房子漆成绿色，是真的吗？

sentences.text: It is believed that whales have their own language.
sentences.translationZh: 人們相信鯨有他們自己的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人们相信鲸有他们自己的语言。

sentences.text: It is impossible to master English in a short time.
sentences.translationZh: 不可能短時間內學會英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

sentences.text: It isn't anything like as cold as it was yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 今天沒有像昨天那麼冷。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天沒有像昨天那麼冷。

sentences.text: It took a long time to take in what she was saying.
sentences.translationZh: 花了很久才能聽懂她在說什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 花了很久才能听懂她在说什么。

sentences.text: It will be snowing when we arrive at Shiga Heights.
sentences.translationZh: 我們到達志賀高原時會下雪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们到达志贺高原时会下雪。

sentences.text: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
sentences.translationZh: 要都解釋的話，需要一輩子的時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要都解释的话，需要一辈子的时间。

sentences.text: It's been a long time since we last saw each other.
sentences.translationZh: 真是好久不見啊
sentences.translationOriginal: 真是好久不见啊

sentences.text: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
sentences.translationZh: 這個月一直都很熱，但今天是個例外。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。

sentences.text: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
sentences.translationZh: 學習外語裡的俚語很有趣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 学习外语里的俚语很有趣。

sentences.text: Let go of my arm! I can't stand people touching me.
sentences.translationZh: 放開我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 放開我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

sentences.text: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
sentences.translationZh: 監獄生活比做畜牲還不如。
sentences.translationOriginal: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。

sentences.text: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.
sentences.translationZh: 今天許多學校因為風暴停課。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。

sentences.text: Many young people in Japan eat bread for breakfast.
sentences.translationZh: 許多日本的年輕人吃麵包當作早餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 許多日本的年輕人吃麵包當作早餐。

sentences.text: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗性格很好，就像她姐姐一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

sentences.text: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
sentences.translationZh: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。
sentences.translationOriginal: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。

sentences.text: One of the main products of this country is coffee.
sentences.translationZh: 這個國家的主要產品之一是咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个国家的主要产品之一是咖啡。

sentences.text: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
sentences.translationZh: 請在建築的入口處等我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请在建筑的入口处等我。

sentences.text: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
sentences.translationZh: 請寫信告訴我你們學校的情況。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。

sentences.text: President Lincoln was what we call a self-made man.
sentences.translationZh: 林肯總統就是我們所謂白手起家的男人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 林肯總統就是我們所謂白手起家的男人。

sentences.text: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
sentences.translationZh: 有關癌症成因的研究耗費頗巨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有關癌症成因的研究耗費頗巨。

sentences.text: She can sing better than anybody else in her class.
sentences.translationZh: 她唱歌唱得比班上任何一個人好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她唱歌唱得比班上任何一個人好。

sentences.text: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
sentences.translationZh: 她鍛鍊時扭傷了腳踝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。

sentences.text: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.
sentences.translationZh: 她已經無法用語言表達她的感覺了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。

sentences.text: She wrote him a long letter, but he didn't read it.
sentences.translationZh: 她給他寫了一封長信，但是他沒有看。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她给他写了一封长信，但是他没有看。

sentences.text: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.
sentences.translationZh: 那個孩子可能在回家的路上被綁架了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个孩子可能在回家的路上被绑架了。

sentences.text: That was the first time that I'd seen Tom so angry.
sentences.translationZh: 那是我第一次見到湯姆如此生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是我第一次见到汤姆如此生气。

sentences.text: The Amazon is fed by a large number of tributaries.
sentences.translationZh: 亞馬遜河有很多支流。
sentences.translationOriginal: 亚马逊河有很多支流。

sentences.text: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
sentences.translationZh: 冷戰以蘇聯解體結束。
sentences.translationOriginal: 冷战以苏联解体结束。

sentences.text: The job looked quite simple, but it took me a week.
sentences.translationZh: 這份工作看起來很簡單，但它花了我一個星期。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這份工作看起來很簡單，但它花了我一個星期。

sentences.text: The people of London are very proud of this bridge.
sentences.translationZh: 倫敦人對這座橋感到非常自豪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 倫敦人對這座橋感到非常自豪。

sentences.text: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
sentences.translationZh: 警察收集了很多對他不利的證據。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。

sentences.text: The sky today is the bluest that I've ever seen it.
sentences.translationZh: 今天的天空是我看過最藍的天空。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天的天空是我看過最藍的天空。

sentences.text: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
sentences.translationZh: 老師允許我提前回家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老師允許我提前回家。

sentences.text: The things he says are not the least bit important.
sentences.translationZh: 他說的話根本毫無意義。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他说的话根本毫无意义。

sentences.text: The truth is that nothing is totally true or false.
sentences.translationZh: 真相是沒有甚麼完全正確或錯誤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真相是沒有甚麼完全正確或錯誤。

sentences.text: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 根據氣象預報，明天會是晴天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根據氣象預報，明天會是晴天。

sentences.text: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
sentences.translationZh: 圖片的背景是一座城堡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

sentences.text: There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
sentences.translationZh: 冰箱裡有一瓶白葡萄酒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 冰箱里有一瓶白葡萄酒。

sentences.text: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
sentences.translationZh: 為了報仇，他們放火燒了鄰居的家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 為了報仇，他們放火燒了鄰居的家。

sentences.text: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
sentences.translationZh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这家公司在巴黎证券交易所上市了。

sentences.text: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.
sentences.translationZh: 這本導遊冊子或許會對你的旅行有幫助。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本导游册子或许会对你的旅行有帮助。

sentences.text: To the best of my knowledge, the rumor is not true.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，這個謠言不是真的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据我所知，这个谣言不是真的。

sentences.text: Tom can't decide whether to buy a Toyota or a Ford.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不能決定買豐田還是福特。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不能决定买丰田还是福特。

sentences.text: Tom is from Australia and Mary is from New Zealand.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆來自澳大利亞，瑪麗來自新西蘭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆来自澳大利亚，玛丽来自新西兰。

sentences.text: Tom knows that I want to leave as soon as possible.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆知道我想盡早離開。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆知道我想盡早離開。

sentences.text: Tom left his sunglasses on the dashboard of my car.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把他的太陽鏡留在我的車的儀表板上了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把他的太阳镜留在我的车的仪表板上了。

sentences.text: Tom probably knows someone who can teach us French.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆應該知道有誰可以教我們法文。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆應該知道有誰可以教我們法文。

sentences.text: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說瑪麗絕不會接受這工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆說瑪麗絕不會接受這工作。

sentences.text: Tom told me that I shouldn't go out alone at night.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆跟我說我不應該晚上一個人出門。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆跟我说我不应该晚上一个人出门。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he doesn't like carbonated drinks.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我他不喜歡碳酸飲料。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我他不喜欢碳酸饮料。

sentences.text: Tom very often takes a nap for an hour after lunch.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆很經常在午飯後小憩一小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆很经常在午饭后小憩一小时。

sentences.text: Tom was advised by Mary not to go there by himself.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗建議湯姆不要獨自去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽建议汤姆不要独自去。

sentences.text: Up to now, how many books do you think you've read?
sentences.translationZh: 到目前為止，你認為你閱讀過多少書籍？
sentences.translationOriginal: 到目前为止，你认为你阅读过多少书籍？

sentences.text: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
sentences.translationZh: 參觀所有觀光勝地累壞了我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 參觀所有觀光勝地累壞了我。

sentences.text: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
sentences.translationZh: 水是液體。凍起來就成了固體。
sentences.translationOriginal: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

sentences.text: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.
sentences.translationZh: 我們都想知道她為什麼甩了這麼好的一個男人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們都想知道她為什麼甩了這麼好的一個男人。

sentences.text: When I entered the room, she was playing the piano.
sentences.translationZh: 當我進入那個房間的時候，她正在彈鋼琴。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我进入那个房间的时候，她正在弹钢琴。

sentences.text: With a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他當時再努力一點，他就成功了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他当时再努力一点，他就成功了。

sentences.text: With her help, my French improved little by little.
sentences.translationZh: 在她的幫助下，我的法語逐漸進步了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。

sentences.text: You are working too hard. Take it easy for a while.
sentences.translationZh: 你工作得太辛苦了。放輕鬆一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你工作得太辛苦了。放輕鬆一下。

sentences.text: You have to study hard to catch up with your class.
sentences.translationZh: 你必須用功讀書趕上同學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必須用功讀書趕上同學。

sentences.text: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
sentences.translationZh: 你在簽字前必須察看這合同。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你在签字前必须察看这合同。

sentences.text: You ought to let Tom know Mary is going to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 你該讓湯姆知道瑪麗要去做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你該讓湯姆知道瑪麗要去做。

sentences.text: You're the one who suggested that we sing together.
sentences.translationZh: 你是那個建議我們一起唱歌的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是那個建議我們一起唱歌的人。

sentences.text: You've been late for school more often than before.
sentences.translationZh: 你比以前更容易上課遲到了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你比以前更容易上課遲到了。

sentences.text: A beautiful woman was seated one row in front of me.
sentences.translationZh: 一個美麗的女人坐在我前面一排。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個美麗的女人坐在我前面一排。

sentences.text: A caged cricket eats just as much as a free cricket.
sentences.translationZh: 籠子裡的蟋蟀吃得跟野生的蟋蟀一樣多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 籠子裡的蟋蟀吃得跟野生的蟋蟀一樣多。

sentences.text: A couch potato is something that I don't want to be.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想成為整天泡在沙發上看電視的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想成為整天泡在沙發上看電視的人。

sentences.text: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
sentences.translationZh: 喝醉的駕駛員對車禍有責任。
sentences.translationOriginal: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。

sentences.text: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
sentences.translationZh: 火警發生在他們住的旅館。
sentences.translationOriginal: 火警發生在他們住的旅館。

sentences.text: All of a sudden, three dogs appeared in front of us.
sentences.translationZh: 突然之間，三隻狗出現在我們面前。
sentences.translationOriginal: 突然之間，三隻狗出現在我們面前。

sentences.text: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
sentences.translationZh: 你們所有的人都熟悉這個故事的真相。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你們所有的人都熟悉這個故事的真相。

sentences.text: At last, she gave in to him and told him the secret.
sentences.translationZh: 最後，她對他屈服了，並告訴了他這個祕密。
sentences.translationOriginal: 最後，她對他屈服了，並告訴了他這個秘密。

sentences.text: At that time, Tom was sitting between Mary and John.
sentences.translationZh: 在那個時候，湯姆正坐在瑪麗和約翰中間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在那个时候，汤姆正坐在玛丽和约翰中间。

sentences.text: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.
sentences.translationZh: 確保親自填寫註冊表格。
sentences.translationOriginal: 确保亲自填写注册表格。

sentences.text: Better be the head of a cat than the tail of a lion.
sentences.translationZh: 寧為貓頭不為獅尾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 寧為貓頭不為獅尾。

sentences.text: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
sentences.translationZh: 你能把你的自行車借我兩天嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

sentences.text: Did you know that some foxes lived on this mountain?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道有些狐狸住在這座山上嗎?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道有些狐狸住在這座山上嗎?

sentences.text: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
sentences.translationZh: 您知道這座廟宇供奉的是哪個神嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

sentences.text: Everybody except Tom knew he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
sentences.translationZh: 流利的英語在今天是一種十分搶手的技能。
sentences.translationOriginal: 流利的英語在今天是一種十分搶手的技能。

sentences.text: He called in to say he could not attend the meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 他打電話來說他不會參加會議了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他打電話來說他不會參加會議了。

sentences.text: He did not answer the phone, so I sent him an email.
sentences.translationZh: 他沒有接電話，所以我給他發了封郵件。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他没有接电话，所以我给他发了封邮件。

sentences.text: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
sentences.translationZh: 他有一個妻子和兩個孩子要養活。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。

sentences.text: He is not the man that he was when I first knew him.
sentences.translationZh: 他已經不是我最初見他那時的那個人了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他已经不是我最初见他那时的那个人了。

sentences.text: He left the house without so much as saying goodbye.
sentences.translationZh: 他甚至沒說再見就離開了家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他甚至没说再见就离开了家。

sentences.text: He must have said so without giving it much thought.
sentences.translationZh: 他一定沒有多考慮就說了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他一定没有多考虑就说了。

sentences.text: He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
sentences.translationZh: 他從沒放棄達成那個目標的希望。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他從沒放棄達成那個目標的希望。

sentences.text: He pinched and scraped for many years to save money.
sentences.translationZh: 為了存錢他省吃儉用了許多年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 為了存錢他省吃儉用了許多年。

sentences.text: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.
sentences.translationZh: 嗨，我可能沒錢，但我一直有我的驕傲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 嗨，我可能没钱，但我一直有我的骄傲。

sentences.text: His brazen act of defiance almost cost him his life.
sentences.translationZh: 他懷疑的無恥行為差點要了他的命。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他怀疑的无耻行为差点要了他的命。

sentences.text: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
sentences.translationZh: 他的觀察是敏銳的，但他沒有說太多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的觀察是敏銳的，但他沒有說太多。

sentences.text: How did Tom talk Mary into babysitting his children?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆是怎麼說服瑪麗照顧他的小孩的呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆是怎么说服玛丽照顾他的小孩的呢？

sentences.text: How long did you think the picnic was going to last?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為野餐要多長時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你認為野餐要多長時間？

sentences.text: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
sentences.translationZh: 由於噪音，我無法集中精力工作了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。

sentences.text: I can't take the place of her as an English teacher.
sentences.translationZh: 我無法取代她做英語老師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我无法取代她做英语老师。

sentences.text: I plan to spend the New Year's holiday in Australia.
sentences.translationZh: 我打算在澳大利亞過新年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我打算在澳大利亚过新年。

sentences.text: I studied in the morning during the summer vacation.
sentences.translationZh: 我在暑假裡早晨學習。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在暑假里早晨学习。

sentences.text: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
sentences.translationZh: 我懷疑那家酒館的啤酒兌水了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

sentences.text: I think the time is right to introduce this product.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得現在是發表這個產品的好時機。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我覺得現在是發表這個產品的好時機。

sentences.text: I think we should be able to go wherever we want to.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我們應該能去我們想去的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為我們應該能去我們想去的地方。

sentences.text: I think you should do that before you go home today.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為你該在今天回家前做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為你該在今天回家前做。

sentences.text: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得吃完那塊大牛排你就飽了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。

sentences.text: I would like to leave this town and never come back.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望離開這個村子並且再也不要回來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望離開這個村子並且再也不要回來。

sentences.text: I wrote a letter asking him to return a bit earlier.
sentences.translationZh: 我寫了封信，叫他早點回。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我写了封信，叫他早点回。

sentences.text: I'm really sorry. I seem to have lost your umbrella.
sentences.translationZh: 我真的很抱歉，我好像弄丟了你的雨傘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我真的很抱歉，我好像弄丢了你的雨伞。

sentences.text: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.
sentences.translationZh: 非常感謝你所做的一切。
sentences.translationOriginal: 非常感谢你所做的一切。

sentences.text: I've been wanting to see that movie for a long time.
sentences.translationZh: 我想看那電影想好久了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想看那电影想好久了。

sentences.text: If I were invisible I wouldn't have to dress myself.
sentences.translationZh: 若我是隱形的，就不用穿衣服了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 若我是隱形的，就不用穿衣服了。

sentences.text: If you need a dictionary, I can lend you my old one.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你需要字典，我就把我舊的借給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你需要字典，我就把我旧的借给你。

sentences.text: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
sentences.translationZh: 萬一有緊急情況，聯繫我的代理人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

sentences.text: Is it necessary for me to explain the reason to him?
sentences.translationZh: 我有必要向他解釋原因嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有必要向他解释原因吗？

sentences.text: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
sentences.translationZh: 空手赤拳抓野兔並不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 空手赤拳抓野兔並不容易。

sentences.text: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
sentences.translationZh: 在你侍酒前最好先將白葡萄酒冷卻一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在你侍酒前最好先將白葡萄酒冷卻一下。

sentences.text: Keep your eyes closed until I tell you to open them.
sentences.translationZh: 閉著你的眼睛直到我告訴你睜開為止。
sentences.translationOriginal: 闭着你的眼睛直到我告诉你睁开为止。

sentences.text: Let's meet at the station at eight tomorrow morning.
sentences.translationZh: 明早八點車站見。
sentences.translationOriginal: 明早八点车站见。

sentences.text: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
sentences.translationZh: 我住的地方－倫敦，從前以霧聞名。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我住的地方－倫敦，從前以霧聞名。

sentences.text: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
sentences.translationZh: 很多日本人對政治冷淡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。

sentences.text: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
sentences.translationZh: 我的駕駛教練說我應該更有耐心一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的駕駛教練說我應該更有耐心一點。

sentences.text: My father has already given up smoking and drinking.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸已經戒菸戒酒了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸已经戒烟戒酒了。

sentences.text: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
sentences.translationZh: 我的手抖得太厲害，沒法穿針了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。

sentences.text: None of them could understand what she was implying.
sentences.translationZh: 他們沒有人瞭解她暗示什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們沒有人了解她暗示什麼。

sentences.text: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
sentences.translationZh: 我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。

sentences.text: Parents teach their children that it's wrong to lie.
sentences.translationZh: 父母教育他們的孩子說謊是不好的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 父母教育他们的孩子说谎是不好的。

sentences.text: People should be the masters of their own destinies.
sentences.translationZh: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。

sentences.text: Quite by chance, I met my old friend at the airport.
sentences.translationZh: 很幸運地，我在機場遇到了我的老朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很幸运地，我在机场遇到了我的老朋友。

sentences.text: She couldn't attend that party because she was sick.
sentences.translationZh: 她因病不能出席會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她因病不能出席会议。

sentences.text: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
sentences.translationZh: 她用鉛筆在紙上畫了一個圈。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。

sentences.text: She studied abroad in order to brush up her English.
sentences.translationZh: 她在國外學習以便提升她的英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她在國外學習以便提升她的英語。

sentences.text: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.
sentences.translationZh: 她揮著她的手，直到火車消失在視線之外。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。

sentences.text: She went over the list to see if her name was there.
sentences.translationZh: 她走過去看看她的名字是否在清單上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她走過去看看她的名字是否在清單上。

sentences.text: Since my mother was sick, I stayed home from school.
sentences.translationZh: 既然母親病了，我就待在家裡沒去上學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 既然母亲病了，我就待在家里没去上学。

sentences.text: Take your hat off when you enter a house of worship.
sentences.translationZh: 當你進入禮拜堂時，把你的帽子脫下來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當你進入禮拜堂時，把你的帽子脫下來。

sentences.text: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
sentences.translationZh: 那是無稽之談。只有傻瓜才會相信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是無稽之談。只有傻瓜才會相信。

sentences.text: That's the computer on which he writes his articles.
sentences.translationZh: 那就是那臺他用來寫文章的電腦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。

sentences.text: That's the same story as I heard when I was a child.
sentences.translationZh: 那跟當我是個孩子時所聽到的是同樣的故事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那跟當我是個孩子時所聽到的是同樣的故事。

sentences.text: The bill was passed after a hard fight in the House.
sentences.translationZh: 該法案在眾議院爭議後獲得通過。
sentences.translationOriginal: 該法案在眾議院爭議後獲得通過。

sentences.text: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
sentences.translationZh: 董事會一致決定任命她為執行總裁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

sentences.text: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
sentences.translationZh: 該公司在這個企劃中投入了很多錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 該公司在這個企劃中投入了很多錢。

sentences.text: The doctor advised my father to cut down on smoking.
sentences.translationZh: 醫生建議我父親減少吸菸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 医生建议我父亲减少吸烟。

sentences.text: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
sentences.translationZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

sentences.text: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
sentences.translationZh: 這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這艘船逆風而行緩慢前進。

sentences.text: The situation is getting worse and worse day by day.
sentences.translationZh: 情況一天比一天差。
sentences.translationOriginal: 情况一天比一天差。

sentences.text: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.
sentences.translationZh: 小鎮被暴風雨後的洪水摧毀了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。

sentences.text: The wind blew too hard for them to play in the park.
sentences.translationZh: 風颳得太猛，他們沒法在公園裡玩了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 风刮得太猛，他们没法在公园里玩了。

sentences.text: There's a lot of trash on the far bank of the river.
sentences.translationZh: 河對岸有很多的垃圾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 河對岸有很多的垃圾。

sentences.text: This has been the driest six months in thirty years.
sentences.translationZh: 這是三十年代以來最乾旱的六月。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是三十年代以來最乾旱的六月。

sentences.text: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗手牽著手，一起欣賞風景。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和玛丽手牵着手，一起欣赏风景。

sentences.text: Tom could've dealt with the problem in a better way.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆本可以用更好的方式處理問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆本可以用更好的方式处理问题。

sentences.text: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆捐一半他的薪水給他最喜歡的慈善機構。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

sentences.text: Tom has contributed a lot of money to this hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆捐獻了很多錢給這間醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆捐獻了很多錢給這間醫院。

sentences.text: We must take into account the fact that he is young.
sentences.translationZh: 我們必須考慮到他很年輕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们必须考虑到他很年轻。

sentences.text: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得我明天約會穿什麼好呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？

sentences.text: When I hear this song, I think of you, and miss you.
sentences.translationZh: 當我聽到這首歌，我想起了你，並想念著你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當我聽到這首歌，我想起了你，並想念著你。

sentences.text: When he was a child, he would go fishing on Sundays.
sentences.translationZh: 他小時候，星期天會去釣魚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他小时候，星期天会去钓鱼。

sentences.text: When you have finished reading this letter, burn it.
sentences.translationZh: 看完這封信請把它燒掉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

sentences.text: Why is everyone being so nice to me all of a sudden?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼大家突然對我這麼好？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为什么大家突然对我这么好？

sentences.text: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
sentences.translationZh: 上大學的時候，你得到的比付出的還多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 上大學的時候，你得到的比付出的還多。

sentences.text: You should not have lent the money to such a person.
sentences.translationZh: 你不應該借錢給這樣的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不應該借錢給這樣的人。

sentences.text: A few years ago, our room had little furniture in it.
sentences.translationZh: 幾年前，我們的房間裡沒有什麼傢俱。
sentences.translationOriginal: 幾年前，我們的房間裡沒有什麼家具。

sentences.text: A foreign language can't be mastered in a year or so.
sentences.translationZh: 一個外國語言無法在一年左右就被掌握。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個外國語言無法在一年左右就被掌握。

sentences.text: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.
sentences.translationZh: 緩期執行在最後關頭決定了下來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 缓期执行在最后关头决定了下来。

sentences.text: After she had read the letter, she tore it to pieces.
sentences.translationZh: 看了信之後，她把它撕成碎片。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看了信之後，她把它撕成碎片。

sentences.text: After walking for an hour, we stopped to take a rest.
sentences.translationZh: 走了一個小時後，我們停下來休息。
sentences.translationOriginal: 走了一個小時後，我們停下來休息。

sentences.text: Can you wake me up at seven o'clock tomorrow morning?
sentences.translationZh: 你明天早上七點可不可以叫我起床。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你明天早上七點可不可以叫我起床。

sentences.text: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
sentences.translationZh: 把蛋糕等分切開更難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 把蛋糕等分切開更難。

sentences.text: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道春捲為什麼叫春捲嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道春卷为什么叫春卷吗？

sentences.text: Don't throw out this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
sentences.translationZh: 這本雜誌不要扔。我還沒看呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

sentences.text: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
sentences.translationZh: 全世界許多國家的人說英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 全世界許多國家的人說英語。

sentences.text: Everyone but Tom knew that he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Feel free to get yourself a drink if you are thirsty.
sentences.translationZh: 覺得渴了就喝點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 觉得渴了就喝点。

sentences.text: Fresh fruits and vegetables are good for your health.
sentences.translationZh: 新鮮水果和蔬菜有益健康。
sentences.translationOriginal: 新鮮水果和蔬菜有益健康。

sentences.text: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
sentences.translationZh: 他從早到晚只是在抱怨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。

sentences.text: He's not such a great writer and I think he knows it.
sentences.translationZh: 他不是那麼出色的作家我想他知道這一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不是那么出色的作家我想他知道这一点。

sentences.text: How long did it take you to finish reading that book?
sentences.translationZh: 你看完這本書要多少時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看完這本書要多少時間？

sentences.text: How much of what I've written here do you understand?
sentences.translationZh: 你瞭解多少我寫在這裡的東西?
sentences.translationOriginal: 你了解多少我寫在這裡的東西?

sentences.text: I am not quite sure if we can meet your requirements.
sentences.translationZh: 我不太確定我們是否能夠滿足你的要求。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不太確定我們是否能夠滿足你的要求。

sentences.text: I don't think that it's going to be easy to find Tom.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為，要找到湯姆可不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为，要找到汤姆可不容易。

sentences.text: I don't understand why pepperoni pizza is so popular.
sentences.translationZh: 我不懂為何義式辣腸披薩如此受歡迎。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不懂為何義式辣腸披薩如此受歡迎。

sentences.text: I get the feeling you're trying to tell me something.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覺你想告訴我什麼事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感觉你想告诉我什么事。

sentences.text: I had hardly left home when it began to rain heavily.
sentences.translationZh: 當雨開始下得很大的時候, 我幾乎不能出門了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當雨開始下得很大的時候, 我幾乎不能出門了。

sentences.text: I must think over the matter before giving my answer.
sentences.translationZh: 我在回答之前必須考慮周全。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在回答之前必须考虑周全。

sentences.text: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
sentences.translationZh: 我不該把一整包薯片都吃完的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不该把一整包薯片都吃完的。

sentences.text: I think that it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得湯姆不太可能會當選。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

sentences.text: I was the second to last person to hear the bad news.
sentences.translationZh: 我是倒數第二個得知這個壞消息的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我是倒数第二个得知这个坏消息的。

sentences.text: I worked in a post office during the summer vacation.
sentences.translationZh: 暑假期間，我在郵局工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 暑假期间，我在邮局工作。

sentences.text: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
sentences.translationZh: 我想試試這件。請問哪裡是試衣間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想试试这件。请问哪里是试衣间？

sentences.text: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
sentences.translationZh: 我會安排一下，叫個人去你家接你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。

sentences.text: I'm now rich enough to afford to get anything I want.
sentences.translationZh: 我現在富得能買我想要的任何東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我现在富得能买我想要的任何东西。

sentences.text: If you have a question, please raise your right hand.
sentences.translationZh: 如果有問題，請舉起你的右手。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果有问题，请举起你的右手。

sentences.text: If you need my advice, I'd be glad to give it to you.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你需要我的建議，我很願意告訴你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你需要我的建议，我很愿意告诉你。

sentences.text: If you pass this test, you could graduate next month.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你通過這個考試，你下個月就可以畢業了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你通過這個考試，你下個月就可以畢業了。

sentences.text: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
sentences.translationZh: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

sentences.text: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.
sentences.translationZh: 據說他爸爸在外國去世了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。

sentences.text: It looks like Tom will do what we've asked him to do.
sentences.translationZh: 看來湯姆會按我們要求的去做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看來湯姆會按我們要求的去做。

sentences.text: It makes no difference to me whether he comes or not.
sentences.translationZh: 他來不來對我來說沒區別。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他来不来对我来说没区别。

sentences.text: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
sentences.translationZh: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。

sentences.text: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
sentences.translationZh: 安靜到連針掉在地上的聲音你都會聽得到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 安靜到連針掉在地上的聲音你都會聽得到。

sentences.text: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我像這樣繼續下去是絕對不可能的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。

sentences.text: Let me read the paper when you have finished with it.
sentences.translationZh: 報紙看完後借我看下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 报纸看完后借我看下。

sentences.text: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗不窮，相反，她相當富裕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

sentences.text: More than 40 percent of students go on to university.
sentences.translationZh: 40%以上的學生去讀大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 40%以上的学生去读大学。

sentences.text: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
sentences.translationZh: 自從手術後，我父親一直處於良好的狀態。
sentences.translationOriginal: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

sentences.text: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸堅持要我去那地方看看。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。

sentences.text: My father will often read the newspaper during meals.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親常在吃飯時看報紙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父亲常在吃饭时看报纸。

sentences.text: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
sentences.translationZh: 舅舅的公司上個月推出了一項新產品。
sentences.translationOriginal: 舅舅的公司上个月推出了一项新产品。

sentences.text: No matter how hard the training was, she never cried.
sentences.translationZh: 不管訓練多麼艱苦，她都沒有哭過。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管训练多么艰苦，她都没有哭过。

sentences.text: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 她迷路了，緊接著天開始下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。

sentences.text: She ran very fast to catch up with the other members.
sentences.translationZh: 她跑得很快是為了趕上其他成員。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她跑得很快是为了赶上其他成员。

sentences.text: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
sentences.translationZh: 她的英語說得比班上任何人都好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她的英語說得比班上任何人都好。

sentences.text: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
sentences.translationZh: 她是個又高又瘦, 留著一頭又長又軟的褐色頭髮的女孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她是個又高又瘦, 留著一頭又長又軟的褐色頭髮的女孩。

sentences.text: She will return home next Sunday, that is, the tenth.
sentences.translationZh: 她下週日回家，也就是10號。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她下周日回家，也就是10号。

sentences.text: She's practicing English so she can get a better job.
sentences.translationZh: 她練習英語以找更好的工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她練習英語以找更好的工作。

sentences.text: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
sentences.translationZh: 自從他不知道該說什麼的時候，便一直沉默著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。

sentences.text: Since he is old, this task must be difficult for him.
sentences.translationZh: 他老了，所以這任務對他來說一定很難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他老了，所以这任务对他来说一定很难。

sentences.text: The Tigers lost the game, which was a surprise to us.
sentences.translationZh: 我們覺得很驚訝老虎隊竟然輸掉了比賽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們覺得很驚訝老虎隊竟然輸掉了比賽。

sentences.text: The bridge will be completed by the end of this year.
sentences.translationZh: 大橋將在年底完工。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大橋將在年底完工。

sentences.text: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
sentences.translationZh: 公車突然在路中央停下來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 公車突然在路中央停下來。

sentences.text: The girl was sobbing in the corner of the schoolroom.
sentences.translationZh: 女孩在教室的角落啜泣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 女孩在教室的角落啜泣。

sentences.text: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
sentences.translationZh: 走廊要寬得能容下輪椅。
sentences.translationOriginal: 走廊要寬得能容下輪椅。

sentences.text: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.
sentences.translationZh: 最後一個聽我說我的主意的人認為我瘋了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 最后一个听我说我的主意的人认为我疯了。

sentences.text: The police will put you behind bars for twenty years.
sentences.translationZh: 警方會把你關在牢裡二十年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警方會把你關在牢裡二十年。

sentences.text: The prince fell in love with a woodcutter's daughter.
sentences.translationZh: 王子愛上了一個樵夫的女兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 王子愛上了一個樵夫的女兒。

sentences.text: The teacher lined the children up in order of height.
sentences.translationZh: 老師按照身高給孩子們排隊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老师按照身高给孩子们排队。

sentences.text: They say she and her husband can't agree on anything.
sentences.translationZh: 他們說她和她的丈夫不可能對任何事達成協議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們說她和她的丈夫不可能對任何事達成協議。

sentences.text: They will hold a meeting at 2 o'clock this afternoon.
sentences.translationZh: 他們今天下午2點會舉行一個會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们今天下午2点会举行一个会议。

sentences.text: This is where I want to live for the rest of my life.
sentences.translationZh: 這裡是我餘生想待的地方
sentences.translationOriginal: 這裡是我餘生想待的地方

sentences.text: Tom and Mary even always wear the same color clothes.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和瑪麗甚至經常穿同樣顏色的衣服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和玛丽甚至经常穿同样颜色的衣服。

sentences.text: Tom bought a camera at a store not too far from here.
sentences.translationZh: Tom在離這裡不遠的一家商店裡買了一臺相機。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom在离这里不远的一家商店里买了一台相机。

sentences.text: Tom came a little earlier today than he usually does.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆今天來得比往常要早一些。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆今天来得比往常要早一些。

sentences.text: Tom cut down the tree that was in front of his house.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆砍了他門前的樹。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆砍了他門前的樹。

sentences.text: Tom didn't know what he'd done was against the rules.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道他的所作所為違反了規則。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道他的所作所为违反了规则。

sentences.text: Tom is already here, but Mary hasn't gotten here yet.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆已經在這裡了，但瑪麗還沒到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆已经在这里了，但玛丽还没到。

sentences.text: Tom ran out of matches so he couldn't light the fire.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆用盡了火柴，不能點火了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆用尽了火柴，不能点火了。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he has no intention of marrying you.
sentences.translationZh: Tom告訴我他們有想要娶你的想法。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom告诉我他们有想要娶你的想法。

sentences.text: We are looking forward to seeing you and your family.
sentences.translationZh: 我們很期待見到您和您的家人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们很期待见到您和您的家人。

sentences.text: We have to look into the disappearance of the doctor.
sentences.translationZh: 我們必須調查醫生的失蹤案。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们必须调查医生的失踪案。

sentences.text: We just have to make sure Tom is planning to be here.
sentences.translationZh: 我們只是需要確認Tom有要來這。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們只是需要確認Tom有要來這。

sentences.text: We looked out the window, but we didn't see anything.
sentences.translationZh: 我們看了窗外，但什麼都沒看見。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们看了窗外，但什么都没看见。

sentences.text: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
sentences.translationZh: 我們得到了在這個海灣內捕魚的特權。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

sentences.text: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.
sentences.translationZh: 我要告訴你的只能你我知道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要告訴你的只能你我知道。

sentences.text: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.
sentences.translationZh: 搖籃裡學的帶到墳墓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 搖籃裡學的帶到墳墓。

sentences.text: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
sentences.translationZh: 他來還是不來，結果是一樣的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。

sentences.text: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
sentences.translationZh: 不管你選哪條路，你都能按時到那裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

sentences.text: Why have you been late to school every day this week?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼你這個禮拜每天上學都遲到？
sentences.translationOriginal: 為什麼你這個禮拜每天上學都遲到？

sentences.text: You don't have to go to the party unless you want to.
sentences.translationZh: 除非你想去, 否則你不必去這個派對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除非你想去, 否則你不必去這個派對。

sentences.text: You look tired. You ought to rest for an hour or two.
sentences.translationZh: 你看起來很累。你應該休息一兩個小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看起來很累。你應該休息一兩個小時。

sentences.text: You should look after the children from time to time.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該偶爾照顧孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該偶爾照顧孩子。

sentences.text: You're the one who suggested that we travel together.
sentences.translationZh: 你是那個建議我們一起旅行的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是那個建議我們一起旅行的人。

sentences.text: A foreign language cannot be mastered in a year or so.
sentences.translationZh: 一個外國語言無法在一年左右就被掌握。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個外國語言無法在一年左右就被掌握。

sentences.text: After a couple of drinks, the guy was feeling no pain.
sentences.translationZh: 喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢夥就感覺不痛了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 喝了幾杯酒後，這個傢伙就感覺不痛了。

sentences.text: An argument may be logically sound without being true.
sentences.translationZh: 不正確的命題聽起來可能符合邏輯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。

sentences.text: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
sentences.translationZh: 當我們走到轉角處，湖就映入了眼簾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

sentences.text: Back in high school, I got up at 6 a.m. every morning.
sentences.translationZh: 以前讀高中的時候﹐我每天早上六點起床。
sentences.translationOriginal: 以前讀高中的時候﹐我每天早上六點起床。

sentences.text: Besides the piano, can you play any other instruments?
sentences.translationZh: 除了鋼琴以外，還會玩什麼樂器嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

sentences.text: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.
sentences.translationZh: 我就只告訴你，我不喜歡我們的新隊長。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。

sentences.text: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
sentences.translationZh: 你能提出解決問題的方法嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

sentences.text: Do you have an extra English dictionary by any chance?
sentences.translationZh: 您碰巧有一本額外的英文字典嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您碰巧有一本額外的英文字典嗎？

sentences.text: Don't throw away this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
sentences.translationZh: 這本雜誌不要扔。我還沒看呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

sentences.text: English is a very important language in today's world.
sentences.translationZh: 英語是當今世界上一種非常重要的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。

sentences.text: Everybody but Tom knew that he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.
sentences.translationZh: 他讓妹妹幫他塗他房間的牆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。

sentences.text: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.
sentences.translationZh: 考慮到他缺乏經驗，他做得[已經]非常好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 考虑到他缺乏经验，他做得[已经]非常好了。

sentences.text: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
sentences.translationZh: 他很快便與小區裡新來的男孩交上了朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。

sentences.text: He took care of the business after his father's death.
sentences.translationZh: 在他父親死後，他接管了公司。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在他父亲死后，他接管了公司。

sentences.text: How long does it take from here to your house on foot?
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡步行到你家要多長時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 从这里步行到你家要多长时间？

sentences.text: How long does it take to walk to your house from here?
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡步行到你家要多長時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 从这里步行到你家要多长时间？

sentences.text: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
sentences.translationZh: 我承認這可能不是最好的方法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

sentences.text: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
sentences.translationZh: 我深信事情會往更好的方向轉變。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。

sentences.text: I can't understand why Tom doesn't want to go with us.
sentences.translationZh: 我不理解為什麼湯姆不想和我們一起走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不理解为什么汤姆不想和我们一起走。

sentences.text: I didn't know who was going to meet me at the airport.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道誰會在機場見我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道谁会在机场见我。

sentences.text: I just wanted to prove to myself that I could do this.
sentences.translationZh: 我只想向自己證明我可以做到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我只想向自己证明我可以做到。

sentences.text: I think I now have enough money to buy the car I want.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我現在有足夠的錢買我想要的那輛車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我现在有足够的钱买我想要的那辆车。

sentences.text: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
sentences.translationZh: 我把他帶到校區裡最貴的餐館去了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

sentences.text: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.
sentences.translationZh: 我遇上了陣雨被淋得全身濕透。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我遇上了陣雨被淋得全身濕透。

sentences.text: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
sentences.translationZh: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。

sentences.text: I wouldn't be too surprised if this song became a hit.
sentences.translationZh: 如果這歌成名，我不會太驚訝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果这歌成名，我不会太惊讶。

sentences.text: I'll lend you the book as soon as I'm done reading it.
sentences.translationZh: 我一把這本書讀完了就借給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一把这本书读完了就借给你。

sentences.text: I'll never tell anyone where I've hidden the treasure.
sentences.translationZh: 我不會告訴任何人我藏寶的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不會告訴任何人我藏宝的地方。

sentences.text: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
sentences.translationZh: 我要去購物。你要跟著來嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？

sentences.text: I'm pretty sure Tom is the only one who can't do that.
sentences.translationZh: 我確信湯姆是唯一不會那麼做的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我确信汤姆是唯一不会那么做的人。

sentences.text: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
sentences.translationZh: 我肯定你會喜歡我們今晚的菜餚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。

sentences.text: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我弄丟了我的鑰匙，我就無法鎖門了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我弄丟了我的鑰匙，我就無法鎖門了。

sentences.text: If I were invisible, I wouldn't have to wear anything.
sentences.translationZh: 若我是隱形的，就不用穿衣服了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 若我是隱形的，就不用穿衣服了。

sentences.text: If I were to tell you all I know, you would be amazed.
sentences.translationZh: 要是我告訴你我所知的一切，你會被驚呆的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是我告诉你我所知的一切，你会被惊呆的。

sentences.text: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

sentences.text: Is there any chance you'll go to Australia next month?
sentences.translationZh: 你有下個月去澳洲的機會嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有下個月去澳洲的機會嗎？

sentences.text: Is there anything you want to add to what I just said?
sentences.translationZh: 我剛才說的內容，你想補充麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我刚才说的内容，你想补充么？

sentences.text: It is close to eleven. It's about time we went to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 快11點了。我們該上床睡覺了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 快11点了。我们该上床睡觉了。

sentences.text: It seems that most people only barbeque in the summer.
sentences.translationZh: 人們似乎只在夏天烤肉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人們似乎只在夏天烤肉。

sentences.text: It's quite difficult to master French in 2 or 3 years.
sentences.translationZh: 很難在2、3年內掌握法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很难在2、3年内掌握法语。

sentences.text: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.
sentences.translationZh: 出去之前確認一下所有的燈都關了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。

sentences.text: Mary has a bad back. It's hard for her to lift things.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗的背不好, 她很難把東西舉起來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 瑪麗的背不好, 她很難把東西舉起來。

sentences.text: Mary said that she loved me, but I didn't believe her.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗說她愛我，但是我並不相信她所說的話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽说她爱我，但是我并不相信她所说的话。

sentences.text: More than 40 percent of the students go to university.
sentences.translationZh: 40%以上的學生去讀大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 40%以上的学生去读大学。

sentences.text: My father often goes to the United States on business.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸經常去美國出差。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。

sentences.text: My father took out his wallet and gave me ten dollars.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸拿出他的錢包，並給了我10美元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸拿出他的钱包，并给了我10美元。

sentences.text: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.
sentences.translationZh: 有時候，我們應該後退一步想一想。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有时候，我们应该后退一步想一想。

sentences.text: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.
sentences.translationZh: 哲學不是我們用六個月就能學的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。

sentences.text: Please bring us two cups of tea and one cup of coffee.
sentences.translationZh: 請來兩杯茶和一杯咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请来两杯茶和一杯咖啡。

sentences.text: Please have a seat and wait until your name is called.
sentences.translationZh: 請在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请在被叫到名字之前坐在椅子上等候。

sentences.text: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
sentences.translationZh: 請把打印機裡面的空的墨粉鼓換掉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

sentences.text: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
sentences.translationZh: 從天上看下來，這條河像一條巨蛇。
sentences.translationOriginal: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

sentences.text: She covered the mouthpiece of the phone with her hand.
sentences.translationZh: 她用手捂住了電話的話筒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她用手捂住了电话的话筒。

sentences.text: She gave birth to her first child at twenty years old.
sentences.translationZh: 她在二十歲的時候生下第一個孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她在二十歲的時候生下第一個孩子。

sentences.text: That was the first time that a man walked on the moon.
sentences.translationZh: 那是人類第一次在月球上行走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是人类第一次在月球上行走。

sentences.text: That wasn't the main reason why Tom needed to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 這不是湯姆要做那件事的主要原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这不是汤姆要做那件事的主要原因。

sentences.text: The bus is full. You'll have to wait for the next one.
sentences.translationZh: 這班公車客滿了。你必須等下一班。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這班公車客滿了。你必須等下一班。

sentences.text: The policeman told me that the last bus leaves at ten.
sentences.translationZh: 警察告訴我巴士的末班車在十點出發。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察告诉我巴士的末班车在十点出发。

sentences.text: The professor spoke too fast for anyone to understand.
sentences.translationZh: 那個教授講得太快了，沒有一個人聽得懂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个教授讲得太快了，没有一个人听得懂。

sentences.text: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.
sentences.translationZh: 他們的合同在這個月底到期。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。

sentences.text: They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.
sentences.translationZh: 他們給士兵提供了充足的食物和水。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们给士兵提供了充足的食物和水。

sentences.text: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.
sentences.translationZh: 這被認為是一件大事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这被认为是一件大事。

sentences.text: Tom and I have decided to go to Australia next summer.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆和我決定下個夏天去澳大利亞
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆和我决定下个夏天去澳大利亚

sentences.text: Tom could have dealt with the problem in a better way.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆本可以用更好的方式處理問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆本可以用更好的方式处理问题。

sentences.text: Tom couldn't get to sleep till after three last night.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆昨晚三點多才睡著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆昨晚三点多才睡着。

sentences.text: Tom didn't seem to want to tell me why he'd done that.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆似乎不想告訴我為什麼他要那樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆似乎不想告诉我为什么他要那样做。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't know the difference between Iraq and Iran.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道伊拉克和伊朗有什麼區別。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道伊拉克和伊朗有什么区别。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't like people who smoke in no smoking areas.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆討厭在禁菸區吸菸的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆讨厌在禁烟区吸烟的人。

sentences.text: Tom dragged himself out of bed and put on his clothes.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆從床上爬起來，穿上了衣服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆从床上爬起来，穿上了衣服。

sentences.text: Tom got so absorbed in his work that he forgot to eat.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆太專注於他的工作，以至於忘了吃飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆太专注于他的工作，以至于忘了吃饭。

sentences.text: Tom poured cold water over himself to wake himself up.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆給自己澆涼水以清醒過來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆给自己浇凉水以清醒过来。

sentences.text: Tom probably doesn't know why the picnic was canceled.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆大概不知道為什麼野餐取消了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆大概不知道為什麼野餐取消了。

sentences.text: Tom said that Mary was probably still studying French.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說瑪麗可能還在學法語
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说玛丽可能还在学法语

sentences.text: Tom told Mary he couldn't do what she asked him to do.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗他不能做她要他做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉玛丽他不能做她要他做的事。

sentences.text: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
sentences.translationZh: 因為一份獎學金，Tom得以上大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因為一份獎學金，Tom得以上大學。

sentences.text: We will have learned English for five years next year.
sentences.translationZh: 到明年我們學英語就有5年了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 到明年我们学英语就有5年了。

sentences.text: Were you able to do everything you wanted to get done?
sentences.translationZh: 你是不是有能力做到你想要完成的所有事情呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是不是有能力做到你想要完成的所有事情呢？

sentences.text: When I first came back to Boston, I was really lonely.
sentences.translationZh: 當我第一次回波士頓時，我真是孤獨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我第一次回波士顿时，我真是孤独。

sentences.text: Who is in charge of the office while the boss is away?
sentences.translationZh: 在主任不在的時候，辦公室由誰來負責？
sentences.translationOriginal: 在主任不在的时候，办公室由谁来负责？

sentences.text: Why don't you wait here while I finish what I'm doing?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼你不在這裡等到我做完為止？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为什么你不在这里等到我做完为止？

sentences.text: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
sentences.translationZh: 如果您同意, 我想給他這份工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果您同意, 我想給他這份工作。

sentences.text: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
sentences.translationZh: 他毫不猶豫地把自己的車賣了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他毫不犹豫地把自己的车卖了。

sentences.text: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
sentences.translationZh: 你每次都繼續犯同樣的錯誤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。

sentences.text: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
sentences.translationZh: 你看上去很蒼白。你最好立刻去床上躺會兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看上去很苍白。你最好立刻去床上躺会儿。

sentences.text: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
sentences.translationZh: 你必須把你的照片貼在申請書上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

sentences.text: You should've done it earlier. It can't be helped now.
sentences.translationZh: 你本應該早點做的。現在已經沒有任何辦法了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你本应该早点做的。现在已经没有任何办法了。

sentences.text: You're the one who suggested that we do that together.
sentences.translationZh: 你是那個建議我們一起做那件事的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你是那個建議我們一起做那件事的人。

sentences.text: He'd like to have a coffee after work. "I would too."
sentences.translationZh: 他想在下班後喝杯咖啡。 "我也想。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 他想在下班後喝杯咖啡。 "我也想。"

sentences.text: How did you get my phone number? "Tom gave it to me."
sentences.translationZh: “你怎麼知道我的電話號碼的？” “湯姆告訴我的。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你怎么知道我的电话号码的？” “汤姆告诉我的。”

sentences.text: According to TV news, there was a plane crash in India.
sentences.translationZh: 根據電視新聞，一架飛機在印度墜毀了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根据电视新闻，一架飞机在印度坠毁了。

sentences.text: After I talked with my teacher, I decided to work hard.
sentences.translationZh: 跟我的老師談過後，我決定認真努力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 跟我的老師談過後，我決定認真努力。

sentences.text: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
sentences.translationZh: 讀完他的書後，我覺得我可以構建一棟房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讀完他的書後，我覺得我可以構建一棟房子。

sentences.text: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
sentences.translationZh: 所有的馬都是動物，但並非所有的動物都是馬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有的马都是动物，但并非所有的动物都是马。

sentences.text: Are there any direct flights between Boston and Sydney?
sentences.translationZh: 請問波士頓和悉尼之間有直飛航班嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 请问波士顿和悉尼之间有直飞航班吗？

sentences.text: As far as I know, there is nothing wrong with his plan.
sentences.translationZh: 據我所知，他的計畫沒有出差錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 據我所知，他的計畫沒有出差錯。

sentences.text: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
sentences.translationZh: 別忘了一到倫敦就給我們留言啊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。

sentences.text: Being late is always better than not showing up at all.
sentences.translationZh: 遲到總比不到好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 迟到总比不到好。

sentences.text: Blenders are nice for people who really like smoothies.
sentences.translationZh: 攪拌機對真的喜歡冰沙的人來說很不錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 攪拌機對真的喜歡冰沙的人來說很不錯。

sentences.text: Books are for people who wish they were somewhere else.
sentences.translationZh: 書是為了那些希望自己在另一個地方的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 書是為了那些希望自己在另一個地方的人。

sentences.text: Did you remember that you were supposed to buy candles?
sentences.translationZh: 你記得自己該買蠟燭嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你记得自己该买蜡烛吗？

sentences.text: Do you want to get married first or have a child first?
sentences.translationZh: 你想我們先結婚還是先生孩子？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想我们先结婚还是先生孩子？

sentences.text: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
sentences.translationZh: 說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。

sentences.text: Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
sentences.translationZh: 埃博拉是人類已知的最致命的病毒之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 埃博拉是人类已知的最致命的病毒之一。

sentences.text: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
sentences.translationZh: 在明天前完成報告幾乎是不可能的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。

sentences.text: From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
sentences.translationZh: 從天色看起來，下午可能會下雨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 從天色看起來，下午可能會下雨。

sentences.text: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
sentences.translationZh: 德國在1880年代採取了一種社會保障制度。
sentences.translationOriginal: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

sentences.text: He doesn't know the difference between right and wrong.
sentences.translationZh: 他好壞不分。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他好坏不分。

sentences.text: He went on reading the book as if nothing had happened.
sentences.translationZh: 他繼續讀書，好像什麼事也沒有發生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他繼續讀書，好像什麼事也沒有發生。

sentences.text: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
sentences.translationZh: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界紀錄。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界紀錄。

sentences.text: I can't believe Tom was able to do this all by himself.
sentences.translationZh: 沒法相信，湯姆沒人幫助自己一個人就做到了這些。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没法相信，汤姆没人帮助自己一个人就做到了这些。

sentences.text: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
sentences.translationZh: 我夏天沒有空調會死。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我夏天没有空调会死。

sentences.text: I don't know where my crutches are. Have you seen them?
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道把柺杖放哪去了，你有看到嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道把拐杖放哪去了，你有看到嗎？

sentences.text: I don't want to go there. He doesn't want to go either.
sentences.translationZh: 我不想去那兒，他也不想。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不想去那儿，他也不想。

sentences.text: I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
sentences.translationZh: 我感覺困得幾乎不能睜開我的眼睛了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感觉困得几乎不能睁开我的眼睛了。

sentences.text: I found a good place to buy fruit a couple of days ago.
sentences.translationZh: 前幾天我發現了一個買水果的好地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 前几天我发现了一个买水果的好地方。

sentences.text: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
sentences.translationZh: 我知道有人認識我的可能性微乎其微。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我知道有人认识我的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.text: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
sentences.translationZh: 我期待聽到你在這件事上的想法 。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法 。

sentences.text: I lost my job and I have no money. I'm at my wit's end.
sentences.translationZh: 我失業又沒錢。真不知該何去何從。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我失業又沒錢。真不知該何去何從。

sentences.text: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.
sentences.translationZh: 我從不回覆陌生人發來的電子郵件。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我从不回复陌生人发来的电子邮件。

sentences.text: I really look forward to your visit in the near future.
sentences.translationZh: 我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很期待在不久的將來您的光臨。

sentences.text: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
sentences.translationZh: 我跟英語母語者學了四年英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我跟英语母语者学了四年英语。

sentences.text: I was quite thirsty and wanted to drink something cool.
sentences.translationZh: 我很渴，想喝點冷飲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很渴，想喝点冷饮。

sentences.text: I'm afraid I can't help you. You must ask someone else.
sentences.translationZh: 我擔心可能幫不了你，你需要找其他人幫忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我担心可能帮不了你，你需要找其他人帮忙。

sentences.text: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
sentences.translationZh: 我很驚訝，你竟然不知道他們結婚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很惊讶，你竟然不知道他们结婚。

sentences.text: If you are not going to the concert, then neither am I.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不去音樂會, 我也不去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不去音樂會, 我也不去。

sentences.text: Instead of going to Europe, I decided to go to America.
sentences.translationZh: 我決定去美國，而不是歐洲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我决定去美国，而不是欧洲。

sentences.text: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
sentences.translationZh: 先熨燙領子的裡面，然後是外面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

sentences.text: It takes 165 years for Neptune to orbit around the sun.
sentences.translationZh: 海王星繞行太陽一週要花一百六十五年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海王星繞行太陽一周要花一百六十五年。

sentences.text: It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
sentences.translationZh: 那是在我到家以後，我才不見了我的錢包。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那是在我到家以后，我才不见了我的钱包。

sentences.text: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
sentences.translationZh: 你能在我們的婚禮上唱歌就太好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。

sentences.text: It's easy to make friends, but hard to get rid of them.
sentences.translationZh: 交朋友很容易, 但擺脫他們很難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 交朋友很容易, 但擺脫他們很難。

sentences.text: It's not that easy to learn a new language after fifty.
sentences.translationZh: 五十歲以後學一門新的語言不是那麼容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 五十岁以后学一门新的语言不是那么容易。

sentences.text: It's up to you to decide whether we'll go there or not.
sentences.translationZh: 該由你來決定我們去不去那兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 该由你来决定我们去不去那儿。

sentences.text: Judging from the look of the sky, it is likely to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 看看天的樣子，要下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看看天的样子，要下雨了。

sentences.text: Kissing a person who smokes is like licking an ashtray.
sentences.translationZh: 親吻一個抽菸的人就像在舔菸灰缸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。

sentences.text: Lake Baikal in Russia is the deepest lake in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 在俄羅斯的貝加爾湖是世界上最深的湖泊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在俄羅斯的貝加爾湖是世界上最深的湖泊。

sentences.text: Let's go out and eat dinner together from time to time.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我們偶爾出去一起吃晚餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讓我們偶爾出去一起吃晚餐。

sentences.text: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
sentences.translationZh: 多數人每天至少刷兩次牙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。

sentences.text: My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.
sentences.translationZh: 著火的時候我媽媽恰好在那。
sentences.translationOriginal: 着火的时候我妈妈恰好在那。

sentences.text: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
sentences.translationZh: 我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我太太兼職的工作賺進了一些額外的錢。

sentences.text: Not knowing what to do, I asked the teacher for advice.
sentences.translationZh: 因為不知道做什麼，所以我向老師尋求建議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为不知道做什么，所以我向老师寻求建议。

sentences.text: One hundred and fifty people entered the marathon race.
sentences.translationZh: 150個人參加了馬拉松比賽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 150个人参加了马拉松比赛。

sentences.text: Only one third of the members turned up at the meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 僅三分之一的成員出席了會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 仅三分之一的成员出席了会议。

sentences.text: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
sentences.translationZh: 威廉王子是英國王位第二順位繼承人
sentences.translationOriginal: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人

sentences.text: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
sentences.translationZh: 好幾間小屋被洪水孤立起來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。

sentences.text: She came to Japan for the purpose of studying Japanese.
sentences.translationZh: 她為了學習日文來到日本。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她為了學習日文來到日本。

sentences.text: She needed some money to buy something to feed her dog.
sentences.translationZh: 她需要一些錢來買點東西喂她的狗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她需要一些钱来买点东西喂她的狗。

sentences.text: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
sentences.translationZh: 能不能麻煩你告訴我去鄰村怎麼走？
sentences.translationOriginal: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？

sentences.text: That wasn't the main reason that Tom needed to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 這不是湯姆要做那件事的主要原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这不是汤姆要做那件事的主要原因。

sentences.text: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
sentences.translationZh: 日本軍隊看來強大得不可阻擋。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。

sentences.text: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管天氣很冷，孩子卻沒有大衣穿。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。

sentences.text: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
sentences.translationZh: 不像狗, 這隻鶴從來沒有夢想過飛翔。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不像狗, 這隻鶴從來沒有夢想過飛翔。

sentences.text: The friend who I thought would pass the exam failed it.
sentences.translationZh: 那個我認為會通過考試的朋友失敗了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那个我认为会通过考试的朋友失败了。

sentences.text: The leader governed his country for more than 50 years.
sentences.translationZh: 這位領導人統治了他的國家五十年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這位領導人統治了他的國家五十年。

sentences.text: The moment I held the baby in my arms, it began to cry.
sentences.translationZh: 我一把孩子抱在手裡，他就開始哭了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一把孩子抱在手里，他就开始哭了。

sentences.text: The mother missed her daughter who was away at college.
sentences.translationZh: 媽媽想念她在讀大學的女兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 妈妈想念她在读大学的女儿。

sentences.text: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
sentences.translationZh: 出國的人數一直在增加。
sentences.translationOriginal: 出国的人数一直在增加。

sentences.text: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.
sentences.translationZh: 奧運會已經開幕了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 奥运会已经开幕了。

sentences.text: The other day I discovered a book written by my father.
sentences.translationZh: 前幾天我發現了一本我父親寫的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 前几天我发现了一本我父亲写的书。

sentences.text: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
sentences.translationZh: 警察調查事故的原因。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察调查事故的原因。

sentences.text: The show was very interesting. You should have seen it.
sentences.translationZh: 演出真的很有意思，你該去看看的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 演出真的很有意思，你该去看看的。

sentences.text: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.
sentences.translationZh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。

sentences.text: The weather report says we'll get three inches of snow.
sentences.translationZh: 天氣預報說會下三英寸雪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天气预报说会下三英寸雪。

sentences.text: There is a certain amount of truth in what he's saying.
sentences.translationZh: 他說的話有一定的道理。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他說的話有一定的道理。

sentences.text: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
sentences.translationZh: 油價上漲的可能性很高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 油价上涨的可能性很高。

sentences.text: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
sentences.translationZh: 必須有外交解決的途徑。
sentences.translationOriginal: 必须有外交解决的途径。

sentences.text: They had their houses destroyed by a strong earthquake.
sentences.translationZh: 他們的房屋被強烈地震摧毀了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們的房屋被強烈地震摧毀了。

sentences.text: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
sentences.translationZh: 他們在這次的投資中得到百分之八的收益。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們在這次的投資中得到百分之八的收益。

sentences.text: This is one of the best restaurants I've ever eaten in.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我吃過的最好的餐館之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我吃过的最好的餐馆之一。

sentences.text: This is the most beautiful sight that I have ever seen.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我見過最美的景色了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我见过最美的景色了。

sentences.text: Time passes quickly when we're doing something we like.
sentences.translationZh: 在做喜歡的事情的時候時間過去得很快。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在做喜欢的事情的时候时间过去得很快。

sentences.text: Tom needs to study more if he hopes to pass this class.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆如果想通過這門課，就需要加勁學習。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆如果想通过这门课，就需要加劲学习。

sentences.text: Tom seems to hardly ever get his homework done on time.
sentences.translationZh: Tom似乎沒辦法準時完成他的作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom似乎没办法准时完成他的作业。

sentences.text: Tom told me not to open the envelope until my birthday.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我，到我生日那天我才能打開信封。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我，到我生日那天我才能打开信封。

sentences.text: Tom told me that he'd give me that book if I wanted it.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說過，如果我想要的話他可以把這本書給我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说过，如果我想要的话他可以把这本书给我。

sentences.text: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
sentences.translationZh: 我們在探險的時候遇到了很多困難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。

sentences.text: What do you make of his attitude towards us these days?
sentences.translationZh: 你做了什麼讓他這些日子用這種態度對待我們？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你做了什麼讓他這些日子用這種態度對待我們？

sentences.text: When she saw that they had no schools, she started one.
sentences.translationZh: 當她發現他們還沒有學校，她就辦了一個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当她发现他们还没有学校，她就办了一个。

sentences.text: When we're children, everything around us looks so big.
sentences.translationZh: 我們小時候，所有的一切對我們來說都顯得那麼大。。。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们小时候，所有的一切对我们来说都显得那么大。。。

sentences.text: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.
sentences.translationZh: 你成功與否取決於你自身的努力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。

sentences.text: Will you help me give out the programs to those people?
sentences.translationZh: 你能幫我給這些人分發節目單嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能帮我给这些人分发节目单吗？

sentences.text: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
sentences.translationZh: 當女性跟一個男人吃飯時，女性會吃得比較少。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當女性跟一個男人吃飯時，女性會吃得比較少。

sentences.text: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
sentences.translationZh: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？

sentences.text: You had better read a lot of books while you are young.
sentences.translationZh: 你最好在年輕的時候多讀點書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你最好在年轻的时候多读点书。

sentences.text: You've got to set the alarm clock before you go to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 在你上床睡覺之前，你必須把鬧鐘設定好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在你上床睡覺之前，你必須把鬧鐘設定好。

sentences.text: A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
sentences.translationZh: 一個句子以一個大寫字母開始。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個句子以一個大寫字母開始。

sentences.text: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
sentences.translationZh: 我的一個女性朋友喜歡跟我一起去同志酒吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。

sentences.text: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.
sentences.translationZh: 一杯冷水在暑熱的天氣裡十分提神。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。

sentences.text: A lot of students around the world are studying English.
sentences.translationZh: 世界上許多學生正在學習英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 世界上許多學生正在學習英語。

sentences.text: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
sentences.translationZh: 有時候口誤對政治家來說是致命的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。

sentences.text: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
sentences.translationZh: 美國是一個自稱沒有社會階層的國家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

sentences.text: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
sentences.translationZh: 除了雨天，我都是騎車去上班的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

sentences.text: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
sentences.translationZh: 哥倫布提出，向西航行可以到達印度。
sentences.translationOriginal: 哥伦布提出，向西航行可以到达印度。

sentences.text: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
sentences.translationZh: 大部份的保險計劃不包含整容手術。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大部份的保險計劃不包含整容手術。

sentences.text: Dad gave me a book, and my little brother gave me a pen.
sentences.translationZh: 爸爸給了我一本書, 弟弟給了我一枝筆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 爸爸給了我一本書, 弟弟給了我一枝筆。

sentences.text: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
sentences.translationZh: 你還和你的高中同學保持聯繫嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？

sentences.text: Do you know how far it is from the station to city hall?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道從火車站到市政府有多遠？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道从火车站到市政府有多远？

sentences.text: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
sentences.translationZh: 由於天氣變差，出發延遲了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

sentences.text: Everyone except Tom knew that he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: He always plans a thing out carefully before he does it.
sentences.translationZh: 他每件事做之前都會細心計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他每件事做之前都會細心計劃。

sentences.text: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
sentences.translationZh: 他剛發表一系列有趣的文章。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

sentences.text: He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.
sentences.translationZh: 為了不錯過火車，他匆匆趕往了車站。
sentences.translationOriginal: 为了不错过火车，他匆匆赶往了车站。

sentences.text: He visited his hometown for the first time in ten years.
sentences.translationZh: 他10年中第一次訪問他的故鄉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他10年中第一次访问他的故乡。

sentences.text: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
sentences.translationZh: 你估計做那件事需要花費你多少時間呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？

sentences.text: I thought that I told you to stay away from my computer.
sentences.translationZh: 我說過讓你離我的電腦遠一點的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我说过让你离我的电脑远一点的。

sentences.text: I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
sentences.translationZh: 我跟你說過她在的時候不要說這件事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。

sentences.text: I was surprised at his strong resemblance to his father.
sentences.translationZh: 他像極了他父親，這讓我震驚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他像极了他父亲，这让我震惊。

sentences.text: I will only buy the car if they repair the brakes first.
sentences.translationZh: 除非他們事先修好剎車，我才會買車子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

sentences.text: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你能教我怎麼做，我會很感激。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你能教我怎麼做，我會很感激。

sentences.text: I'd like to exchange this shirt that I bought yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。

sentences.text: I'm a stranger here myself. I'm afraid I can't help you.
sentences.translationZh: 我對這裡不熟。恐怕我不能幫你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我對這裡不熟。恐怕我不能幫你。

sentences.text: I've always wondered what it'd be like to have siblings.
sentences.translationZh: 我總是想有兄弟姐妹會怎麼樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我总是想有兄弟姐妹会怎么样。

sentences.text: If you can't come, you should let me know ahead of time.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不能來，你該讓我提前知道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不能來，你該讓我提前知道。

sentences.text: Industry as we know it today didn't exist in those days.
sentences.translationZh: 我們今天所認識的工業在那個時代不存在。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们今天所认识的工业在那个时代不存在。

sentences.text: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.
sentences.translationZh: 他們在黎明前控制住了火勢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。

sentences.text: It's a good thing to read good books when you are young.
sentences.translationZh: 年輕的時候多看點好書是件好事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 年轻的时候多看点好书是件好事。

sentences.text: It's hard to say what the weather will be like tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 很難說明天的天氣將會怎樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

sentences.text: Let me remind you again that March 31st is the due date.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我再次提醒你3月31日是到期日。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讓我再次提醒你3月31日是到期日。

sentences.text: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我來告訴你我不贊成你的理由。
sentences.translationOriginal: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。

sentences.text: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不計較太多，生活會更容易些。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。

sentences.text: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
sentences.translationZh: 學好一門外語需要堅韌不拔的毅力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。
