sentences.text: Much of London was destroyed in the seventeenth century.
sentences.translationZh: 倫敦許多部份在十七世紀時被摧毀。
sentences.translationOriginal: 倫敦許多部份在十七世紀時被摧毀。

sentences.text: My brother would often stay up all night reading novels.
sentences.translationZh: 我哥哥經常熬夜看小說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我哥哥經常熬夜看小說。

sentences.text: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸現在非常專注於股市。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。

sentences.text: My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.
sentences.translationZh: 我的記性不好。我簡直不記得他的名字了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的記性不好。我簡直不記得他的名字了。

sentences.text: My parents have gone to the airport to see my uncle off.
sentences.translationZh: 我父母去機場送我叔叔了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父母去机场送我叔叔了。

sentences.text: My plan is to spend the New Year's holiday in Australia.
sentences.translationZh: 我打算在澳大利亞過新年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我打算在澳大利亚过新年。

sentences.text: My sister is twenty-one years old and a college student.
sentences.translationZh: 我妹妹21歲，是個大學生。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我妹妹21岁，是个大学生。

sentences.text: Please send me a reply as soon as you receive this mail.
sentences.translationZh: 收到此郵件後請儘快給我答覆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 收到此邮件后请尽快给我答复。

sentences.text: She is wearing the same dress that she had on yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 她穿著跟昨天相同的衣服。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她穿著跟昨天相同的衣服。

sentences.text: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
sentences.translationZh: 有些人不喜歡把錢存銀行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有些人不喜欢把钱存银行。

sentences.text: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.
sentences.translationZh: 非常感謝您昨晚美妙的晚餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 非常感謝您昨晚美妙的晚餐。

sentences.text: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
sentences.translationZh: 大部分觀眾是年幼的兒童。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

sentences.text: The bathtub was filled with hot water and flower petals.
sentences.translationZh: 浴缸裡滿是熱水和花瓣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 浴缸裡滿是熱水和花瓣。

sentences.text: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
sentences.translationZh: 船長要為乘客安全負責。
sentences.translationOriginal: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

sentences.text: The colors of the American flag are red, white and blue.
sentences.translationZh: 美國國旗的顏色是紅白藍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。

sentences.text: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
sentences.translationZh: 法庭對他的謀殺罪名作出了無罪判決。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

sentences.text: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
sentences.translationZh: 唯一能聽到的聲音是鐘的滴答聲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 唯一能听到的声音是钟的滴答声。

sentences.text: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
sentences.translationZh: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。
sentences.translationOriginal: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。

sentences.text: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
sentences.translationZh: 大部分的學生來自西海岸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大部分的學生來自西海岸。

sentences.text: There was only one warden on duty when the riot started.
sentences.translationZh: 暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。
sentences.translationOriginal: 暴動開始時只有一位監獄長值班。

sentences.text: There's something I've been meaning to discuss with you.
sentences.translationZh: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有件事我一直想跟你商量。

sentences.text: This is the house where I used to live when I was young.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我年輕時候住的房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我年轻时候住的房子。

sentences.text: To be very honest with you, I don't think I can do that.
sentences.translationZh: 和你說句實話，我覺得我做不到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 和你说句实话，我觉得我做不到。

sentences.text: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆胸痛，所以去了醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

sentences.text: We all chipped in to buy our teacher a birthday present.
sentences.translationZh: 我們所有人湊份子給老師買生日禮物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们所有人凑份子给老师买生日礼物。

sentences.text: We could stay in Boston for a few more days if you like.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你願意的話，我們可以在波士頓多待幾天
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你愿意的话，我们可以在波士顿多待几天

sentences.text: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.
sentences.translationZh: 這個月底前，我們必須交報告。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。

sentences.text: We're all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
sentences.translationZh: 我們都期待看到你和你的家人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。

sentences.text: We're finding it difficult deciding on which one to buy.
sentences.translationZh: 我們覺得很難決定買哪一個。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。

sentences.text: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
sentences.translationZh: 你比較喜歡哪一個，搖滾樂還是古典音樂？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你比較喜歡哪一個，搖滾樂還是古典音樂？

sentences.text: With just a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他再努力一點，就可能已經成功了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他再努力一点，就可能已经成功了。

sentences.text: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
sentences.translationZh: 你夠大了知道不要那樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你夠大了知道不要那樣做。

sentences.text: You should ask your father for his advice and follow it.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該問你父親的忠告並遵守它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該問你父親的忠告並遵守它。

sentences.text: You'd better take an umbrella with you in case it rains.
sentences.translationZh: 以防下雨你最好帶把傘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 以防下雨你最好带把伞。

sentences.text: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。

sentences.text: Your mother must have been beautiful when she was young.
sentences.translationZh: 你母親年輕的時候一定很美。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你母親年輕的時候一定很美。

sentences.text: When will you be back? "It all depends on the weather."
sentences.translationZh: “你什麼時候回來？”“這都要看天氣。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你什么时候回来？”“这都要看天气。”

sentences.text: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
sentences.translationZh: 一個入室盜竊者趁我去旅遊的時候闖入了我家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。

sentences.text: About how much will I have to pay for all the treatments?
sentences.translationZh: 所有的醫藥費我大概要付多少？
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有的医药费我大概要付多少？

sentences.text: According to the weather forecast, it will snow tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 天氣預報說明天會下雪。
sentences.translationOriginal: 天气预报说明天会下雪。

sentences.text: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
sentences.translationZh: 行勝於言，但並不是所有情況都是這樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

sentences.text: Almost everyone in our village is related to one another.
sentences.translationZh: 我們村裡所有的村民幾乎彼此都是親戚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们村里所有的村民几乎彼此都是亲戚。

sentences.text: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
sentences.translationZh: 銀行對風險客戶收取較高的貸款利息。
sentences.translationOriginal: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

sentences.text: Children should keep away from the river. It's dangerous.
sentences.translationZh: 兒童應該遠離河流。有危險。
sentences.translationOriginal: 儿童应该远离河流。有危险。

sentences.text: English is spoken by more people than any other language.
sentences.translationZh: 說英語的人比說任何其他語言的人多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 說英語的人比說任何其他語言的人多。

sentences.text: Every day I waited for her at the bookstore after school.
sentences.translationZh: 我每天放學後在書店那裡等她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我每天放学后在书店那里等她。

sentences.text: Everybody except Tom knew that he didn't need to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 除了湯姆以外任何人都知道他沒必要這麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了汤姆以外任何人都知道他没必要这么做。

sentences.text: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.
sentences.translationZh: 尼日爾仍然有50萬孩子面臨著營養不良。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尼日尔仍然有50万孩子面临着营养不良。

sentences.text: He is proud of having been educated in the United States.
sentences.translationZh: 他對自己在美國讀過書這件事感到很驕傲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他对自己在美国读过书这件事感到很骄傲。

sentences.text: I came to this country for the purpose of studying music.
sentences.translationZh: 我來這個國家的目的是學習音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我來這個國家的目的是學習音樂。

sentences.text: I can't look at this painting without thinking of my mom.
sentences.translationZh: 我無法看著這幅畫而不想起我母親。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我無法看著這幅畫而不想起我母親。

sentences.text: I told Tom that I thought his house needed to be painted.
sentences.translationZh: 我告訴湯姆我認為他的房子要刷漆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我告诉汤姆我认为他的房子要刷漆。

sentences.text: I took it for granted that she would come to our wedding.
sentences.translationZh: 我理所當然地認為她會參加我們的結婚典禮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我理所当然地认为她会参加我们的结婚典礼。

sentences.text: I tried very hard to put an end to their heated argument.
sentences.translationZh: 我努力地平息他們不斷加溫的爭執。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我努力地平息他們不斷加溫的爭執。

sentences.text: I want to move out of this cramped room as soon as I can.
sentences.translationZh: 我想盡快從這個不透氣的屋子裡出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想尽快从这个不透气的屋子里出去。

sentences.text: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
sentences.translationZh: 我想看看您的郵票收藏。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

sentences.text: I'm not a university student, but I'm brighter than them.
sentences.translationZh: 我不是一個大學生, 但我比他們更聰明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不是一個大學生, 但我比他們更聰明。

sentences.text: If you do not have this program, you can download it now.
sentences.translationZh: 假如你沒有這個程序，你現在就可以去下載。
sentences.translationOriginal: 假如你没有这个程序，你现在就可以去下载。

sentences.text: If you would move over, there would be room for everyone.
sentences.translationZh: 如果您移過去一點, 每個人就可以有空間了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果您移過去一點, 每個人就可以有空間了。

sentences.text: It is very expensive to keep up with the latest fashions.
sentences.translationZh: 跟上最近潮流時尚是件非常花錢的事兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 跟上最近潮流时尚是件非常花钱的事儿。

sentences.text: Mary isn't really sick. She's only pretending to be sick.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗不是真病。她只是裝病。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽不是真病。她只是装病。

sentences.text: More than 40 percent of the students go on to university.
sentences.translationZh: 40%以上的學生去讀大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 40%以上的学生去读大学。

sentences.text: No other mountain in the world is as tall as Mt. Everest.
sentences.translationZh: 世界上任何山峰都達不到珠穆朗瑪峰的高度。
sentences.translationOriginal: 世界上任何山峰都达不到珠穆朗瑪峰的高度。

sentences.text: She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible to do.
sentences.translationZh: 她試著舉起箱子，但發現不可能做到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她試著舉起箱子，但發現不可能做到。

sentences.text: She would often go to the theater when she was in London.
sentences.translationZh: 她在倫敦的時候，曾經常去劇院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她在伦敦的时候，曾经常去剧院。

sentences.text: Thanks very much for having me to dinner the other night.
sentences.translationZh: 謝謝那天晚上請我吃了飯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 谢谢那天晚上请我吃了饭。

sentences.text: That was the most interesting novel that I had ever read.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我所讀過的最有趣的小說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我所读过的最有趣的小说。

sentences.text: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
sentences.translationZh: 那家公司去年虧損了10億日元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。

sentences.text: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
sentences.translationZh: 節日和考試碰巧在同一天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。

sentences.text: The train was so crowded that I had to stand all the way.
sentences.translationZh: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。

sentences.text: They are leaving in three days, that is to say June 10th.
sentences.translationZh: 他們將在三天後離開, 那也就是說在六月十日。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們將在三天後離開, 那也就是說在六月十日。

sentences.text: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
sentences.translationZh: 他們視喬叟為英詩之父。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們視喬叟為英詩之父。

sentences.text: They were forced to kill and eat several of their horses.
sentences.translationZh: 他們被迫殺掉他們的幾匹馬來吃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们被迫杀掉他们的几匹马来吃。

sentences.text: This is the first time that I have heard of this website.
sentences.translationZh: 我第一次知道這個網站。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我第一次知道这个网站。

sentences.text: This is the last time I'll ask you to do anything for me.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我最後一次讓你為我做點事了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我最后一次让你为我做点事了。

sentences.text: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.
sentences.translationZh: 說實話，這對我來說有點太辣了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。

sentences.text: Tom did a good job predicting who would win the election.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆預測勝選者做得好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆预测胜选者做得好。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't have any friends who are willing to help him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆沒有願意幫助他的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆没有愿意帮助他的朋友。

sentences.text: Tom probably doesn't know how to do that as well as Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆可能不知道如何做得像瑪麗做得一樣好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆可能不知道如何做得像瑪麗做得一样好。

sentences.text: Tom used a fire extinguisher to try and put the fire out.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆試著用滅火器把火撲滅。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆試著用滅火器把火撲滅。

sentences.text: Tom was sitting alone at one of the tables near the door.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆獨自坐在門邊一個桌子旁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆獨自坐在門邊一個桌子旁。

sentences.text: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
sentences.translationZh: 海嘯席捲稻田, 淹沒了城鎮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海嘯席捲稻田, 淹沒了城鎮。

sentences.text: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
sentences.translationZh: 我們都期待看到你和你的家人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。

sentences.text: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
sentences.translationZh: 我們這裡以耶穌基督和查理斯國王之名。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們這裡以耶穌基督和查理斯國王之名。

sentences.text: We need you to tell us why you were absent all last week.
sentences.translationZh: 我們要你告訴我們你為什麼整個上週都缺勤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们要你告诉我们你为什么整个上周都缺勤。

sentences.text: We often hear it said that the Japanese are good workers.
sentences.translationZh: 我們經常聽說日本人工作勤奮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们经常听说日本人工作勤奋。

sentences.text: What have you done with my pen? It was here a minute ago.
sentences.translationZh: 你把我的鋼筆怎麼了? 一分鐘前它還在這裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你把我的鋼筆怎麼了? 一分鐘前它還在這裡。

sentences.text: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
sentences.translationZh: 當他咆哮時，他脖子上青筋暴起。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当他咆哮时，他脖子上青筋暴起。

sentences.text: Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?
sentences.translationZh: 我們有必要為上這門課買本教材嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？

sentences.text: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
sentences.translationZh: 為了救許多人犧牲一個人是否道德？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

sentences.text: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
sentences.translationZh: 你變了那麼多，以至於我幾乎認不出你了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。

sentences.text: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
sentences.translationZh: 你沒有干涉他人事務的權力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你沒有干涉他人事務的權力。

sentences.text: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
sentences.translationZh: 你永遠沒有第二次機會去打造第一印象。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你永遠沒有第二次機會去打造第一印象。

sentences.text: You should have done it earlier. It cannot be helped now.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該早點做的。現在沒人可以幫你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該早點做的。現在沒人可以幫你。

sentences.text: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
sentences.translationZh: 今天你們倆很讓人印象深刻。我為你們感到驕傲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

sentences.text: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.
sentences.translationZh: 散散步將會給你很好的食慾吃早餐。
sentences.translationOriginal: 散散步將會給你很好的食慾吃早餐。

sentences.text: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
sentences.translationZh: 真正的科學家不會這樣去思考。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

sentences.text: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
sentences.translationZh: 攀登富士山後，我得到了一首詩的靈感。
sentences.translationOriginal: 攀登富士山後，我得到了一首詩的靈感。

sentences.text: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
sentences.translationZh: 跑上山後，我完全喘不過氣來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 跑上山後，我完全喘不過氣來。

sentences.text: All you have to do is to write your name and address here.
sentences.translationZh: 你只要在這裡寫下你的姓名和地址就行了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你只要在这里写下你的姓名和地址就行了。

sentences.text: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然我享受打保齡球，但是我最近沒有去打保齡球。
sentences.translationOriginal: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

sentences.text: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
sentences.translationZh: 小心不要在單行道逆向行駛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 小心不要在单行道逆向行驶。

sentences.text: Between you and me, I'm going to quit my present job soon.
sentences.translationZh: 我只跟你說，我很快就要辭掉我現在的工作了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我只跟你说，我很快就要辞掉我现在的工作了。

sentences.text: Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
sentences.translationZh: 金髮女郎比其他顏色頭髮的女人多賺7％。
sentences.translationOriginal: 金髮女郎比其他顏色頭髮的女人多賺7％。

sentences.text: Both of Tom's parents passed away when he was quite young.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆很小的時候父母就都去世了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆很小的时候父母就都去世了。

sentences.text: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?
sentences.translationZh: 你真的需要提問題來知道答案嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？

sentences.text: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English.
sentences.translationZh: 說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。
sentences.translationOriginal: 說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。

sentences.text: Ebola spreads from person to person through bodily fluids.
sentences.translationZh: 埃博拉通過體液在人與人之間傳播。
sentences.translationOriginal: 埃博拉通过体液在人与人之间传播。

sentences.text: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
sentences.translationZh: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。

sentences.text: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.
sentences.translationZh: 他這個人話不多，但總是遵守諾言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。

sentences.text: He is numbered among the greatest scientists in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 他是世界上最偉大的科學家之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。

sentences.text: He owes his success both to working hard and to good luck.
sentences.translationZh: 他的成功要歸結於他的辛勤工作和好運氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的成功要归结于他的辛勤工作和好运气。

sentences.text: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
sentences.translationZh: 他被人發現倒在廚房的地板上，不省人事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

sentences.text: How long does it take to go from here to the Hilton Hotel?
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡到希爾頓飯店要花多久時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 從這裡到希爾頓飯店要花多久時間？

sentences.text: However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
sentences.translationZh: 無論我多麼努力嘗試，我都無法做到比她更好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。

sentences.text: I don't like being the one who always has to milk the cow.
sentences.translationZh: 我不喜歡做那個總是擠牛奶的人
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不喜欢做那个总是挤牛奶的人

sentences.text: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
sentences.translationZh: 我憑韌性克服了困難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我凭韧性克服了困难。

sentences.text: I had hoped that my mother would live until I got married.
sentences.translationZh: 我曾經希望我媽媽能活到我結婚的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我曾经希望我妈妈能活到我结婚的时候。

sentences.text: I had to abstain from smoking while I was in the hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 在醫院的時候，我不得不戒菸。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在医院的时候，我不得不戒烟。

sentences.text: I have so many clothes I don't know what to wear tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 我有那麼多衣服，以至於我不知道明天穿什麼了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有那么多衣服，以至于我不知道明天穿什么了。

sentences.text: I'd gladly pay more for something if it's of high quality.
sentences.translationZh: 如果它是高品質的東西我會很樂意多付一點錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果它是高品質的東西我會很樂意多付一點錢。

sentences.text: I'd like to have this meat dish with your best white wine.
sentences.translationZh: 我想在吃這肉喝你最好的白酒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想在吃这肉喝你最好的白酒。

sentences.text: I'm sorry I wasn't able to see you when you came by today.
sentences.translationZh: 我很抱歉今天您來的時候沒能見您。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很抱歉今天您来的时候没能见您。

sentences.text: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
sentences.translationZh: 我一直想成為一名職業籃球運動員。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

sentences.text: I've never been to New York, and my sister hasn't, either.
sentences.translationZh: 我從沒去過紐約，我妹妹也沒有。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我从没去过纽约，我妹妹也没有。

sentences.text: If I had the money, I would immediately buy this computer.
sentences.translationZh: 我要是有錢，立馬就買這臺電腦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我要是有钱，立马就买这台电脑。

sentences.text: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
sentences.translationZh: 在江戶時代賞月的宴會非常受歡迎。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在江戶時代賞月的宴會非常受歡迎。

sentences.text: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.
sentences.translationZh: 我們去不去那兒由你來決定。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们去不去那儿由你来决定。

sentences.text: It says in the Bible, "Man shall not live on bread alone."
sentences.translationZh: 聖經裡有一句話，叫做“人不能只靠麵包生活”。
sentences.translationOriginal: 圣经里有一句话，叫做“人不能只靠面包生活”。

sentences.text: It took me a little more time than usually to fall asleep.
sentences.translationZh: 我花了比平常多一點的時間入睡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我花了比平常多一點的時間入睡。

sentences.text: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
sentences.translationZh: 他很難掩飾對自己成功的驕傲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。

sentences.text: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.
sentences.translationZh: 一兩天是沒辦法逛完東京的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。

sentences.text: It's so secret that even I don't know what it's all about.
sentences.translationZh: 這太祕密了，連我都不知道它是關於什麼的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这太秘密了，连我都不知道它是关于什么的。

sentences.text: Many improvements have been made since this century began.
sentences.translationZh: 本世紀初以來，產生了很多進步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。

sentences.text: My grandfather sometimes talks to himself when he's alone.
sentences.translationZh: 我祖父一個人的時候，有時會自言自語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我祖父一个人的时候，有时会自言自语。

sentences.text: Some people like red wine and some people like white wine.
sentences.translationZh: 有人喜歡紅酒，有人喜歡白酒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有人喜歡紅酒，有人喜歡白酒。

sentences.text: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.
sentences.translationZh: 下車，把手放在背後。
sentences.translationOriginal: 下车，把手放在背后。

sentences.text: That coat may have cost a lot of money, but it's worth it.
sentences.translationZh: 那大衣可能花了很多錢，但它值得。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那大衣可能花了很多錢，但它值得。

sentences.text: That was the part that Tom and I were most confused about.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我和湯姆最困惑的部分。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我和汤姆最困惑的部分。

sentences.text: The Eiffel Tower is in the same city as the Louvre Museum.
sentences.translationZh: 埃菲爾鐵塔和盧浮宮在同一座城市。
sentences.translationOriginal: 埃菲尔铁塔和卢浮宫在同一座城市。

sentences.text: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
sentences.translationZh: 這場減價活動會持續三天，從今天開始。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

sentences.text: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
sentences.translationZh: 合同已經到手了，那就出去慶祝一下吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

sentences.text: The simplest way is often the best way to solve a problem.
sentences.translationZh: 解決問題最簡便的方法往往是最好的辦法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 解决问题最简便的方法往往是最好的办法。

sentences.text: The train will probably arrive at the station before noon.
sentences.translationZh: 火車大概會在中午前到站。
sentences.translationOriginal: 火车大概会在中午前到站。

sentences.text: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 大學在20年前由他的父親建立。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大学在20年前由他的父亲建立。

sentences.text: This is the place where the battle of Hastings took place.
sentences.translationZh: 這裡是黑斯廷斯戰役發生的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這裡是黑斯廷斯戰役發生的地方。

sentences.text: This place still looks the same as it did a long time ago.
sentences.translationZh: 這裡就像在古時候一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這裡就像在古時候一樣。

sentences.text: This was the most interesting book that she had ever read.
sentences.translationZh: 這是她讀過最有趣的書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這是她讀過最有趣的書。

sentences.text: Three months is too short a time to finish the experiment.
sentences.translationZh: 要完成實驗，三個月太短了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要完成实验，三个月太短了。

sentences.text: Tom didn't know that what he'd done was against the rules.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道他的所作所為違反了規則。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道他的所作所为违反了规则。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't know whether Mary is telling the truth or not.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗說的是真話還是假話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽说的是真话还是假话。

sentences.text: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
sentences.translationZh: Tom沒有意圖去邀請Mary去即將來臨的舞會。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

sentences.text: Tom spent most of the morning straightening up his office.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆花了大半早晨整理他的辦公室。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆花了大半早晨整理他的办公室。

sentences.text: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.
sentences.translationZh: 這個公司二分之三的僱員是工程師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个公司二分之三的雇员是工程师。

sentences.text: Was this wall built to keep people out or to keep them in?
sentences.translationZh: 建造這堵牆是為了把人隔在外面還是把他們留在裡面？
sentences.translationOriginal: 建造这堵墙是为了把人隔在外面还是把他们留在里面？

sentences.text: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.
sentences.translationZh: 去年夏天，我們在橋上看焰火看得很過癮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 去年夏天，我们在桥上看焰火看得很过瘾。

sentences.text: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
sentences.translationZh: 我們應該盡量避免把我們自己的信念強加在別人身上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們應該盡量避免把我們自己的信念強加在別人身上。

sentences.text: We were disappointed to hear that Tom couldn't get a visa.
sentences.translationZh: 我們很遺憾地聽說，湯姆沒能拿到簽證。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们很遗憾地听说，汤姆没能拿到签证。

sentences.text: What mountain do you think is the second highest in Japan?
sentences.translationZh: 你認為日本第二高峰是哪座山？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你认为日本第二高峰是哪座山？

sentences.text: When were you planning on telling Tom about what happened?
sentences.translationZh: 你準備啥時候告訴Tom發生了什麼
sentences.translationOriginal: 你准备啥时候告诉Tom发生了什么

sentences.text: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
sentences.translationZh: 由於天氣變差，出發延遲了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。

sentences.text: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
sentences.translationZh: 你不介意我關窗吧？我有點著涼了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。

sentences.text: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
sentences.translationZh: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦, 但是他們不是。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦, 但是他們不是。

sentences.text: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
sentences.translationZh: 你活著，但是卻不知道為什麼活著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。

sentences.text: When will you come back? "It all depends on the weather."
sentences.translationZh: “你什麼時候回來？”“這都要看天氣。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你什么时候回来？”“这都要看天气。”

sentences.text: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
sentences.translationZh: 根據我的估計，她現在應該在印度了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根據我的估計，她現在應該在印度了。

sentences.text: After I cleaned the window, I could see through it clearly.
sentences.translationZh: 清潔窗戶後，我能很清楚的從窗戶看出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 清潔窗戶後，我能很清楚的從窗戶看出去。

sentences.text: All of a sudden, the enemy bombs came down on us like rain.
sentences.translationZh: 突然間，敵人的炸彈像雨點一樣落向我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 突然间，敌人的炸弹像雨点一样落向我们。

sentences.text: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
sentences.translationZh: 所有訂購必須在今年年底前支付款項。
sentences.translationOriginal: 所有訂購必須在今年年底前支付款項。

sentences.text: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
sentences.translationZh: 你所說的一切都將成為呈堂證供。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

sentences.text: Could you please talk a bit louder? I can't hear very well.
sentences.translationZh: 你能大聲點講嗎？我聽不太清。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能大声点讲吗？我听不太清。

sentences.text: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
sentences.translationZh: 這幾年對作業療法的需求在迅速增長。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

sentences.text: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
sentences.translationZh: 他在上個景氣時期炒股攢下了一筆錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

sentences.text: How many times a day do you look at yourself in the mirror?
sentences.translationZh: 你一天照幾次鏡子？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你一天照几次镜子？

sentences.text: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
sentences.translationZh: 如何克服日元升高是個大問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

sentences.text: I am in the habit of taking some exercise before breakfast.
sentences.translationZh: 我在吃早餐前有運動的習慣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在吃早餐前有運動的習慣。

sentences.text: I can't believe your parents let you come here by yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 我不敢相信你父母讓你自己過來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不敢相信你父母让你自己过来。

sentences.text: I do not remember seeing the letter, but perhaps I read it.
sentences.translationZh: 我不記得我看過這封信, 但或許我讀過它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不記得我看過這封信, 但或許我讀過它。

sentences.text: I felt quite relieved after I had said all I wanted to say.
sentences.translationZh: 說了所有我要說的話後，我感覺很輕鬆。
sentences.translationOriginal: 说了所有我要说的话后，我感觉很轻松。

sentences.text: I let Tom watch a little TV after he finished his homework.
sentences.translationZh: 我讓Tom在做完作業後看一點電視。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我让Tom在做完作业后看一点电视。

sentences.text: I noticed a note on my desk, but I don't know who wrote it.
sentences.translationZh: 我發現了我辦公桌上有張字條, 但是我不知道是誰寫的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我發現了我辦公桌上有張字條, 但是我不知道是誰寫的。

sentences.text: I slept a little during lunch break because I was so tired.
sentences.translationZh: 我在午休時間睡了一會兒，因為我太累了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我在午休时间睡了一会儿，因为我太累了。

sentences.text: I think I now have enough money to buy the car that I want.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我現在有足夠的錢買我想要的那輛車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我现在有足够的钱买我想要的那辆车。

sentences.text: I think that I now have enough money to buy the car I want.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我現在有足夠的錢買我想要的那輛車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我现在有足够的钱买我想要的那辆车。

sentences.text: I want to go and change into that shirt I bought yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想去換我昨天買的這件襯衫。

sentences.text: I would rather live by myself than do as he tells me to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我寧願自己獨立生活也不要他來指使我。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我寧願自己獨立生活也不要他來指使我。

sentences.text: I would really like to know why he did something like that.
sentences.translationZh: 我真的很想知道他為什麼做了像那樣的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我真的很想知道他為什麼做了像那樣的事。

sentences.text: In the winter, many older people slip on ice and fall down.
sentences.translationZh: 在冬天，很多老人在冰上滑倒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在冬天，很多老人在冰上滑倒。

sentences.text: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?
sentences.translationZh: 由醫生來決定某人何時該死是對的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？

sentences.text: Is there any chance that you'll go to Australia next month?
sentences.translationZh: 你有下個月去澳洲的機會嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有下個月去澳洲的機會嗎？

sentences.text: Leaving something unfinished is the worst thing you can do.
sentences.translationZh: 半途而廢是你所能做的最糟糕的事情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 半途而废是你所能做的最糟糕的事情。

sentences.text: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親經營外貿多年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父亲经营外贸多年。

sentences.text: No less than three hundred dollars was needed for the work.
sentences.translationZh: 這個工作需要不低於300美金。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个工作需要不低于300美金。

sentences.text: No matter how much I think about it, I can't understand it.
sentences.translationZh: 無論怎麼去想我都搞不清楚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论怎么去想我都搞不清楚。

sentences.text: No matter how much I think about it, I don't understand it.
sentences.translationZh: 無論怎麼去想我都搞不清楚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论怎么去想我都搞不清楚。

sentences.text: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
sentences.translationZh: 記者沒有猶豫地去幹涉了人們的私生活。
sentences.translationOriginal: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。

sentences.text: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.
sentences.translationZh: 帶孩子團體去圖書館一點問題都沒有。
sentences.translationOriginal: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。

sentences.text: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。

sentences.text: The main problem with Tom is that he has no sense of humor.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆的主要問題是他一點幽默感都沒有
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

sentences.text: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
sentences.translationZh: 最合邏輯的放鞋處是門口附近。
sentences.translationOriginal: 最合逻輯的放鞋處是門口附近。

sentences.text: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
sentences.translationZh: 只有能提出新問題的回答才是有用的回答。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只有能提出新问题的回答才是有用的回答。

sentences.text: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.
sentences.translationZh: 前幾天人生第一次去釣魚了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。

sentences.text: The population of Japan is larger than that of New Zealand.
sentences.translationZh: 日本的人口比新西蘭多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本的人口比新西兰多。

sentences.text: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
sentences.translationZh: 這場秀棒極了，但是門票太貴了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这场秀棒极了，但是门票太贵了。

sentences.text: There are some misprints, but all in all, it's a good book.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然有一些印刷錯誤, 但大致上說來, 這是一本好書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 雖然有一些印刷錯誤, 但大致上說來, 這是一本好書。

sentences.text: They tried very hard to gain an advantage over one another.
sentences.translationZh: 他們很努力地超過對方獲得優勢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們很努力地超過對方獲得優勢。

sentences.text: They wanted a wedding picture in front of the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.translationZh: 他們想在艾菲爾鐵塔前面拍張結婚照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們想在艾菲爾鐵塔前面拍張結婚照。

sentences.text: Tom almost always uses a credit card when he goes shopping.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在去購物的時候，幾乎每次都會用信用卡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在去购物的时候，几乎每次都会用信用卡。

sentences.text: Tom didn't doubt that there would be a lot of people there.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆確定那裡會有很多人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆确定那里会有很多人。

sentences.text: Tom didn't want Mary to know he didn't know how to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不想瑪麗知道他不知道怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不想玛丽知道他不知道怎么做。

sentences.text: Tom has been to this park with Mary at least a dozen times.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆跟瑪麗來這公園至少十二次。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆跟玛丽来这公园至少十二次。

sentences.text: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道拿他車庫的那些廢物怎麼辦。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。

sentences.text: Tom likes to listen to music while he's doing his homework.
sentences.translationZh: Tom很喜歡一邊聽歌一邊做作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom很喜欢一边听歌一边做作业。

sentences.text: Tom said he wouldn't be able to do what we asked him to do.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他做不成我們要他做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他做不成我们要他做的事。

sentences.text: Tom would never have let us go if Mary hadn't gone with us.
sentences.translationZh: 如果瑪麗不跟著我們，湯姆不會讓我們走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果玛丽不跟着我们，汤姆不会让我们走。

sentences.text: Tom wrote Mary a long letter, but he didn't send it to her.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆給瑪麗寫了封長信，可是沒有寄給她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆给玛丽写了封长信，可是没有寄给她。

sentences.text: Two men are trying to figure out what's wrong with the car.
sentences.translationZh: 兩個男人在檢查汽車出了什麼故障。
sentences.translationOriginal: 两个男人在检查汽车出了什么故障。

sentences.text: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
sentences.translationZh: 演講者精彩的演說給我們留下了深刻的印象。
sentences.translationOriginal: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.text: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
sentences.translationZh: 茶點過後我們接著開會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 茶点过后我们接着开会。

sentences.text: When I heard that song, it reminded me of when I was a kid.
sentences.translationZh: 我聽到那首歌時，它讓我想起了我小的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我聽到那首歌時，它讓我想起了我小的時候。

sentences.text: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
sentences.translationZh: 您能為我解釋這句句子的意思嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？

sentences.text: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.
sentences.translationZh: 一群年輕人在操場上打手球。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一群年輕人在操場上打手球。

sentences.text: According to the newspaper, there was a big fire last night.
sentences.translationZh: 根據報導，昨晚有一場很大的火災。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根據報導，昨晚有一場很大的火災。

sentences.text: Afraid of hurting his feelings, I didn't tell him the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 怕傷害了他的感情，我沒有告訴他真相。
sentences.translationOriginal: 怕傷害了他的感情，我沒有告訴他真相。

sentences.text: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.
sentences.translationZh: 湯川博士在科學研究上起了很重要的作用。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。

sentences.text: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.
sentences.translationZh: 每一個偉大的作家似乎已經對英語感興趣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每一個偉大的作家似乎已經對英語感興趣。

sentences.text: Everyone in the room checked their watches at the same time.
sentences.translationZh: 房間裡的所有人都同時看了看自己的手錶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 房间里的所有人都同时看了看自己的手表。

sentences.text: Father would often read detective stories in his spare time.
sentences.translationZh: 父親常常在空閒時間讀偵探小說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 父亲常常在空闲时间读侦探小说。

sentences.text: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.
sentences.translationZh: 他和許多其他人一樣問了我同樣的問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。

sentences.text: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.
sentences.translationZh: 他撞車是因為有人在剎車上做了手腳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。

sentences.text: He left for Europe a week ago, that is, on the tenth of May.
sentences.translationZh: 他在一週前離開去往歐洲，就是說，是在五月十號。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在一周前离开去往欧洲，就是说，是在五月十号。

sentences.text: He was aware that I was around, but didn't come to greet me.
sentences.translationZh: 他注意到我在場，但是沒向我打招呼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他注意到我在場，但是沒向我打招呼。

sentences.text: His bag is right here, so he cannot have gone to school yet.
sentences.translationZh: 他的包就在這兒，所以他不可能已經去了學校。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的包就在这儿，所以他不可能已经去了学校。

sentences.text: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.
sentences.translationZh: 有空的時候，我總喜歡聽古典音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

sentences.text: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.
sentences.translationZh: 我常常能分辨出來一個人是不是瞞著我什麼事情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我常常能分辨出来一个人是不是瞒着我什么事情。

sentences.text: I had never seen a windmill until I visited the Netherlands.
sentences.translationZh: 在我去荷蘭之前，我從沒見過風車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我去荷兰之前，我从没见过风车。

sentences.text: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
sentences.translationZh: 我有三隻狗，其中一隻是公的，另外兩隻是母的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。

sentences.text: I have two sons. One is in Tokyo and the other is in Nagoya.
sentences.translationZh: 我有兩個兒子，一個在東京，另一個在名古屋。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有两个儿子，一个在东京，另一个在名古屋。

sentences.text: I make it a rule not to watch television after nine o'clock.
sentences.translationZh: 我規定自己在九點之後不看電視。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我规定自己在九点之后不看电视。

sentences.text: I think that our living together has influenced your habits.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得我和你一起住影響了你生活的方式。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得我和你一起住影响了你生活的方式。

sentences.text: I thought he loved you, but as it is, he loved another girl.
sentences.translationZh: 我以為他愛你，但事實上，他愛另一個女孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以為他愛你，但事實上，他愛另一個女孩。

sentences.text: I was just about to leave the house when the telephone rang.
sentences.translationZh: 我正要離開家的時候電話響了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我正要离开家的时候电话响了。

sentences.text: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
sentences.translationZh: 我希望我能知道如何刪除我的Facebook帳號。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我希望我能知道如何刪除我的Facebook帳號。

sentences.text: I would have liked to come with you, but I didn't have time.
sentences.translationZh: 我想和你一起去，但是我沒有時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想和你一起去，但是我没有时间。

sentences.text: I would rather stay at home than go out in this hot weather.
sentences.translationZh: 在這種暑天裡我寧願呆在家也不出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在这种暑天里我宁愿呆在家也不出去。

sentences.text: If I had worked hard in my youth, I would be successful now.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我年輕的時候努力工作, 我現在就成功了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我年輕的時候努力工作, 我現在就成功了。

sentences.text: If I were you, I'd want to know what Tom is doing right now.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我是你，我不會想去知道Tom現在正在做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我是你，我不会想去知道Tom现在正在做什么。

sentences.text: If you stay at a big hotel, you can use their swimming pool.
sentences.translationZh: 若你住到的是大的旅館，就能使用他們的游泳池。
sentences.translationOriginal: 若你住到的是大的旅館，就能使用他們的游泳池。

sentences.text: It seems as if I'm the only person here capable of doing it.
sentences.translationZh: 看來我是這裡唯一有能力做這件事的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看来我是这里唯一有能力做这件事的人。

sentences.text: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.
sentences.translationZh: 他對一個生病的男人說這種事真是沒良心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。

sentences.text: It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 很難說明天的天氣將會怎樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

sentences.text: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 欺騙別人是錯的, 但更糟的欺騙自己。
sentences.translationOriginal: 欺騙別人是錯的, 但更糟的欺騙自己。

sentences.text: Looking at your Facebook friends' photos is a waste of time.
sentences.translationZh: 在Facebook上瀏覽朋友的照片是在浪費時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在Facebook上瀏覽朋友的照片是在浪費時間。

sentences.text: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
sentences.translationZh: 道路結冰導致了很多起事故。
sentences.translationOriginal: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。

sentences.text: My younger brother really likes to take photos of mountains.
sentences.translationZh: 我弟弟很喜歡拍山的照片。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我弟弟很喜欢拍山的照片。

sentences.text: Pizza is the kind of food that fits into today's life style.
sentences.translationZh: 比薩是種適合現在的生活方式的食物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 比萨是种适合现在的生活方式的食物。

sentences.text: Some babies learn to swim even before they are one year old.
sentences.translationZh: 有些寶寶甚至在一歲之前就學習游泳了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有些宝宝甚至在一岁之前就学习游泳了。

sentences.text: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該考慮的第一件事是時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

sentences.text: The number of traffic accidents seems to be on the increase.
sentences.translationZh: 交通事故的數量似乎在增長。
sentences.translationOriginal: 交通事故的数量似乎在增长。

sentences.text: The student handed the examination papers in to the teacher.
sentences.translationZh: 該學生把考試卷交給了老師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 該學生把考試卷交給了老師。

sentences.text: This book says that elephants live to be over 100 years old.
sentences.translationZh: 這本書上寫，大象能活過一百歲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这本书上写，大象能活过一百岁。

sentences.text: This is one of the best restaurants that I've ever eaten in.
sentences.translationZh: 這是我吃過的最好的餐館之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是我吃过的最好的餐馆之一。

sentences.text: This town is quite different from what it was ten years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 這鎮子跟十年前的它差別很大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這鎮子跟十年前的它差別很大。

sentences.text: Tom couldn't read very well until he was thirteen years old.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆十三歲以前讀得不好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆十三歲以前讀得不好。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't quite get it. Could you explain it to him again?
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不大明白。你能再跟他解釋一遍嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不大明白。你能再跟他解释一遍吗？

sentences.text: Tom took Mary to the hospital on the back of his motorcycle.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把瑪麗放到他的摩托車背上送到醫院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把玛丽放到他的摩托车背上送到医院。

sentences.text: Tom translated a letter from French to English for his boss.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆為他的老闆把一封信從法語翻譯成了英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆为他的老板把一封信从法语翻译成了英语。

sentences.text: We did not expect him to finish the task in so short a time.
sentences.translationZh: 我們沒指望過他在那麼短的時間裡完成工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。

sentences.text: We don't like our neighbors, and they don't like us, either.
sentences.translationZh: 我們不喜歡我們的鄰居，而他們也不喜歡我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們不喜歡我們的鄰居，而他們也不喜歡我們。

sentences.text: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
sentences.translationZh: 我們認為他的生意理所當然會獲得成功。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

sentences.text: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.
sentences.translationZh: 當我是個孩子的時候，我會把大部分時間都用於室內閱讀。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。

sentences.text: You can lie to everyone else, but you can't lie to yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 你可以向別人撒謊，但你不會向自己撒謊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你可以向别人撒谎，但你不会向自己撒谎。

sentences.text: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
sentences.translationZh: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。
sentences.translationOriginal: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。

sentences.text: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.
sentences.translationZh: 你們該養成使用字典的習慣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。

sentences.text: Shall I have him call you when he gets back? "Yes, please."
sentences.translationZh: “等他回來，我要讓他給你打電話嗎？”“是的，謝謝。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “等他回来，我要让他给你打电话吗？”“是的，谢谢。”

sentences.text: What's going on in the cave? I'm curious. "I have no idea."
sentences.translationZh: 山洞裡發生了什麼事? 我很好奇。"我不知道。"
sentences.translationOriginal: 山洞裡發生了什麼事? 我很好奇。"我不知道。"

sentences.text: A fire broke out last night and three houses were burnt down.
sentences.translationZh: 昨晚發生了一場火災，三棟房屋被燒毀了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 昨晚發生了一場火災，三棟房屋被燒毀了。

sentences.text: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
sentences.translationZh: 為了參加划船比賽，一支新的隊伍組成了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

sentences.text: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
sentences.translationZh: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。
sentences.translationOriginal: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。

sentences.text: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
sentences.translationZh: 一輩子只會出現一次像這樣的機會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。

sentences.text: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
sentences.translationZh: 癌症如果在第一階段被發現的話是很容易治癒的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。

sentences.text: Even though I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然我享受打保齡球，但是我最近沒有去打保齡球。
sentences.translationOriginal: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

sentences.text: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
sentences.translationZh: 他匿名向紅十字捐了大筆錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

sentences.text: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
sentences.translationZh: 他買土地的目的是要造房子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他買土地的目的是要造房子。

sentences.text: How long does it take to get from here to your house on foot?
sentences.translationZh: 從這裡步行到你家要多長時間？
sentences.translationOriginal: 从这里步行到你家要多长时间？

sentences.text: I can't believe that you were the smartest kid in your class.
sentences.translationZh: 我不敢相信你是你們班裡面最聰明的孩子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不敢相信你是你们班里面最聪明的孩子。

sentences.text: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.
sentences.translationZh: 我不喜歡茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。

sentences.text: I got a phone call from him just as I was about to go to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 我正要上床的時候接到了他打來的電話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我正要上床的時候接到了他打來的電話。

sentences.text: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
sentences.translationZh: 我才想起來我之前該買個麵包。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。

sentences.text: I saw a group of foreigners on my way to school this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 今天早上在去學校的路上，我看到了一群外國人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天早上在去学校的路上，我看到了一群外国人。

sentences.text: I sometimes just don't want to get out of bed in the morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我有時早上不想下床。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有时早上不想下床。

sentences.text: I want this work completed by two o'clock tomorrow afternoon.
sentences.translationZh: 明天下午2點以前，我希望這工作完成了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 明天下午2点以前，我希望这工作完成了。

sentences.text: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
sentences.translationZh: 但願我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽評論的辦法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

sentences.text: I've had a headache for three days and I can't get rid of it.
sentences.translationZh: 我已經頭疼三天了，還沒擺脫它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我已经头疼三天了，还没摆脱它。

sentences.text: If I had known that you were here, I would have come at once.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我早知道你在這兒的話，我馬上就來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我早知道你在这儿的话，我马上就来了。

sentences.text: If he had taken his doctor's advice, he might still be alive.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他聽了他醫生的建議，他可能還活著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他听了他医生的建议，他可能还活着。

sentences.text: If her nose were a little shorter, she would be quite pretty.
sentences.translationZh: 若她的姿態能再低一點就更完美了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 若她的姿態能再低一點就更完美了。

sentences.text: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
sentences.translationZh: 合理地餵狗可以延長寵物壽命。
sentences.translationOriginal: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

sentences.text: It took us a long time to decide what we really wanted to do.
sentences.translationZh: 我們花了很長時間決定我們真正想的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們花了很長時間決定我們真正想的事。

sentences.text: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
sentences.translationZh: 從天色上判斷，今天下午可能會下雨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 從天色上判斷，今天下午可能會下雨。

sentences.text: Long time, no see. I hear that you've changed your job again.
sentences.translationZh: 好久不見。聽說你又換工作了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 好久不见。听说你又换工作了？

sentences.text: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
sentences.translationZh: 很多公司實行8小時工作制。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很多公司實行8小時工作制。

sentences.text: My fingers are so numb with cold that I can't play the piano.
sentences.translationZh: 我的手指凍僵了，以至於無法彈鋼琴了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的手指冻僵了，以至于无法弹钢琴了。

sentences.text: My grandfather is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我的爺爺喜歡大清早的散步。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。

sentences.text: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
sentences.translationZh: 塑料代替了許多傳統的原料。
sentences.translationOriginal: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

sentences.text: Problems that can be solved with money are not real problems.
sentences.translationZh: 錢可以解決的問題都不是問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 錢可以解決的問題都不是問題。

sentences.text: She has a real knack for getting people to do what she wants.
sentences.translationZh: 她真的有本事讓別人做她想做的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她真的有本事让别人做她想做的事。

sentences.text: She tossed me grapes and I tried to catch them with my mouth.
sentences.translationZh: 她朝我丟葡萄，我試著用嘴接住它們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她朝我丢葡萄，我试着用嘴接住它们。

sentences.text: She visited the old man in the hospital every day but Sunday.
sentences.translationZh: 她每天都去探視在醫院裡的老人，除了星期天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她每天都去探視在醫院裡的老人，除了星期天。

sentences.text: Since I had met him once before, I recognized him right away.
sentences.translationZh: 由於我以前見過他一次，所以我馬上就認出他了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由於我以前見過他一次，所以我馬上就認出他了。

sentences.text: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.
sentences.translationZh: 最好的減肥方法就是少吃多運動。
sentences.translationOriginal: 最好的減肥方法就是少吃多運動。

sentences.text: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 會議將在後天於東京舉行。
sentences.translationOriginal: 会议将在后天于东京举行。

sentences.text: The house burned to the ground before the fire truck arrived.
sentences.translationZh: 消防車到達之前，房子就全燒了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。

sentences.text: The old church on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.
sentences.translationZh: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。
sentences.translationOriginal: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。

sentences.text: The old houses were torn down to make room for a supermarket.
sentences.translationZh: 這棟老房子被拆除了，以騰出空間給超級市場。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這棟老房子被拆除了，以騰出空間給超級市場。

sentences.text: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
sentences.translationZh: 鯊魚皮比金槍魚皮粗糙多了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 鯊魚皮比金槍魚皮粗糙多了。

sentences.text: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
sentences.translationZh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾會被罰款。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。

sentences.text: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
sentences.translationZh: 這架飛機一次可以攜帶40名乘客。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

sentences.text: This novel is more interesting than the one I read last week.
sentences.translationZh: 這本小說比我上週看的那本有意思。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這本小說比我上週看的那本有意思。

sentences.text: Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆還不清楚要不要上大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆还不清楚要不要上大学。

sentences.text: Tom went into the kitchen and poured himself a cup of coffee.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆進了廚房，給自己倒了杯咖啡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆进了厨房，给自己倒了杯咖啡。

sentences.text: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?
sentences.translationZh: 如果地球停止自傳，你認為會發生什麼？
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？

sentences.text: While we were discussing the problem, I hit upon a good idea.
sentences.translationZh: 在我們討論問題的過程中，我想到了一個好主意。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我们讨论问题的过程中，我想到了一个好主意。

sentences.text: With the T.V. on, how can you keep your mind on your studies?
sentences.translationZh: 你開著電視怎麼能安心學習呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你开着电视怎么能安心学习呢？

sentences.text: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.
sentences.translationZh: 橫穿馬路時你要留心。
sentences.translationOriginal: 横穿马路时你要留心。

sentences.text: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
sentences.translationZh: 一些航班由於地震被延誤了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一些航班由於地震被延誤了。

sentences.text: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
sentences.translationZh: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。

sentences.text: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
sentences.translationZh: 去美國旅行一次相當於她兩年的工資。
sentences.translationOriginal: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

sentences.text: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.
sentences.translationZh: 他們爭吵後，一週都沒有再說話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。

sentences.text: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
sentences.translationZh: 獲得諾貝爾獎後，她仍謙虛如昔。
sentences.translationOriginal: 獲得諾貝爾獎後，她仍謙虛如昔。

sentences.text: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
sentences.translationZh: 你所要做的便是好好把握這千載難逢的機會。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你所要做的便是好好把握這千載難逢的機會。

sentences.text: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
sentences.translationZh: 老齡化的人口需要更多醫療保健支出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

sentences.text: As soon as the bell rang, the teacher came into the classroom.
sentences.translationZh: 鐘聲一響起，老師就走進了教室。
sentences.translationOriginal: 鐘聲一響起，老師就走進了教室。

sentences.text: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.
sentences.translationZh: 在我六歲的時候，我第一次被帶去看馬戲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。

sentences.text: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆的主意我不太感興趣，這個我們之間說說就好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。

sentences.text: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.
sentences.translationZh: 小孩的體溫一般比大人的要高。
sentences.translationOriginal: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。

sentences.text: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道倫敦交響樂團的演奏會行程嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

sentences.text: Ever since she fell in the kitchen, she hasn't been all there.
sentences.translationZh: 自從她在廚房裡摔倒後，她不曾再到那裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 自從她在廚房裡摔倒後，她不曾再到那裡。

sentences.text: He told me that whatever might happen, he was prepared for it.
sentences.translationZh: 他告訴我不論發生什麼，他都準備好了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他告诉我不论发生什么，他都准备好了。

sentences.text: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.
sentences.translationZh: 事情沒能如他所願讓他感到失望。
sentences.translationOriginal: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。

sentences.text: I don't know about the past, but now we have faxes and emails.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道以前怎樣，但現在我們有傳真和電子郵件。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道以前怎样，但现在我们有传真和电子邮件。

sentences.text: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.
sentences.translationZh: 我對湯姆要持之以恆地學習法語口語這件事很懷疑。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。

sentences.text: I have not yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
sentences.translationZh: 我還沒有收集到足夠的材料來寫一本書。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我還沒有收集到足夠的材料來寫一本書。

sentences.text: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
sentences.translationZh: 我聽到車站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我聽到車站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。

sentences.text: I should have tried out this electric shaver before buying it.
sentences.translationZh: 我本該在買下這個電動剃鬚刀之前試一下的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我本该在买下这个电动剃须刀之前试一下的。

sentences.text: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為辨別清楚意見和事實很重要。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

sentences.text: I think you need to spend a little more time on your homework.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得你應該多花點時間在作業上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得你应该多花点时间在作业上。

sentences.text: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
sentences.translationZh: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反應。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。

sentences.text: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.
sentences.translationZh: 伊斯蘭教大約在七世紀中傳到中國。
sentences.translationOriginal: 伊斯蘭教大約在七世纪中傳到中國。

sentences.text: It is becoming important for us to know how to use a computer.
sentences.translationZh: 知道如何使用電腦對我們來說變得很重要。
sentences.translationOriginal: 知道如何使用电脑对我们来说变得很重要。

sentences.text: Japan is now very different from what it was twenty years ago.
sentences.translationZh: 相比二十年前的日本，現在的日本有了翻天覆地的變化。
sentences.translationOriginal: 相比二十年前的日本，现在的日本有了翻天覆地的变化。

sentences.text: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
sentences.translationZh: 語言是人們與他人交流的手段。
sentences.translationOriginal: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

sentences.text: Let me stop you right there. We don't want to hear about that.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我在這打斷你。我們不想聽那個話題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 讓我在這打斷你。我們不想聽那個話題。

sentences.text: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸參加了料理競賽並得了第一名。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。

sentences.text: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
sentences.translationZh: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。
sentences.translationOriginal: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。

sentences.text: She doesn't have any friends or relatives to take care of her.
sentences.translationZh: 她沒有任何親戚朋友照顧她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她没有任何亲戚朋友照顾她。

sentences.text: Some of the bluest water in the world is found in Crater Lake.
sentences.translationZh: 一些世界上最藍的水在火山湖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一些世界上最藍的水在火山湖。

sentences.text: Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
sentences.translationZh: 假如你有1000美元，你會用它做什麼呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？

sentences.text: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
sentences.translationZh: 全體銷售人員通宵達旦地工作了一週。
sentences.translationOriginal: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

sentences.text: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
sentences.translationZh: 詩人對他愛的女人表達了他火熱的激情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 詩人對他愛的女人表達了他火熱的激情。

sentences.text: There are a lot of things you don't know about my personality.
sentences.translationZh: 我的個性還有很多方面是你不瞭解的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的个性还有很多方面是你不了解的。

sentences.text: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.
sentences.translationZh: 他們互幫互助，把校慶搞得很成功。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。

sentences.text: Tom asked Mary some questions, but she refused to answer them.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆問了瑪麗一些問題，但是她拒絕回答。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆问了玛丽一些问题，但是她拒绝回答。

sentences.text: Tom doesn't like it when people cuss in front of his children.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不喜歡人們在他孩子面前講壞話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不喜欢人们在他孩子面前讲坏话。

sentences.text: Tom probably doesn't know how to do that as well as Mary does.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆可能不知道如何做得像瑪麗做得一樣好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆可能不知道如何做得像瑪麗做得一样好。

sentences.text: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
sentences.translationZh: 要是湯姆繫上安全帶的話，他就不會死的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是汤姆系上安全带的话，他就不会死的。

sentences.text: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
sentences.translationZh: 我們有不到五分鐘來疏散整棟樓的人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们有不到五分钟来疏散整栋楼的人。

sentences.text: We probably don't have enough time to finish doing that today.
sentences.translationZh: 我們應該不夠時間在今天之內完成它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们应该不够时间在今天之内完成它。

sentences.text: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
sentences.translationZh: 我們罷工是因為公司沒有改善我們的工資。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們罷工是因為公司沒有改善我們的工資。

sentences.text: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.
sentences.translationZh: 我最討厭背誦課文了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我最讨厌背诵课文了。

sentences.text: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不按照安全手續來的話，你可能會受傷的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

sentences.text: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
sentences.translationZh: 剛開始的時候你可能不會喜歡這個啤酒。這是需要多次品嚐去習慣它的口味。
sentences.translationOriginal: 剛開始的時候你可能不會喜歡這個啤酒。這是需要多次品嚐去習慣它的口味。

sentences.text: You must get this homework finished by the day after tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 你必須在後天以前完成回家作業。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你必須在後天以前完成回家作業。

sentences.text: You shouldn't say that kind of thing when children are around.
sentences.translationZh: 孩子們在旁邊的時候，你不應該說那種事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孩子们在旁边的时候，你不应该说那种事。

sentences.text: You told her that you had finished the work three days before.
sentences.translationZh: 你告訴她你已經在三天前完成這個工作了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你告訴她你已經在三天前完成這個工作了。

sentences.text: As soon as she heard the bell ring, she answered the telephone.
sentences.translationZh: 她一聽到鈴響，就接了電話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她一聽到鈴響，就接了電話。

sentences.text: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.
sentences.translationZh: 隨著時間的推移，比賽增加了規則以使之更安全。
sentences.translationOriginal: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。

sentences.text: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
sentences.translationZh: 在2020年以前，我們的城市的人口將增加一倍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在2020年以前，我們的城市的人口將增加一倍。

sentences.text: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
sentences.translationZh: 變量的聲明在C和C++中極其重要。
sentences.translationOriginal: 变量的声明在C和C++中极其重要。

sentences.text: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
sentences.translationZh: 英語是一種世界性的語言，用於世界各地。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英語是一種世界性的語言，用於世界各地。

sentences.text: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 英語是目前在世界上使用最廣泛的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英語是目前在世界上使用最廣泛的語言。

sentences.text: English is just one of over 2,700 languages in the world today.
sentences.translationZh: 今天，英語只是世界上超過2,700種語言的其中之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天，英語只是世界上超過2,700種語言的其中之一。

sentences.text: For the time being, my sister is an assistant in a supermarket.
sentences.translationZh: 目前，我妹妹在一家超市當收銀員。
sentences.translationOriginal: 目前，我妹妹在一家超市当收银员。

sentences.text: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.
sentences.translationZh: 沿著這條路直走，到第三個紅綠燈的地方右轉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。

sentences.text: He and his wife tried to work out their problems, but couldn't.
sentences.translationZh: 他和他的妻子試圖解決他們的問題，但沒有辦法。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他和他的妻子試圖解決他們的問題，但沒有辦法。

sentences.text: He still remembers the day his mother found out he was smoking.
sentences.translationZh: 他還記得他媽媽發現他正在抽菸的那天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他还记得他妈妈发现他正在抽烟的那天。

sentences.text: He told me that I looked pale and asked me what the matter was.
sentences.translationZh: 他跟我說我很蒼白，並問我怎麼了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他跟我说我很苍白，并问我怎么了。

sentences.text: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
sentences.translationZh: 我不推薦在那家餐館吃飯。食物糟糕透了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

sentences.text: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
sentences.translationZh: 如果必要的話，我不反對付特別費用。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

sentences.text: If Tom doesn't do what he's supposed to do, please let me know.
sentences.translationZh: 如果湯姆沒有做他應當做的事，請讓我知道。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果汤姆没有做他应当做的事，请让我知道。

sentences.text: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
sentences.translationZh: 如果他年輕一點，他將很適合這個職位。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。

sentences.text: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
sentences.translationZh: 化學工廠一著火就爆炸了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

sentences.text: It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
sentences.translationZh: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。

sentences.text: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
sentences.translationZh: 每個月還清信用卡負債很重要。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

sentences.text: It's hard for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.
sentences.translationZh: 法語說得快，我就難以理解。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。

sentences.text: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
sentences.translationZh: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。

sentences.text: One thousand dollars will cover all the expenses for the party.
sentences.translationZh: 1000美元將負擔聚會的全部費用。
sentences.translationOriginal: 1000美元将负担聚会的全部费用。

sentences.text: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
sentences.translationZh: 這個島的經濟依靠的是漁業。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

sentences.text: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
sentences.translationZh: 警察認為竊賊從地下室窗口進入。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

sentences.text: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
sentences.translationZh: 學校坐落於距離車站步行五分鐘的地方。
sentences.translationOriginal: 學校坐落於距離車站步行五分鐘的地方。

sentences.text: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
sentences.translationZh: 議員受到了議會道德委員會的譴責。
sentences.translationOriginal: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

sentences.text: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
sentences.translationZh: 第三季國民生產總值較上一季成長了1％。
sentences.translationOriginal: 第三季國民生產總值較上一季成長了1％。

sentences.text: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
sentences.translationZh: 戰士知道自己的力量和弱點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 戰士知道自己的力量和弱點。

sentences.text: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.
sentences.translationZh: 今年的時尚潮流完全不同於去年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。

sentences.text: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
sentences.translationZh: 今天我們的人造衛星正在環繞地球運轉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天我们的人造卫星正在环绕地球运转。

sentences.text: Tom didn't know exactly what it was that Mary wanted him to do.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知道瑪麗到底讓他做什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知道玛丽到底让他做什么。

sentences.text: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
sentences.translationZh: 我們聯繫上他們已經為時已晚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。

sentences.text: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你女朋友發現真相的話，你會有麻煩的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

sentences.text: Why are you going to Japan? "To attend a conference in Tokyo."
sentences.translationZh: “你去日本幹嘛？”“去東京參加一個會議。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”

sentences.text: Will you have some more coffee? "No, thanks. I've had enough."
sentences.translationZh: “你想再來點咖啡嗎？”“不，謝謝。我夠了。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你想再来点咖啡吗？”“不，谢谢。我够了。”

sentences.text: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
sentences.translationZh: 孩子們的衣食住行靠的是他們的父母。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

sentences.text: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
sentences.translationZh: 你知道顯微鏡和望遠鏡的差別嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

sentences.text: Everybody is supposed to know the law, but few people really do.
sentences.translationZh: 每一個人都應該知法懂法，但是真正能做到的人卻很少。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每一个人都应该知法懂法，但是真正能做到的人却很少。

sentences.text: Excuse me, let me point out three mistakes in the above article.
sentences.translationZh: 不好意思，讓我指出先前文章的三個錯誤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不好意思，讓我指出先前文章的三個錯誤。

sentences.text: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
sentences.translationZh: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。

sentences.text: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
sentences.translationZh: 他是個非常浪漫的男友，每晚都給我帶花。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是个非常浪漫的男友，每晚都给我带花。

sentences.text: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 當他老闆發現真相的時候，謊言給他帶來了麻煩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

sentences.text: I can still remember the time when we went on a picnic together.
sentences.translationZh: 我還記得我和你一起去野餐的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我还记得我和你一起去野餐的时候。

sentences.text: I may be unsociable, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
sentences.translationZh: 我或許不善於社交,但這並不意味我不和別人交談。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我或许不善于社交,但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。

sentences.text: I think that I now have enough money to buy the car that I want.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為我現在有足夠的錢買我想要的那輛車。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我认为我现在有足够的钱买我想要的那辆车。

sentences.text: Is it true that your family will travel in Hokkaido? I envy you.
sentences.translationZh: 你們家去北海道旅遊是真的麼？我羨慕你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你们家去北海道旅游是真的么？我羡慕你。

sentences.text: It hasn't been easy for Tom to deal with Mary's health problems.
sentences.translationZh: 處理瑪麗的健康問題對湯姆來說不容易。
sentences.translationOriginal: 处理玛丽的健康问题对汤姆来说不容易。

sentences.text: It is sometimes difficult to make yourself understood in public.
sentences.translationZh: 有時很難在公眾場合表達你自己的意思。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有時很難在公眾場合表達你自己的意思。

sentences.text: My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.
sentences.translationZh: 我十四歲的時候，父親死於蛛網膜下出血。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

sentences.text: No matter how hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
sentences.translationZh: 無論我多麼努力嘗試，我都無法做到比她更好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。

sentences.text: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有人明白為什麼大象突然攻擊了它的主人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

sentences.text: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
sentences.translationZh: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。

sentences.text: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.
sentences.translationZh: 當她的孩子在公共場合行為表現不好的時候，她覺得很尷尬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當她的孩子在公共場合行為表現不好的時候，她覺得很尷尬。

sentences.text: She wouldn't let up until I agreed to go to the movies with her.
sentences.translationZh: 她不願鬆開我，直到我同意和她去電影院。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她不愿松开我，直到我同意和她去电影院。

sentences.text: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
sentences.translationZh: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。

sentences.text: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.
sentences.translationZh: 事故似乎和厚厚的積雪有關。
sentences.translationOriginal: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。

sentences.text: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
sentences.translationZh: 在這個城市，白人和黑人間的爭端愈演愈烈。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

sentences.text: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
sentences.translationZh: 遭受心臟病困擾的人數增加了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。

sentences.text: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
sentences.translationZh: 錢幣的價值取決於所使用的金屬的重量。
sentences.translationOriginal: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

sentences.text: This book is for students whose native language is not Japanese.
sentences.translationZh: 這本書是給母語不是日語的學生的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這本書是給母語不是日語的學生的。

sentences.text: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
sentences.translationZh: 這顯然是今年出版的最好的小說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。

sentences.text: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
sentences.translationZh: 數以千計的蠟燭點亮了儀式中的教堂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

sentences.text: Tom didn't want Mary to know that he didn't know how to do that.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不想瑪麗知道他不知道怎麼做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不想玛丽知道他不知道怎么做。

sentences.text: Tom says he isn't sure if he can do that, but he says he'll try.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆說他不確定是否能做到，但是他說會嘗試。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆说他不确定是否能做到，但是他说会尝试。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary that she should quit pretending to be intoxicated.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗她應該停止假裝醉酒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary that she should stop pretending to be intoxicated.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴瑪麗她應該停止假裝醉酒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。

sentences.text: Tom told us this morning that he and Mary were moving to Boston.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆告訴我今天上午他和瑪麗要搬到波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆告诉我今天上午他和玛丽要搬到波士顿。

sentences.text: We moved our bags to make room for the elderly lady to sit down.
sentences.translationZh: 我們移走了行李騰出空間讓老太太可以坐下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們移走了行李騰出空間讓老太太可以坐下。

sentences.text: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
sentences.translationZh: 那場事故讓我們陷入了不尋常的局勢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

sentences.text: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
sentences.translationZh: 我們今晚會吃很多，所以我希望你沒有在節食。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

sentences.text: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.
sentences.translationZh: 當爸爸發現你做了什麼的時候，他會發瘋的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。

sentences.text: You must've been surprised to meet your teacher in such a place.
sentences.translationZh: 在那種地方碰到你的老師，你應該很驚訝吧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在那种地方碰到你的老师，你应该很惊讶吧。

sentences.text: You should do that as often as you can while you're still young.
sentences.translationZh: 趁你還年輕的時候，你應該儘可能經常地這樣做。
sentences.translationOriginal: 趁你还年轻的时候，你应该尽可能经常地这样做。

sentences.text: We haven't seen each other since 2009. "Has it been that long?"
sentences.translationZh: “我們從2009年起就沒見過面。”“有那麼久嗎？”
sentences.translationOriginal: “我们从2009年起就没见过面。”“有那么久吗？”

sentences.text: Will you be at my party tomorrow night? "I'll try to be there."
sentences.translationZh: “你明天會來我的聚會嗎？”“我儘量來。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你明天会来我的聚会吗？”“我尽量来。”

sentences.text: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
sentences.translationZh: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
sentences.translationOriginal: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。

sentences.text: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
sentences.translationZh: 要想成功只需要無知和自信。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

sentences.text: As a matter of fact, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 事實上，我從今天早上開始沒有吃任何東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 事實上，我從今天早上開始沒有吃任何東西。

sentences.text: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
sentences.translationZh: 澳大利亞在歐洲是最大的電能生產國之一。
sentences.translationOriginal: 澳大利亚在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

sentences.text: Can you spare me a few minutes? I'd like to have a word with you.
sentences.translationZh: 你有幾分鐘時間嗎？我想跟你聊一下。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你有幾分鐘時間嗎？我想跟你聊一下。

sentences.text: For the time being, I am studying French at this language school.
sentences.translationZh: 目前，我正在這所語言學校學習法語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 目前，我正在這所語言學校學習法語。

sentences.text: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
sentences.translationZh: 我都快要說出他的名字了，可就是記不起來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

sentences.text: I have lost my umbrella somewhere in the park. I have to buy one.
sentences.translationZh: 我的雨傘遺失在公園裡某個地方。我必須再買一把。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的雨傘遺失在公園裡某個地方。我必須再買一把。

sentences.text: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
sentences.translationZh: 好久不見了。記得上次我什麼時候看見你的嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 好久不见了。记得上次我什么时候看见你的吗？

sentences.text: I hope I will have a chance to see you next time I'm in New York.
sentences.translationZh: 希望下次我在紐約還可以有機會見到你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 希望下次我在纽约还可以有机会见到你。

sentences.text: I'd like to make a call to Tokyo, Japan. The number is 3202-5625.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要打個電話到日本東京，號碼是3202－5625。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要打个电话到日本东京，号码是3202－5625。

sentences.text: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.
sentences.translationZh: 再過兩週你就可以出院了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 再过两周你就可以出院了。

sentences.text: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
sentences.translationZh: 萬一船運遲了，我們有特別的遲到保險。
sentences.translationOriginal: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

sentences.text: It is out of the question for you to go to New York this weekend.
sentences.translationZh: 這個週末去紐約對你來說是不可能的事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這個週末去紐約對你來說是不可能的事。

sentences.text: Maybe my grandchild will be the first person to set foot on Mars.
sentences.translationZh: 可能我的孫子會是登陸火星的第一人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 可能我的孙子会是登陆火星的第一人。

sentences.text: Money takes a long time to earn, but you can spend it in no time.
sentences.translationZh: 錢要花很長的時間來賺, 但你可以一下子就花掉它了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 錢要花很長的時間來賺, 但你可以一下子就花掉它了。

sentences.text: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
sentences.translationZh: 通常學生們喜歡理解他們問題的老師。
sentences.translationOriginal: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。

sentences.text: The baby caught sight of my ballpoint pen and reached out for it.
sentences.translationZh: 這個嬰兒盯著我的原子筆看, 並且伸手要拿它。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這個嬰兒盯著我的原子筆看, 並且伸手要拿它。

sentences.text: The leaves of the trees in the garden have turned completely red.
sentences.translationZh: 花園裡樹上的葉子已經完全變紅了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 花园里树上的叶子已经完全变红了。

sentences.text: The train was so crowded that I had to keep standing all the way.
sentences.translationZh: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這班火車如此的擁擠以至於我整個車程都必須站著。

sentences.text: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
