sentences.translationZh: 這將是我環繞美國旅行中一個很好的紀念品。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。

sentences.text: Tom probably knows where we can get something to eat around here.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆應該知道這附近哪裡有東西吃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆應該知道這附近哪裡有東西吃。

sentences.text: What Tom really wanted was enough money to buy Mary some flowers.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆真正想要的是有足夠的錢給瑪麗買一些花。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆真正想要的是有足够的钱给玛丽买一些花。

sentences.text: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.
sentences.translationZh: 讓我們別來，我們就更想來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。

sentences.text: Because of the typhoon, my parents ended their trip one day early.
sentences.translationZh: 因為颱風的關係，我的父母提早一天結束了旅行回到家。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。

sentences.text: Four hundred million people speak English as their first language.
sentences.translationZh: 四億人以英語作為他們的第一語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 四億人以英語作為他們的第一語言。

sentences.text: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
sentences.translationZh: 他似乎不知道我父親和我之間的糾葛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。

sentences.text: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
sentences.translationZh: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。

sentences.text: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
sentences.translationZh: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。

sentences.text: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
sentences.translationZh: 獅子是獸類之王的話，鷹就是鳥類之王。
sentences.translationOriginal: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

sentences.text: If you don't have anything nice to say, don't say anything at all.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你沒好話說，那就什麼都別說。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你没好话说，那就什么都别说。

sentences.text: If you had left home a little earlier you would have been in time.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你早點出門的話，你就能趕上了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你早点出门的话，你就能赶上了。

sentences.text: It seems that the only time he isn't eating is when he's sleeping.
sentences.translationZh: 看來他只有在睡覺時不吃東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 看来他只有在睡觉时不吃东西。

sentences.text: Last month our twenty-year-old daughter gave birth to a baby girl.
sentences.translationZh: 上個月，我們20歲的女兒生了個女孩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 上个月，我们20岁的女儿生了个女孩。

sentences.text: My car broke down this morning and won't be repaired until Friday.
sentences.translationZh: 我的車今天早上壞了，星期五才能修好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我的车今天早上坏了，星期五才能修好。

sentences.text: My father always said that heaven helps those who help themselves.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親總是說天助自助者。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父親總是說天助自助者。

sentences.text: No matter how often I tell her, she keeps making the same mistake.
sentences.translationZh: 不管我跟她說了多少次，她還是繼續犯同樣的錯誤。
sentences.translationOriginal: 不管我跟她说了多少次，她还是继续犯同样的错误。

sentences.text: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
sentences.translationZh: 這個班的女生平均身高超過了155公分。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。

sentences.text: The dolphin and trainer communicated much better than we expected.
sentences.translationZh: 海豚和馴養員交流得比我們所期望的好得多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 海豚和驯养员交流得比我们所期望的好得多。

sentences.text: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
sentences.translationZh: 近來咖啡的短缺造成了許多問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

sentences.text: Tom put the large picnic basket on the passenger seat next to him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆把那個大野餐籃子放在他旁邊的乘客座位上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆把那个大野餐篮子放在他旁边的乘客座位上。

sentences.text: Tom wanted Mary's phone number, but she refused to give it to him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想要瑪麗的電話號碼但是被拒絕了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想要玛丽的电话号码但是被拒绝了。

sentences.text: Tom was admiring my new car at the time the truck crashed into it.
sentences.translationZh: 在湯姆欣賞我的新車的同時，一輛卡車撞了過來。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在湯姆欣賞我的新車的同時，一輛卡車撞了過來。

sentences.text: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆穿著一件防彈衣，所以子彈沒把他殺死。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆穿著一件防彈衣，所以子彈沒把他殺死。

sentences.text: You've worked hard for months and have certainly earned a holiday.
sentences.translationZh: 你已經辛苦地工作好幾個月了, 當然可以休假。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你已經辛苦地工作好幾個月了, 當然可以休假。

sentences.text: The good die young is an old saying which may or may not be true.
sentences.translationZh: “好人不長命”是句或真或假的老話。
sentences.translationOriginal: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。

sentences.text: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
sentences.translationZh: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。

sentences.text: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
sentences.translationZh: 由於他的財富，他能夠成為這個俱樂部的成員。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由於他的財富，他能夠成為這個俱樂部的成員。

sentences.text: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
sentences.translationZh: 大家都渴望知道前冠軍得主發生了什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

sentences.text: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
sentences.translationZh: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百貨公司的特價活動。
sentences.translationOriginal: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百貨公司的特價活動。

sentences.text: He always left the problem of his children's education to his wife.
sentences.translationZh: 他總是把孩子的教育問題留給他的妻子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他總是把孩子的教育問題留給他的妻子。

sentences.text: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
sentences.translationZh: 他宣佈他將立刻來調查此事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他宣布他將立刻來調查此事。

sentences.text: He devoted the last years of his life to writing his autobiography.
sentences.translationZh: 他晚年致力於寫自傳。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他晚年致力於寫自傳。

sentences.text: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
sentences.translationZh: 他在城市裡一直受到噪音或者其他的干擾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。

sentences.text: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
sentences.translationZh: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。

sentences.text: I'm not a child, but sometimes you talk to me as if I were a child.
sentences.translationZh: 我不是小孩子，但有時你跟我說話就好像我是小孩子一樣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不是小孩子，但有时你跟我说话就好像我是小孩子一样。

sentences.text: If you heard her speak English, you would take her for an American.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你聽到她講的英語，你會以為她是美國人呢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你听到她讲的英语，你会以为她是美国人呢。

sentences.text: In this kind of weather, it's best to stay home and not go outside.
sentences.translationZh: 這種天氣下最好待在家裡不要外出。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这种天气下最好待在家里不要外出。

sentences.text: It took me more than two hours to translate a few pages of English.
sentences.translationZh: 翻譯幾頁英文花了我2個多小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 翻译几页英文花了我2个多小时。

sentences.text: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
sentences.translationZh: 她開始對生態學感興趣，是受到他的影響。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。

sentences.text: Please don't forget to put a stamp on the letter before mailing it.
sentences.translationZh: 請不要忘記寄信前要在上面貼郵票。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请不要忘记寄信前要在上面贴邮票。

sentences.text: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
sentences.translationZh: 瑞士位於法國、意大利、奧地利和德國之間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

sentences.text: The teacher pointed her finger at me and asked me to come with her.
sentences.translationZh: 教師用手指指著我，要我跟她走。
sentences.translationOriginal: 教师用手指指着我，要我跟她走。

sentences.text: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
sentences.translationZh: 發現了遠處的燈光的旅行者歡喜不已。
sentences.translationOriginal: 发现了远处的灯光的旅行者欢喜不已。

sentences.text: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
sentences.translationZh: 這幅畫被估價數百萬元。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这幅画被估价数百万元。

sentences.text: There are many more students in the classroom today than yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 今天教室裡的學生比昨天還要多。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天教室裡的學生比昨天還要多。

sentences.text: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
sentences.translationZh: 有一分鐘的沉默，然後每個人都開始尖叫。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。

sentences.text: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
sentences.translationZh: 這只是你和我之間的祕密，所以不要讓它流出去。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

sentences.text: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
sentences.translationZh: 這個問題讓小學生解決太難了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。

sentences.text: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

sentences.text: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
sentences.translationZh: 要是你老打遊戲的話，你的視力會下降的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。

sentences.text: According to the guidebook, this is the best restaurant around here.
sentences.translationZh: 根據指南，這是這附近最好的餐館。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根據指南，這是這附近最好的餐館。

sentences.text: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
sentences.translationZh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人餓死呀？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

sentences.text: Father makes sure that all the lights are off before he goes to bed.
sentences.translationZh: 父親確定所有的燈都關了後才去睡覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 父親確定所有的燈都關了後才去睡覺。

sentences.text: I can't remember the meaning of the word that I looked up yesterday.
sentences.translationZh: 我記不起昨天查的那個詞的意思了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我记不起昨天查的那个词的意思了。

sentences.text: I think that Liszt's "Forgotten Waltz No.3" is a hidden masterpiece.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得李斯特的《被遺忘的圓舞曲第三首》是個被埋沒的名曲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得李斯特的《被遗忘的圆舞曲第三首》是个被埋没的名曲。

sentences.text: I've never lived on a farm, but both of my parents grew up on farms.
sentences.translationZh: 我從沒有住在農場，但我的父母都在農場長大。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我从没有住在农场，但我的父母都在农场长大。

sentences.text: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
sentences.translationZh: 如果兩個人總是意見相同，那麼他們其中一個就沒必要了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果两个人总是意见相同，那么他们其中一个就没必要了。

sentences.text: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
sentences.translationZh: 在一些國家，叛國罪的懲罰可以是終身監禁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在一些國家，叛國罪的懲罰可以是終身監禁。

sentences.text: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
sentences.translationZh: 根據你所說的話，我認為我們應該重新審視我們的計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

sentences.text: It's difficult for me to understand French when it's spoken quickly.
sentences.translationZh: 法語說得快，我就難以理解。
sentences.translationOriginal: 法语说得快，我就难以理解。

sentences.text: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我今早起床時，我爸已經吃過早飯了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我今早起床时，我爸已经吃过早饭了。

sentences.text: My father is in the habit of reading the newspaper before breakfast.
sentences.translationZh: 我父親有個習慣，早餐之前讀報紙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父亲有个习惯，早餐之前读报纸。

sentences.text: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
sentences.translationZh: 我們的任務到目前為止很輕鬆，但從現在開始將會變得很難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。

sentences.text: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
sentences.translationZh: 死刑在美國的很多州都被廢除了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

sentences.text: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
sentences.translationZh: 因為閃光燈壞了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

sentences.text: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
sentences.translationZh: 一個差勁的廚師和下毒者唯一的不同在於他們的意圖。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一個差勁的廚師和下毒者唯一的不同在於他們的意圖。

sentences.text: The time will soon come when man will be able to travel to the moon.
sentences.translationZh: 在不久的將來人類會可以去月球旅遊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在不久的将来人类会可以去月球旅游。

sentences.text: Tom asked me to tell you he didn't plan on going to Boston with you.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆讓我告訴你他沒有計劃和你一起去波士頓。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆让我告诉你他没有计划和你一起去波士顿。

sentences.text: Tom started as a janitor, but he's now the president of the company.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆最初是看門人，但現在他是公司的總裁了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆最初是看门人，但现在他是公司的总裁了。

sentences.text: Tom told Mary not to waste her time trying to convince John to help.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆對瑪麗說，不要浪費時間去說服約翰來幫忙。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆对玛丽说，不要浪费时间去说服约翰来帮忙。

sentences.text: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想學拳擊，但他媽媽覺得這太危險了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。

sentences.text: Do you know when they will arrive? "At eleven-thirty this evening."
sentences.translationZh: 你知道他們什麼時候到嗎？ 今晚11點半。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你知道他们什么时候到吗？ 今晚11点半。

sentences.text: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
sentences.translationZh: 堅持做對的事情。這會滿足一部分人同時使另一部分人感到驚訝。
sentences.translationOriginal: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

sentences.text: Everybody talks about the weather, but nobody does anything about it.
sentences.translationZh: 每個人都在談論天氣, 但是沒有人為它做任何事情。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每個人都在談論天氣, 但是沒有人為它做任何事情。

sentences.text: He and I were inseparable friends during our time together in school.
sentences.translationZh: 我和他在學生時代是分不開的朋友。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我和他在學生時代是分不開的朋友。

sentences.text: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
sentences.translationZh: 他的智慧和經驗使他能處理這個麻煩。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的智慧和經驗使他能處理這個麻煩。

sentences.text: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
sentences.translationZh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反對。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

sentences.text: I came to Tokyo three years ago and have been living here ever since.
sentences.translationZh: 三年前我來到東京並一直住在這兒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 三年前我来到东京并一直住在这儿。

sentences.text: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
sentences.translationZh: 我看不出有其他方法能讓他接受我們的提議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

sentences.text: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
sentences.translationZh: 我認為在有風暴的時候裡登山很危險。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我認為在有風暴的時候裡登山很危險。

sentences.text: If it had not been for your help, I couldn't have completed the work.
sentences.translationZh: 如果不是因為有你的幫助，我不可能完成了這個工作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果不是因为有你的帮助，我不可能完成了这个工作。

sentences.text: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
sentences.translationZh: 我們將於幾分鐘內降落在新東京國際機場。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

sentences.text: It's better to teach someone how to fish than to give someone a fish.
sentences.translationZh: 授之以魚，不如授之以漁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 授之以鱼，不如授之以渔。

sentences.text: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.
sentences.translationZh: 很明顯的是這兩者之間有很強烈的分歧。
sentences.translationOriginal: 很明顯的是這兩者之間有很強烈的分歧。

sentences.text: It's hard to believe Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
sentences.translationZh: 真難相信湯姆不知道瑪麗愛他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。

sentences.text: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.
sentences.translationZh: 大多數美國人似乎不反對我直呼其名。
sentences.translationOriginal: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。

sentences.text: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有人會為這個舊建築物的拆除而落淚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

sentences.text: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然她在日本被撫養長大，但是她精通英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 雖然她在日本被撫養長大，但是她精通英語。

sentences.text: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
sentences.translationZh: 她充分利用她住在倫敦的優勢，提高英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

sentences.text: The taller the tree, the more likely it is to be struck by lightning.
sentences.translationZh: 樹高遭雷擊。
sentences.translationOriginal: 树高遭雷击。

sentences.text: There is nothing worse than doing something in a half-hearted manner.
sentences.translationZh: 沒有什麼比做事缺乏熱情更糟。
sentences.translationOriginal: 没有什么比做事缺乏热情更糟。

sentences.text: Tom and I sat on a bench in the park and talked while we fed pigeons.
sentences.translationZh: 我和湯姆在公園的長椅上坐著，一邊聊天一邊喂著鴿子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我和汤姆在公园的长椅上坐着，一边聊天一边喂着鸽子。

sentences.text: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
sentences.translationZh: 我們已經收到了很多回應我們廣告的申請。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們已經收到了很多回應我們廣告的申請。

sentences.text: Because of heavy snow, the plane from Beijing arrived 20 minutes late.
sentences.translationZh: 由於下大雪，從北京來的班機延遲二十分鐘。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由於下大雪，從北京来的班機延遲二十分鐘。

sentences.text: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
sentences.translationZh: 你能告訴我紅茶和綠茶的區別嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？

sentences.text: Don't worry! Even if I drink, it doesn't have an effect on my driving.
sentences.translationZh: 別擔心! 即使我喝酒了, 它對我的駕駛沒有影響。
sentences.translationOriginal: 別擔心! 即使我喝酒了, 它對我的駕駛沒有影響。

sentences.text: Had he known what was about to happen, he would have changed his plan.
sentences.translationZh: 要是他知道會發生什麼，他就會改變計劃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 要是他知道会发生什么，他就会改变计划。

sentences.text: I think you will find it convenient to put a short-cut on the desktop.
sentences.translationZh: 我想你遲早會知道在桌面建立一個快捷方式是有多方便。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想你迟早会知道在桌面建立一个快捷方式是有多方便。

sentences.text: I want a cellular phone, but I don't have enough money to pay for one.
sentences.translationZh: 我想要一支手機, 但是我沒有足夠的錢買一支。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想要一支手機, 但是我沒有足夠的錢買一支。

sentences.text: I will have finished reading this novel by the time you come tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 你明天來的時候，我就看完這本小說了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你明天来的时候，我就看完这本小说了。

sentences.text: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
sentences.translationZh: 我正在尋找可以幫我修改這篇論文的母語人士。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我正在尋找可以幫我修改這篇論文的母語人士。

sentences.text: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
sentences.translationZh: 我有點有趣的事要告訴你，你可能會吃驚。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我有点有趣的事要告诉你，你可能会吃惊。

sentences.text: It was raining when we left, but by the time we arrived, it was sunny.
sentences.translationZh: 我們走的時候下著雨，到的時候有太陽。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们走的时候下着雨，到的时候有太阳。

sentences.text: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.
sentences.translationZh: 只憑長相的話很難區分英國人和美國人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。

sentences.text: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
sentences.translationZh: 預防措施比真正的治療更有效。
sentences.translationOriginal: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

sentences.text: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
sentences.translationZh: 寧可當隻老虎活一天，也不願當隻兔子過一百年。
sentences.translationOriginal: 寧可當隻老虎活一天，也不願當隻兔子過一百年。

sentences.text: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
sentences.translationZh: 她認出那枚胸針是她幾個月前丟失的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。

sentences.text: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子們出去遠足。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。

sentences.text: What's this song? I've heard it before, but I can't remember the name.
sentences.translationZh: 這是什麼歌？我以前聽過，但是我想不起歌名了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这是什么歌？我以前听过，但是我想不起歌名了。

sentences.text: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
sentences.translationZh: 數據表明年輕人抽菸的現象沒有減少。
sentences.translationOriginal: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

sentences.text: Because it is written in simple English even a child can understand it.
sentences.translationZh: 因為這是用簡單的英語寫的，所以甚至連孩子都能理解。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因為這是用簡單的英語寫的，所以甚至連孩子都能理解。

sentences.text: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?
sentences.translationZh: 有沒有一個國家比美國更提倡愛國主義？
sentences.translationOriginal: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？

sentences.text: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
sentences.translationZh: 有空的時候，我總喜歡聽古典音樂。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。

sentences.text: I was nine years old when I asked my mom if Santa Claus really existed.
sentences.translationZh: 我九歲的時候問我媽媽聖誕老人是否真的存在。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我九岁的时候问我妈妈圣诞老人是否真的存在。

sentences.text: If it's at all possible, I'd like you to take part in the next meeting.
sentences.translationZh: 如果可能的話, 我希望你參加下一次的會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果可能的話, 我希望你參加下一次的會議。

sentences.text: If you enjoy the work you do, you have something worth more than money.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你喜歡你做的工作，你就有比金錢更有價值的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你喜歡你做的工作，你就有比金錢更有價值的東西。

sentences.text: It was not until I had a baby myself that I knew what mother's love is.
sentences.translationZh: 直到我自己有了孩子我才明白了什麼是母愛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 直到我自己有了孩子我才明白了什么是母爱。

sentences.text: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
sentences.translationZh: 善良是聾子能聽盲人能看的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 善良是聾子能聽盲人能看的語言。

sentences.text: Mary came home from school in tears because her friends had teased her.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗哭著從學校跑回了家裡，因為她的朋友捉弄了她。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽哭着从学校跑回了家里，因为她的朋友捉弄了她。

sentences.text: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
sentences.translationZh: 我爸爸對我的愛和照顧不比我媽媽少。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

sentences.text: Now's the time to decide whether you really want to get married or not.
sentences.translationZh: 現在是你決定是不是真要結婚的時候。
sentences.translationOriginal: 现在是你决定是不是真要结婚的时候。

sentences.text: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
sentences.translationZh: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人會因為體溫而在紅外線攝影機上顯現。

sentences.text: The police have been searching for the stolen goods for almost a month.
sentences.translationZh: 警察大概從一個月前就開始找被偷物品了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 警察大概从一个月前就开始找被偷物品了。

sentences.text: They told me that I would feel a little better if I took this medicine.
sentences.translationZh: 他們告訴我吃完這個藥我就會覺得舒服一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他們告訴我吃完這個藥我就會覺得舒服一點。

sentences.text: Tom couldn't go to college because his family didn't have enough money.
sentences.translationZh: 因為家裡錢不夠所以湯姆沒能念大學。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为家里钱不够所以汤姆没能念大学。

sentences.text: Tom thought he had a chance to make a lot of money on the stock market.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆覺得他有機會在股市賺一大筆錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。

sentences.text: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
sentences.translationZh: 他的食物供給不足的的時候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。

sentences.text: While I was reading in bed last night, I fell asleep with the light on.
sentences.translationZh: 我昨晚在床上看書的時候點著燈就睡了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我昨晚在床上看书的时候点着灯就睡了。

sentences.text: Where have you been? "I have been to the station to see a friend off."
sentences.translationZh: “你去哪兒了？”“我去了火車站送我的一個朋友。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “你去哪儿了？”“我去了火车站送我的一个朋友。”

sentences.text: After I got married, my Japanese got better and I could understand more.
sentences.translationZh: 在我結婚之後，我的日語水平提高了，能理解更多日語了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在我结婚之后，我的日语水平提高了，能理解更多日语了。

sentences.text: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
sentences.translationZh: 對了，前些時間你說傘不見了，現在找到了嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

sentences.text: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
sentences.translationZh: 當她看到媽媽沒在生她的氣，她的雙眼因為幸福而閃爍了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當她看到媽媽沒在生她的氣，她的雙眼因為幸福而閃爍了。

sentences.text: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
sentences.translationZh: 我不用曲膝就能把我的手掌放到地上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不用曲膝就能把我的手掌放到地上。

sentences.text: I learned to drive a car and got a driver's license when I was eighteen.
sentences.translationZh: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。

sentences.text: I learned to drive a car when I was eighteen and got a driver's license.
sentences.translationZh: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我十八歲時，學了開車、考到了駕照。

sentences.text: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
sentences.translationZh: 我本來預備今天去海灘的，但接著天就開始下雨了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。

sentences.text: I wonder whether we have enough money to buy Tom the painting he wanted.
sentences.translationZh: 我想知道咱們是否有足夠的錢給湯姆買他想要的這幅畫
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想知道咱们是否有足够的钱给汤姆买他想要的这幅画

sentences.text: If we knew what we were doing, it wouldn't be called research, would it?
sentences.translationZh: 如果我們知道我們在做什麼，那麼這不能稱之為研究，是嗎？
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我们知道我们在做什么，那么这不能称之为研究，是吗？

sentences.text: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也沒什麼大不了的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什么大不了的。

sentences.text: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
sentences.translationZh: 在美國，大多數人能在十八歲後投票選舉。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁后投票选举。

sentences.text: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
sentences.translationZh: 得不到的東西就最想得到。
sentences.translationOriginal: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

sentences.text: Rather than cutting down on cigarettes, why don't you just give them up?
sentences.translationZh: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？
sentences.translationOriginal: 比起少抽菸，你何不直接把菸戒了？

sentences.text: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
sentences.translationZh: 反社會者極少為他們的罪行顯露懊悔或有罪惡的感覺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

sentences.text: Tom can't account for his whereabouts on the day that Mary was murdered.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不能說明瑪麗遇害那天自己在哪裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不能说明玛丽遇害那天自己在哪里。

sentences.text: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆從沒忘記在婚禮週年紀念日送給他妻子花。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。

sentences.text: Tom was able to make himself understood in French when he visited Paris.
sentences.translationZh: 在巴黎，沒有人能夠理解湯姆的法文。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在巴黎，沒有人能夠理解湯姆的法文。

sentences.text: We were talking about something at that time, but I don't remember what.
sentences.translationZh: 我們那時在談論事情，但我不記得是什麼了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们那时在谈论事情，但我不记得是什么了。

sentences.text: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
sentences.translationZh: 你不應該在社交網絡上分享過多私人信息。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

sentences.text: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。
sentences.translationOriginal: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。

sentences.text: After school, I go to an English school to practice English conversation.
sentences.translationZh: 放學後，我到一所英語學校去練習英語會話。
sentences.translationOriginal: 放學後，我到一所英語學校去練習英語會話。

sentences.text: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
sentences.translationZh: 因為啤酒會根據麥芽含量去徵稅，所以發泡酒會比較便宜。
sentences.translationOriginal: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

sentences.text: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
sentences.translationZh: 我想你要拿到駕照根本不難。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想你要拿到驾照根本不难。

sentences.text: I thought we had found the perfect hiding place, but the police found us.
sentences.translationZh: 我以為我們發現了絕妙的藏身之處，但警察找到了我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以为我们发现了绝妙的藏身之处，但警察找到了我们。

sentences.text: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
sentences.translationZh: 我想知道最近的美國運通辦事處的電話號碼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我想知道最近的美國運通辦事處的電話號碼。

sentences.text: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
sentences.translationZh: 她定期去看牙醫，所以她很少牙痛。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

sentences.text: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
sentences.translationZh: 讓事情更糟糕的是，他沒有注意到他打擾到了鄰居。
sentences.translationOriginal: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。

sentences.text: You seem to be prejudiced against ideas that come from foreign countries.
sentences.translationZh: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你似乎對來自國外的想法有偏見。

sentences.text: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
sentences.translationZh: 如果一個病人折一千隻紙鶴, 她的願望就會成真。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果一個病人折一千隻紙鶴, 她的願望就會成真。

sentences.text: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
sentences.translationZh: 真難相信湯姆不知道瑪麗愛他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。

sentences.text: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
sentences.translationZh: 請在兩點半參加在二樓會議室的會議。
sentences.translationOriginal: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

sentences.text: Tom returned to his hometown to visit his parents during the summer break.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆在夏休回鄉看望父母。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆在夏休回乡看望父母。

sentences.text: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
sentences.translationZh: 籌劃旅行的時候，我們必須考慮到全家人的意願。
sentences.translationOriginal: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。

sentences.text: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你不會說英語，你就很難得到一個好的職位。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

sentences.text: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
sentences.translationZh: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

sentences.text: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
sentences.translationZh: 英語現已成為世界上許多國家的通用語言了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

sentences.text: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
sentences.translationZh: 假如能一個月之內還上的話，我可以把錢借給你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

sentences.text: Outside the school, she saw people with no homes living in cardboard boxes.
sentences.translationZh: 在校外，她見到沒有家的人們住在紙板箱裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在校外，她见到没有家的人们住在纸板箱里。

sentences.text: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
sentences.translationZh: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。
sentences.translationOriginal: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。

sentences.text: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.
sentences.translationZh: 這電子辭典的好處就是便於攜帶。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。

sentences.text: The lady really flipped out when she learned she had won a million dollars.
sentences.translationZh: 當這位女士得知她已經贏得了百萬美元, 她真的樂瘋了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當這位女士得知她已經贏得了百萬美元, 她真的樂瘋了。

sentences.text: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
sentences.translationZh: 我們對這次的延遲表示抱歉，並對可能造成的不便表示遺憾。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

sentences.text: According to newspaper reports, there was an airplane accident last evening.
sentences.translationZh: 根據報載，有一架飛機昨天晚上發生了意外。
sentences.translationOriginal: 根據報載，有一架飛機昨天晚上發生了意外。

sentences.text: After he had graduated from the university, he taught English for two years.
sentences.translationZh: 從他大學畢業以後, 他教了兩年的英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 從他大學畢業以後, 他教了兩年的英語。

sentences.text: If a man had 11 sheep and all but 9 died, how many sheep would he have left?
sentences.translationZh: 如果一個人有11只羊，除了9只之外，其他全部死了，那麼他還剩下幾隻羊呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果一个人有11只羊，除了9只之外，其他全部死了，那么他还剩下几只羊呢？

sentences.text: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
sentences.translationZh: 如果那天下雨，比賽會順延至下一個晴天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。

sentences.text: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
sentences.translationZh: 給你解釋這為什麼行不通要花很多時間。
sentences.translationOriginal: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。

sentences.text: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
sentences.translationZh: 該國嚴禁進口稀有野生動物。
sentences.translationOriginal: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

sentences.text: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
sentences.translationZh: 忠犬八公的雕像佇立在澀谷站前。
sentences.translationOriginal: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

sentences.text: Tom thought that he had a chance to make a lot of money on the stock market.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆覺得他有機會在股市賺一大筆錢。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。

sentences.text: A person views things differently according to whether they are rich or poor.
sentences.translationZh: 每一個人對事情的看法不同是依據他們是富有還是貧窮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每一個人對事情的看法不同是依據他們是富有還是貧窮。

sentences.text: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管政府拒絕承認，它的經濟政策還是失敗了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

sentences.text: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
sentences.translationZh: 瑪麗把圍裙系在她的腰上，然後把火雞從烤箱裡拿出來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 玛丽把围裙系在她的腰上，然后把火鸡从烤箱里拿出来了。

sentences.text: People look at things differently depending on whether they are rich or poor.
sentences.translationZh: 人們看待事情的角度不同取決於他們是富裕或貧窮。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人們看待事情的角度不同取決於他們是富裕或貧窮。

sentences.text: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part.
sentences.translationZh: 奧運會最重要的不是獲勝，而是參與。
sentences.translationOriginal: 奥运会最重要的不是获胜，而是参与。

sentences.text: The population of London is much greater than that of any other British city.
sentences.translationZh: 倫敦的人口遠遠多於其他英國城市的人口。
sentences.translationOriginal: 倫敦的人口遠遠多於其他英國城市的人口。

sentences.text: They consider it impolite to disagree with someone they don't know very well.
sentences.translationZh: 他們認為，去反駁一個不認識的人有些不禮貌。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他们认为，去反驳一个不认识的人有些不礼貌。

sentences.text: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆得出無論他做什麼，瑪麗都不會喜歡的結論。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆得出无论他做什么，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。

sentences.text: Eighty percent of all information on computers around the world is in English.
sentences.translationZh: 全世界百分之八十電腦上的資訊都是用英語寫的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 全世界百分之八十電腦上的資訊都是用英語寫的。

sentences.text: I thought that we had found the perfect hiding place, but the police found us.
sentences.translationZh: 我以為我們發現了絕妙的藏身之處，但警察找到了我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我以为我们发现了绝妙的藏身之处，但警察找到了我们。

sentences.text: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
sentences.translationZh: 早上起來，嗓子變得很沙啞，我想是不是感冒了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

sentences.text: If it looks like an apple and it tastes like an apple, it's probably an apple.
sentences.translationZh: 如果看起來像個蘋果而且吃起來也像蘋果的話，可能就是蘋果。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果看起来像个苹果而且吃起来也像苹果的话，可能就是苹果。

sentences.text: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
sentences.translationZh: 世界就像是一本書，走一步等於翻了一頁。
sentences.translationOriginal: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

sentences.text: Today, I was supposed to study at the library but I woke up around 12 o'clock.
sentences.translationZh: 今天，我本打算在圖書館學習但到12點左右才醒。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天，我本打算在图书馆学习但到12点左右才醒。

sentences.text: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
sentences.translationZh: Tom寫作可以寫的像本國人一樣，可是他的發音很爛
sentences.translationOriginal: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

sentences.text: Tom did the best he could, but he wasn't able to get a higher grade than Mary.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆盡了全力，但他還是不能獲得比瑪麗更高的等級。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆尽了全力，但他还是不能获得比玛丽更高的等级。

sentences.text: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
sentences.translationZh: 當列車停止時，所有的乘客都想知道發生了什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

sentences.text: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
sentences.translationZh: Charles Lindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。
sentences.translationOriginal: Charles Lindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。

sentences.text: His scores are always better than mine, even though he doesn't study very much.
sentences.translationZh: 他的分數總比我高，儘管他學習得少一點。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他的分数总比我高，尽管他学习得少一点。

sentences.text: I don't have a lot of work, but it's enough to keep me in the office this week.
sentences.translationZh: 其實我工作並不多，但足以讓我這週在辦公室裡忙著了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 其实我工作并不多，但足以让我这周在办公室里忙着了。

sentences.text: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
sentences.translationZh: 我還了從圖書館借的書，又借了些新的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。

sentences.text: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
sentences.translationZh: 文章的發表被預定在教授生日那天。
sentences.translationOriginal: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

sentences.text: She's popular, not because she's beautiful, but because she's kind to everyone.
sentences.translationZh: 她受歡迎不是因為她的美麗，而是因為她親切地對待每個人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她受歡迎不是因為她的美麗，而是因為她親切地對待每個人。

sentences.text: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
sentences.translationZh: 電話運營商提示來電人等候接通。
sentences.translationOriginal: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

sentences.text: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
sentences.translationZh: 那些說錢不能買來幸福的人，只是不知道上哪裡去買而已。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那些说钱不能买来幸福的人，只是不知道上哪里去买而已。

sentences.text: At the time there were no native English speakers teaching in any public school.
sentences.translationZh: 當時沒有任何以英語為母語的人在公立學校任教。
sentences.translationOriginal: 當時沒有任何以英語為母語的人在公立學校任教。

sentences.text: Rio de Janeiro is perfectly safe as long as you stay out of the dangerous areas.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你遠離危險區域，里約熱內盧就是完全安全的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你远离危险区域，里约热内卢就是完全安全的。

sentences.text: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
sentences.translationZh: 她被要求去說服他以讓他或者他的兒子或者是別的人來粉刷屋子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。

sentences.text: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆總是說話聲音太小，我幾乎聽不懂他在說什麼。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。

sentences.text: Even though I studied English for 6 years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.
sentences.translationZh: 儘管我在學校學了6年英語，我還是說不好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 尽管我在学校学了6年英语，我还是说不好。

sentences.text: Every now and then he drops in at this bookstore on his way home from the office.
sentences.translationZh: 有時從辦公室回家的路上他會到這家書店看一看。
sentences.translationOriginal: 有時從辦公室回家的路上他會到這家書店看一看。

sentences.text: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.
sentences.translationZh: 我不知道這個城市，而且我一點都不懂那裡的語言。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。

sentences.text: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
sentences.translationZh: 兩個孩子的年齡加起來和他們的父親相當。
sentences.translationOriginal: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。

sentences.text: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
sentences.translationZh: 對工具箱裡只有一把榔頭的人來說，所有的問題都像釘子。
sentences.translationOriginal: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

sentences.text: Tom went swimming in the river, but when he got out, his clothes had been stolen.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆去河裡游泳，但當他出來時，他的衣服被偷了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆去河里游泳，但当他出来时，他的衣服被偷了。

sentences.text: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.
sentences.translationZh: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。
sentences.translationOriginal: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。

sentences.text: Manholes are round because that way they won't accidentally fall through the hole.
sentences.translationZh: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 人孔是圓的，因為這樣人孔蓋就不會意外地掉進洞裡。

sentences.text: You should have known better than to take an examination without preparing for it.
sentences.translationZh: 你應該知道要為考試作準備。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你應該知道要為考試作準備。

sentences.text: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
sentences.translationZh: 科學上，血型和性格的關聯性沒有被證明。
sentences.translationOriginal: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

sentences.text: I've just spoken to your French teacher and he says you're doing well in his class.
sentences.translationZh: 我剛跟你的法語老師談過話，他說你在課堂上表現得很好。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我刚跟你的法语老师谈过话，他说你在课堂上表现得很好。

sentences.text: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
sentences.translationZh: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。

sentences.text: He came back not because he was homesick, but because he was running short of money.
sentences.translationZh: 他不是因為想家，而是因為沒錢才回來的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 他不是因為想家，而是因為沒錢才回來的。

sentences.text: If you want something to be done right, sometimes you've just got to do it yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 如果你想做對一件事，有時候你得親力親為。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果你想做对一件事，有时候你得亲力亲为。

sentences.text: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
sentences.translationZh: 如果系統工程師繼續離開，公司的競爭優勢將會被削弱。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。

sentences.text: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.
sentences.translationZh: 訪客通常在進入一戶日本人家之前會被要求脫鞋。
sentences.translationOriginal: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。

sentences.text: Why don't we stop arguing over these piddling matters and get to the issues at hand?
sentences.translationZh: 為什麼我們不停止為細枝末節的爭吵而進入正題呢？
sentences.translationOriginal: 为什么我们不停止为细枝末节的争吵而进入正题呢？

sentences.text: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.
sentences.translationZh: 一個成長中的孩子如果沒有充足的能量，可能需要藥物治療。
sentences.translationOriginal: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。

sentences.text: All things considered, I think you should go back home and take care of your parents.
sentences.translationZh: 全盤考慮後，我覺得你應該回家，照顧你的父母。
sentences.translationOriginal: 全盤考慮後，我覺得你應該回家，照顧你的父母。

sentences.text: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
sentences.translationZh: 在倫敦，警察總是擔心在列車上發現炸彈。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在倫敦，警察總是擔心在列車上發現炸彈。

sentences.text: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
sentences.translationZh: 女士們，先生們，由於機場的意外情況，我們的著陸將被推遲。
sentences.translationOriginal: 女士们，先生们，由于机场的意外情况，我们的着陆将被推迟。

sentences.text: The number of people on Facebook is greater than the population of the United States.
sentences.translationZh: Facebook的用戶比美國人口還多。
sentences.translationOriginal: Facebook的用戶比美國人口還多。

sentences.text: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
sentences.translationZh: 除了那些我們嘗試過的政府形態，民主是最差的那種了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

sentences.text: If you could go back and start your life again, from what age would you like to start?
sentences.translationZh: 假如能回到過去讓人生再來一遍的話，你希望能回到幾歲的時候？
sentences.translationOriginal: 假如能回到过去让人生再来一遍的话，你希望能回到几岁的时候？

sentences.text: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
sentences.translationZh: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。
sentences.translationOriginal: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。

sentences.text: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆名義上市公司的領導。他兒子做所有重大決策。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆名义上市公司的领导。他儿子做所有重大决策。

sentences.text: Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆的媽媽是一名護士，她所在的醫院就在瑪麗住的那條街的對面。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。

sentences.text: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
sentences.translationZh: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙, 那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙, 那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。

sentences.text: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
sentences.translationZh: 我必須要換衣服，因為我現在穿的衣服不適合這個環境。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。

sentences.text: Computers are certainly playing an important role in our life, whether we like it or not.
sentences.translationZh: 無論我們是否喜歡電腦，它在我們的生活中始終起著重要的作用。
sentences.translationOriginal: 无论我们是否喜欢电脑，它在我们的生活中始终起着重要的作用。

sentences.text: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
sentences.translationZh: 你覺得這本書的哪個譯本比較好？法語的還是英語的？
sentences.translationOriginal: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

sentences.text: Drinking lots of water is good for you, sure, but one can't drink that much water at once.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然喝多點水對身體有好處，但是一次性喝太多水也是不好的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 虽然喝多点水对身体有好处，但是一次性喝太多水也是不好的。

sentences.text: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
sentences.translationZh: 理論上說，理論和實踐沒有區別。但實踐上說，是有的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。

sentences.text: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
sentences.translationZh: 455名婦女中會有一名直到懷孕第二十週前沒有意識到自己懷孕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 455名婦女中會有一名直到懷孕第二十週前沒有意識到自己懷孕。

sentences.text: Because of its origins, Canadian English has features of both American and British English.
sentences.translationZh: 由於它的起源，加拿大英語具有美國英語和​​英國英語兩者的特色。
sentences.translationOriginal: 由於它的起源，加拿大英語具有美國英語和​​英國英語兩者的特色。

sentences.text: I like this picture, not just because it is famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.
sentences.translationZh: 我喜歡這幅畫，不僅是因為它的名氣，而是因為它真的是一個傑作。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我喜欢这幅画，不仅是因为它的名气，而是因为它真的是一个杰作。

sentences.text: For the other 600 million people, English is either a second language or a foreign language.
sentences.translationZh: 對於其他的六億人口而言，英語不是第二語言就是外語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 對於其他的六億人口而言，英語不是第二語言就是外語。

sentences.text: Lonely people tend to be afraid of meeting others, which ensures they will always be lonely.
sentences.translationZh: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。
sentences.translationOriginal: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。

sentences.text: That place's food is delicious and their prices are low. However, their location isn't good.
sentences.translationZh: 那家館子物美價廉，美中不足的是他們糟糕的位置。
sentences.translationOriginal: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。

sentences.text: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
sentences.translationZh: 在人際交往中，第一印象決定著將要發生的事情內容的百分之五十以上。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。

sentences.text: In Japan, it rains quite a bit during our rainy season which is from mid-June until mid-July.
sentences.translationZh: 在日本，在我們的雨季常常下雨，雨季一般在六月中旬至七月中旬。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在日本，在我们的雨季常常下雨，雨季一般在六月中旬至七月中旬。

sentences.text: Right now, we have blueberries, blackberries, cherries, strawberries, peaches and nectarines.
sentences.translationZh: 現在我們有藍莓、黑莓、櫻桃、草莓、桃子和油桃。
sentences.translationOriginal: 現在我們有藍莓、黑莓、櫻桃、草莓、桃子和油桃。

sentences.text: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
sentences.translationZh: 這五年痛苦的癌症治療他終於堅持下來了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

sentences.text: When we started out, our band could only find small clubs in small cities that would hire us.
sentences.translationZh: 當我們起步時，我們的樂隊只能找小城市裡的小俱樂部僱我們。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当我们起步时，我们的乐队只能找小城市里的小俱乐部雇我们。

sentences.text: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.
sentences.translationZh: 伯拉罕·林肯，美國第16任總統，生於肯塔基州的一個簡陋的小屋裡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 伯拉罕·林肯，美国第16任总统，生于肯塔基州的一个简陋的小屋里。

sentences.text: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
sentences.translationZh: 20個以上九折特惠。
sentences.translationOriginal: 20个以上九折特惠。

sentences.text: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
sentences.translationZh: 真的不敢相信你在吃醫生叮囑不要食用的東西。
sentences.translationOriginal: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。

sentences.text: I think Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得當湯姆發現他買來的畫是贗品的時候，他會很生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。

sentences.text: If we were supposed to talk more than listen, we would have been given two mouths and one ear.
sentences.translationZh: 如果我們應該少聽多說話, 那麼我們應該得到兩個嘴巴一隻耳朵才是。
sentences.translationOriginal: 如果我們應該少聽多說話, 那麼我們應該得到兩個嘴巴一隻耳朵才是。

sentences.text: Optimists see opportunities in disasters while pessimists find disasters in every opportunity.
sentences.translationZh: 樂觀者在災禍中看到機會，悲觀者在機會中看到災禍。
sentences.translationOriginal: 樂觀者在災禍中看到機會，悲觀者在機會中看到災禍。

sentences.text: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆試過還回泳衣來換成更大一號的，但是員工告訴他那是不被允許的。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

sentences.text: During the Depression in the 1930's, many wealthy people lost everything in the stock market crash.
sentences.translationZh: 在十九世紀三十年代的大蕭條時期，許多富人在股市崩盤中失去了一切。
sentences.translationOriginal: 在十九世纪三十年代的大萧条时期，许多富人在股市崩盘中失去了一切。

sentences.text: I think that Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
sentences.translationZh: 我覺得當湯姆發現他買來的畫是贗品的時候，他會很生氣。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。

sentences.text: Some people clung to tree branches for several hours to avoid being washed away by the floodwaters.
sentences.translationZh: 為了不被洪水沖走，有的人緊緊地抱著樹幹長達數個鐘頭。
sentences.translationOriginal: 为了不被洪水冲走，有的人紧紧地抱着树干长达数个钟头。

sentences.text: The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.
sentences.translationZh: 這個工人本來應該在中午十二點到達, 但他被交通堵塞困住了幾個小時。
sentences.translationOriginal: 這個工人本來應該在中午十二點到達, 但他被交通堵塞困住了幾個小時。

sentences.text: My parents usually speak to each other in French, even though my mother is a native English speaker.
sentences.translationZh: 我父母通常用法語對話，即使我母親的母語是英語。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我父母通常用法语对话，即使我母亲的母语是英语。

sentences.text: The large crowd roared in approval as Mark Knopfler played the first few bars of "Money for Nothing".
sentences.translationZh: 就像馬克·諾弗勒早期演唱的歌曲《金錢無用》一樣，絕大多數的人依然高呼贊成“金錢無用論”。
sentences.translationOriginal: 就像马克·诺弗勒早期演唱的歌曲《金钱无用》一样，绝大多数的人依然高呼赞成“金钱无用论”。

sentences.text: If you'd listen a little more carefully to what the teacher says, you'd probably be able to understand.
sentences.translationZh: 假如你在老師講課的時候再集中一點去聽講的話，你應該就能弄明白了。
sentences.translationOriginal: 假如你在老师讲课的时候再集中一点去听讲的话，你应该就能弄明白了。

sentences.text: Tom's daughter pretended not to know him when he came to pick her up from school in his battered old car.
sentences.translationZh: 當湯姆開著他破舊的雷澤車來接女兒放學時，他的女兒假裝不認識他。
sentences.translationOriginal: 当汤姆开着他破旧的雷泽车来接女儿放学时，他的女儿假装不认识他。

sentences.text: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
sentences.translationZh: 許多自然環境保護主義者擔心持續屠殺鯨魚正推動這些動物走向滅絕。
sentences.translationOriginal: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。

sentences.text: The Japanese Parliament today officially elected Ryoutarou Hashimoto as the country's 52nd prime minister.
sentences.translationZh: 日本國會今天正式選舉了橋本龍太郎作為全國第52屆總理。
sentences.translationOriginal: 日本國會今天正式選舉了橋本龍太郎作為全國第52屆總理。

sentences.text: Last year in the Philippines, earthquakes and tidal waves resulted in the deaths of more than 6,000 people.
sentences.translationZh: 去年在菲律賓，地震和海嘯造成了超過6000人的死亡。
sentences.translationOriginal: 去年在菲律宾，地震和海啸造成了超过6000人的死亡。

sentences.text: Is that Tom calling again? "Yes. He calls every evening these days. I shouldn't have given him my number."
sentences.translationZh: “又是湯姆的電話？” “嗯。最近他每天晚上都會打過來。當時就不該給他我的號碼的。”
sentences.translationOriginal: “又是汤姆的电话？” “嗯。最近他每天晚上都会打过来。当时就不该给他我的号码的。”

sentences.text: My mother speaks French better than my father speaks English, so they usually speak to each other in French.
sentences.translationZh: 我母親的法語比我父親的英語要好，所以他們通常用法語交流。
sentences.translationOriginal: 我母亲的法语比我父亲的英语要好，所以他们通常用法语交流。

sentences.text: Tom didn't know how to translate the word "computer" because the people he was talking to had never seen one.
sentences.translationZh: 湯姆不知如何翻譯“計算機”一詞，因為同他談話的人從未見過一臺。
sentences.translationOriginal: 汤姆不知如何翻译“计算机”一词，因为同他谈话的人从未见过一台。

sentences.text: Even now, I occasionally think I'd like to see you. Not the you that you are today, but the you I remember from the past.
sentences.translationZh: 即使是現在，我偶爾還是想見到你。不是今天的你，而是我記憶中曾經的你。
sentences.translationOriginal: 即使是现在，我偶尔还是想见到你。不是今天的你，而是我记忆中曾经的你。

sentences.text: It's very easy to sound natural in your own native language, and very easy to sound unnatural in your non-native language.
sentences.translationZh: 你很容易把母語說得通順流暢，卻很容易把非母語說得不自然。
sentences.translationOriginal: 你很容易把母语说得通顺流畅，却很容易把非母语说得不自然。

sentences.text: I got fired from the company, but since I have a little money saved up, for the time being, I won't have trouble with living expenses.
sentences.translationZh: 雖然我被公司解僱了，但是我還有點存款，所以目前不用擔心生計問題。
sentences.translationOriginal: 虽然我被公司解雇了，但是我还有点存款，所以目前不用担心生计问题。
